1.e: The Lord is One and He can be attained through the grace of the true Guru.
Name of the Bani : Japu Sahib
The sacred utterance of The Tenth Sovereign:
CHHAPAI STANZA. BY THY GRACE

1.g: ਚੱਕ੍ਰ ਚਿਹਨ ਅਰੁ ਬਰਨ ਜਾਤਿ ਅਰੁ ਪਾਤਿ ਨਹਿਨ ਜਿਹ ॥
1.t: cha'kr chihan ar baran jaat ar paat nahin jeh ||
1.e: He who is without mark or sign, He who is without caste or line.

1.g: ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਅਰੁ ਰੇਖ ਭੇਖ ਕੋਊ ਕਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਤਿ ਕਿਹ ॥
1.t: roop ra(n)g ar rekh bhekh kouoo keh na sakat keh ||
1.e: He who is without colour or form, and without any distinctive norm.

1.g: ਅਚਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਨਭਉ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸ ਅਮਿਤੋਜਿ ਕਹਿੱਜੈ ॥
1.t: achal moorat anabhau prakaas amitoj kahi'jai ||
1.e: He who is without limit and motion, All effulgence, non-descript Ocean.

1.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਾਣ ਸਾਹੁ ਸਾਹਾਣਿ ਗਣਿਜੈ ॥
1.t: koT i(n)dhr i(n)dhraan saahu saahaan ganijai ||
1.e: The Lord of millions of Indras and kings, the Master of all worlds and beings.

1.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਮਹੀਪ ਸੁਰ ਨਰ ਅਸੁਰ ਨੇਤ ਨੇਤ ਬਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਣ ਕਹਤ ॥
1.t: tirabhavan maheep sur nar asur net net ban tiran kahat ||
1.e: Each twig of the foliage proclaims: “Not this Thou art.”

1.g: ਤਵ ਸਰਬ ਨਾਮ ਕਥੈ ਕਵਨ ਕਰਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਰਨਤ ਸੁਮਤਿ ॥੧॥
1.t: tav sarab naam kathai kavan karam naam baranat sumat ||1||
1.e: All Thy Names cannot be told. One doth impart Thy Action-Name with benign heart.1.

4.g: ਆਦਿ ਰੂਪ ਅਨਾਦਿ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੋਨਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
4.t: aadh roop anaadh moorat ajon purakh apaar ||
4.e: Thou art the Supreme Purush, an Eternal Entity in the beginning and free from birth.

4.g: ਸਰਬ ਮਾਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਮਾਨ ਦੇਵ ਅਭੇਵ ਆਦਿ ਉਦਾਰ ॥
4.t: sarab maan tiramaan dhev abhev aadh udhaar ||
4.e: Worshipped by all and venerated by three gods, Thou art without difference and art Generous from the very beginning.

4.g: ਸਰਬ ਪਾਲਕ ਸਰਬ ਘਾਲਕ ਸਰਬ ਕੋ ਪੁਨਿ ਕਾਲ ॥
4.t: sarab paalak sarab ghaalak sarab ko pun kaal ||
4.e: Thou art the Creator Sustainer, Inspirer and Destroyer of all.

4.g: ਜੱਤ੍ਰ ਤੱਤ੍ਰ ਬਿਰਾਜਹੀ ਅਵਧੂਤ ਰੂਪ ਰਿਸਾਲ ॥੭੯॥
4.t: ja'tr ta'tr biraajahee avadhoot roop risaal ||79||
4.e: Thou art present everywhere like an ascetic with a Generous disposition.79.

4.g: ਨਾਮ ਠਾਮ ਨ ਜਾਤਿ ਜਾਕਰ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਨ ਰੇਖ ॥
4.t: naam Thaam na jaat jaakar roop ra(n)g na rekh ||
4.e: Thou art Nameless, Placeless, Casteless, Formless, Colourless and Lineless.

4.g: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਉਦਾਰ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੋਨਿ ਆਦਿ ਅਸੇਖ ॥
4.t: aadh purakh udhaar moorat ajon aadh asekh ||
4.e: Thou, the Primal Purusha, art Unborn, Generous Entity and Perfect from the very beginning.

5.g: ਦੇਸ ਔਰ ਨ ਭੇਸ ਜਾਕਰ ਰੂਪ ਰੇਖ ਨ ਰਾਗ ॥
5.t: dhes aauar na bhes jaakar roop rekh na raag ||
5.e: Thou art Countryless, Garbless, Formless, Lineless and Non-attached.

5.g: ਜੱਤ੍ਰ ਤੱਤ੍ਰ ਦਿਸਾ ਵਿਸਾ ਹੁਇ ਫੈਲਿਓ ਅਨੁਰਾਗ ॥੮੦॥
5.t: ja'tr ta'tr dhisaa visaa hui failio anuraag ||80||
5.e: Thou art present in all direction and conners and Pervadest the Universe as Love.80.

5.g: ਨਾਮ ਕਾਮ ਬਿਹੀਨ ਪੇਖਤ ਧਾਮ ਹੂੰ ਨਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
5.t: naam kaam biheen pekhat dhaam hoo(n) neh jaeh ||
5.e: Thou appearest without name and desire, thou hast no particular Abode.

5.g: ਸਰਬ ਮਾਨ ਸਰਬੱਤ੍ਰ ਮਾਨ ਸਦੈਵ ਮਾਨਤ ਤਾਹਿ ॥
5.t: sarab maan saraba'tr maan sadhaiv maanat taeh ||
5.e: Thou, being worshipped by all, art the Enjoyer of all.

5.g: ਏਕ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਨੇਕ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀਨ ਰੂਪ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
5.t: ek moorat anek dharasan keen roop anek ||
5.e: Thou, the One Entity, appearest as Many creating innumerable forms.

5.g: ਖੇਲ ਖੇਲਿ ਅਖੇਲ ਖੇਲਨ ਅੰਤ ਕੋ ਫਿਰਿ ਏਕ ॥੮੧॥
5.t: khel khel akhel khelan a(n)t ko fir ek ||81||
5.e: After playing the world-drama, when Thou wilt stop the play, Thou wilt be the same One again.81.

5.g: ਦੇਵ ਭੇਵ ਨ ਜਾਨਹੀ ਜਿਹ ਬੇਦ ਅਉਰ ਕਤੇਬ ॥
5.t: dhev bhev na jaanahee jeh bedh aaur kateb ||
5.e: The gods and the Scriptures of Hindus and Muslims do not know Thy secret.

5.g: ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਨ ਜਾਤਿ ਪਾਤਿ ਸੁ ਜਾਨਈ ਕਿਂਹ ਜੇਬ ॥
5.t: roop ra(n)g na jaat paat su jaaniee ki(n)h jeb ||
5.e: How to know Thee when thou art Formless, Colourless, Casteless and without lineage?

5.g: ਤਾਤ ਮਾਤ ਨ ਜਾਤ ਜਾਕਰ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਬਿਹੀਨ ॥
5.t: taat maat na jaat jaakar janam maran biheen ||
5.e: Thou art without father and mother and art casteless, Thou art without births and deaths.

5.g: ਚੱਕ੍ਰ ਬੱਕ੍ਰ ਫਿਰੈ ਚਤੁਰ ਚੱਕ ਮਾਨਹੀ ਪੁਰ ਤੀਨ ॥੮੨॥
5.t: cha'kr ba'kr firai chatur cha'k maanahee pur teen ||82||
5.e: Thou movest fast like the disc in all the four directions and art worshipped by the three worlds. 82.

5.g: ਲੋਕ ਚਉਦਹ ਕੇ ਬਿਖੈ ਜਗ ਜਾਪਹੀ ਜਿਂਹ ਜਾਪ ॥
5.t: lok chaudheh ke bikhai jag jaapahee ji(n)h jaap ||
5.e: The Name is recited in the fourteen divisions of the universe.

5.g: ਆਦਿ ਦੇਵ ਅਨਾਦਿ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਥਾਪਿਓ ਸਬੈ ਜਿਂਹ ਥਾਪਿ ॥
5.t: aadh dhev anaadh moorat thaapio sabai ji(n)h thaap ||
5.e: Thou, the Primal God, art Eternal Entity and hast created the entire universe.

5.g: ਪਰਮ ਰੂਪ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
5.t: param roop puneet moorat pooran purakh apaar ||
5.e: Thou, the holiest Entity, art of Supreme Form, Thou art Bondless, Perfect Purusha.

5.g: ਸਰਬ ਬਿਸ੍ਵ ਰਚਿਓ ਸੁਯੰਭਵ ਗੜਨ ਭੰਜਨਹਾਰ ॥੮੩॥
5.t: sarab bisavai rachio suya(n)bhav gaRan bha(n)janahaar ||83||
5.e: Thou, the Self-Existent, Creator and Destroyer, hast crated the whole universe.83.

5.g: ਕਾਲ ਹੀਨ ਕਲਾ ਸੰਜੁਗਤਿ ਅਕਾਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਅਦੇਸ ॥
5.t: kaal heen kalaa sa(n)jugat akaal purakh adhes ||
5.e: Thou art Dearthless, Almighty, Timeless Purasha and Countryless.

5.g: ਧਰਮ ਧਾਮ ਸੁ ਭਰਮ ਰਹਿਤ ਅਭੂਤ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਸ ॥
5.t: dharam dhaam su bharam rahit abhoot alakh abhes ||
5.e: Thou art the Abode of righteousness,  Thou art Illusionless, Garbless, Incomprehensible and devoid of five elements.

5.g: ਅੰਗ ਰਾਗ ਨ ਰੰਗ ਜਾਕਹਿ ਜਾਤਿ ਪਾਤਿ ਨ ਨਾਮ ॥
5.t: a(n)g raag na ra(n)g jaakeh jaat paat na naam ||
5.e: Thou art without body, without attachment, without colour, caste, lineage and name.

5.g: ਗਰਬ ਗੰਜਨ ਦੁਸਟ ਭੰਜਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦਾਇਕ ਕਾਮ ॥੮੪॥
5.t: garab ga(n)jan dhusaT bha(n)jan mukat dhaik kaam ||84||
5.e: Thou art the Destroyer of ego, the vanquisher of tyrants and performer of works leading to salvation.84.

5.g: ਆਪ ਰੂਪ ਅਮੀਕ ਅਨਉਸਤਤਿ ਏਕ ਪੁਰਖ ਅਵਧੂਤ ॥
5.t: aap roop ameek anausatat ek purakh avadhoot ||
5.e: Thou art the Deepest and Indescribable Entity, the One unique ascetic Purusha.

11.e: Then the signatures of the Author (Guru Gobind Singh). BY THY GRACE QUATRAIN (CHAUPAI)
I Salute the One Primal Lord.
Who pervades the watery, earthly and heavenly expanse.
That Primal Purusha is Unmanifested and Immortal.
His Light illumines the fourteen worlds. I.
He hath merged Himself within the elephant and the worm.

11.g: ਰਾਵ ਰੰਕ ਜਿਹ ਇਕ ਸਰ ਜਾਨਾ ॥
11.t: raav ra(n)k jeh ik sar jaanaa ||
11.e: The king and the baggar equal before Him.
That Non-dual and Imperceptible Purusha is Inseparable.
He reaches the inner core of every heart.2.
He is an Inconceivable Entity, Exernal and Garbless.

11.g: ਰਾਗ ਰੰਗ ਜਿਹ ਰੂਪ ਨ ਰੇਖਾ ॥
11.t: raag ra(n)g jeh roop na rekhaa ||
11.e: He is without attachment, colour, form and mark.
He distinct from all others of various colours and signs.
He is the Primal Purusha, Unique and Changeless.3.

11.g: ਬਰਨ ਚਿਹਨ ਜਿਹ ਜਾਤ ਨ ਪਾਤਾ ॥
11.t: baran chihan jeh jaat na paataa ||
11.e: He is without colour, mark, caste and lineage.

11.g: ਸੱਤ੍ਰ ਮਿੱਤ੍ਰ ਜਿਹ ਤਾਤ ਨ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
11.t: sa'tr mi'tr jeh taat na maataa ||
11.e: He is the without enemy, friend, father and mother.

11.g: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਦੂਰਿ ਸਭਨ ਤੇ ਨੇਰਾ ॥
11.t: sabh te dhoor sabhan te neraa ||
11.e: He is far away from all and closest to all.
His dwelling is within water, on earth and in heavens.4.
He is Limitless Entity and hath infinite celestial strain.
The goddess Durga takes refuge at His Feet and abides there.
Brahma and Vishnu Could not know His end.
The four-headed god Brahma described Him ad ‘Neti Neti’ (Not this, Not this).5.
He hath created millions of Indras and Upindras (smaller Indras).
He hath created and destroyed Brahmas and Rudras (Shivas).
He hath created the play of fourteen worlds.
And then Himself merges it within His Self.6.
Infinite demons, gods and Sheshanagas.
He hath created Gandharvas, Yakshas and being of high character.
The story of past, future and present.

11.g: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਕੇ ਪਟ ਪਟ ਕੀ ਜਾਨੀ ॥੭॥
11.t: ghaT ghaT ke paT paT kee jaanee ||7||
11.e: Regarding the inward recesses of every heart are known to Him.7.

11.g: ਤਾਤ ਮਾਤ ਜਿਹ ਜਾਤ ਨ ਪਾਤਾ ॥
11.t: taat maat jeh jaat na paataa ||
11.e: He Who hath no father, mother caste and lineage.
He is not imbues with undivided love for anyone of them.
He is merged in all lights (souls).
I have recognized Him within all and visualized Him at all places. 8.
He is deathless and a non-temporal Entity.
He is Imperceptible Purusha, Unmanifested and Unscathed.

11.g: ਜਾਤ ਪਾਤ ਜਿਹ ਚਿਹਨ ਨ ਬਰਨਾ ॥
11.t: jaat paat jeh chihan na baranaa ||
11.e: He Who is without caste, lineage, mark and colour.
The Unmanifest Lord is Indestructible and ever Stable.9.

11.g: ਸਭ ਕੋ ਕਾਲ ਸਭਨ ਕੋ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
11.t: sabh ko kaal sabhan ko karataa ||
11.e: He is the Destroyer of all and Creator of all.
He is the Remover of maladies, sufferings and blemishes.

11.g: ਏਕ ਚਿੱਤ ਜਿਹ ਇਕ ਛਿਨ ਧਿਆਇਓ ॥
11.t: ek chi't jeh ik chhin dhiaaio ||
11.e: He Who meditates upon Him with single mind even for an instant

11.g: ਕਾਲ ਫਾਸ ਕੇ ਬੀਚ ਨ ਆਇਓ ॥੧੦॥
11.t: kaal faas ke beech na aaio ||10||
11.e: He doth not come within the trap of death. 10.
BY THY GRACE KABITT

11.g: ਕਤਹੂੰ ਸੁਚੇਤ ਹੁਇ ਕੈ ਚੇਤਨਾ ਕੋ ਚਾਰ ਕੀਓ ਕਤਹੂੰ ਅਚਿੰਤ ਹੁਇ ਕੈ ਸੋਵਤ ਅਚੇਤ ਹੋ ॥
11.t: katahoo(n) suchet hui kai chetanaa ko chaar keeo katahoo(n) achi(n)t hui kai sovat achet ho ||
11.e: O Lord! Somewhere becoming Conscious, Thou adrnest consciousness ,  somewhere becoming Carefree, thou sleepest unconsciously.

12.g: ਕਤਹੂੰ ਭਿਖਾਰੀ ਹੁਇ ਕੈ ਮਾਂਗਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਭੀਖ ਕਹੂੰ ਮਹਾ ਦਾਨ ਹੁਇ ਕੈ ਮਾਂਗਿਓ ਧਨ ਦੇਤ ਹੋ ॥
12.t: katahoo(n) bhikhaaree hui kai maa(n)gat firat bheekh kahoo(n) mahaa dhaan hui kai maa(n)gio dhan dhet ho ||
12.e: Somewhere becoming a beggar, Thou beggest alms and somewhere becoming a Supreme Donor, Thou bestowest the begged wealth.

12.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਮਹਾਂ ਰਾਜਨ ਕੋ ਦੀਜਤ ਅਨੰਤ ਦਾਨ ਕਹੂੰ ਮਹਾਂ ਰਾਜਨ ਤੇ ਛੀਨ ਛਿਤ ਲੇਤ ਹੋ ॥
12.t: kahoo(n) mahaa(n) raajan ko dheejat ana(n)t dhaan kahoo(n) mahaa(n) raajan te chheen chhit let ho ||
12.e: Some where Thou givest inexhaustible gifts to emperors and somewhere Thou deprivest the emperors of their kingdoms.

12.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਬੇਦ ਰੀਤ ਕਹੂੰ ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਬਿਪ੍ਰੀਤ ਕਹੂੰ ਤ੍ਰਿਗੁਨ ਅਤੀਤ ਕਹੂੰ ਸੁਰਗੁਨ ਸਮੇਤ ਹੋ ॥੧॥੧੧॥
12.t: kahoo(n) bedh reet kahoo(n) taa siau bipreet kahoo(n) tiragun ateet kahoo(n) suragun samet ho ||1||11||
12.e: Somewhere Thou workest in accordance with Vedic rites and somewhere Thou art quite opposed to it,  somewhere Thou art without three modes of maya and somewhere Thou hast all godly attributes.1.11.

12.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਜੱਛ ਗੰਧ੍ਰਬ ਉਰਗ ਕਹੂੰ ਬਿਦਿਆਧਰ ਕਹੂੰ ਭਏ ਕਿੰਨਰ ਪਿਸਾਚ ਕਹੂੰ ਪ੍ਰੇਤ ਹੋ ॥
12.t: kahoo(n) ja'chh ga(n)dhrab urag kahoo(n) bidhiaadhar kahoo(n) bhe ki(n)nar pisaach kahoo(n) pret ho ||
12.e: O Lord! Somewhere Thou art Yaksha, Gandharva, Sheshanaga and Vidyadhar and somewhere Thou becomest Kinnar, Pishacha and Preta.

12.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਹੁਇ ਕੈ ਹਿੰਦੂਆ ਗਾਇਤ੍ਰੀ ਕੋ ਗੁਪਤ ਜਪਿਓ ਕਹੂੰ ਹੁਇ ਕੈ ਤੁਰਕਾ ਪੁਕਾਰੇ ਬਾਂਗ ਦੇਤ ਹੋ ॥
12.t: kahoo(n) hui kai hi(n)dhooaa gaitree ko gupat japio kahoo(n) hui kai turakaa pukaare baa(n)g dhet ho ||
12.e: Somewhere Thou becomest a Hindu and repeatest Gayatri secretly: Somewhere becoming a Turk Thou callest Muslims to worship.

12.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਕੋਕ ਕਾਬ ਹੁਇ ਕੈ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਕੋ ਪੜਤ ਮਤ ਕਤਹੂੰ ਕੁਰਾਨ ਕੋ ਨਿਦਾਨ ਜਾਨ ਲੇਤ ਹੋ ॥
12.t: kahoo(n) kok kaab hui kai puraan ko paRat mat katahoo(n) kuraan ko nidhaan jaan let ho ||
12.e: Somewhere being a poet thou recitest the Pauranic wisdom and somewhere Thou recitest the Pauranic wisdom and somewhere Thou comprehendest the essence of Quran.

12.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਬੇਦ ਰੀਤ ਕਹੂੰ ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਬਿਪ੍ਰੀਤ ਕਹੂੰ ਤ੍ਰਿਗੁਨ ਅਤੀਤ ਕਹੂੰ ਸੁਰਗੁਨ ਸਮੇਤ ਹੋ ॥੨॥੧੨॥
12.t: kahoo(n) bedh reet kahoo(n) taa siau bipreet kahoo(n) tiragun ateet kahoo(n) suragun samet ho ||2||12||
12.e: Somewhere Thou workest in accordance with Vedic rites and somewhere Thou art quite opposed to it ;  somewhere Thou art without threee modes of maya and somewhere Thou hast all godly attributes. 2.12.

12.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਦੇਵਤਾਨ ਕੇ ਦਿਵਾਨ ਮੈ ਬਿਰਾਜਮਾਨ ਕਹੂੰ ਦਾਨਵਾਨ ਕੋ ਗੁਮਾਨ ਮਤ ਦੇਤ ਹੋ ॥
12.t: kahoo(n) dhevataan ke dhivaan mai biraajamaan kahoo(n) dhaanavaan ko gumaan mat dhet ho ||
12.e: O Lord! Somewhere Thou art seated in the Court of gods and somewhere Thou givest the egoistic intellect to demons.

12.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਰਾਜਾ ਕੋ ਮਿਲਤ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਪਦਵੀ ਸੀ ਕਹੂੰ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਪਦਵੀ ਛਿਪਾਇ ਛੀਨ ਲੇਤ ਹੋ ॥
12.t: kahoo(n) i(n)dhr raajaa ko milat i(n)dhr padhavee see kahoo(n) i(n)dhr padhavee chhipai chheen let ho ||
12.e: Somewhere Thou Bestowest the position of of the king of gods to Indra and somewhere Thou deprivest Indra of this position.

12.g: ਕਤਹੂੰ ਬਿਚਾਰ ਅਬਿਚਾਰ ਕੋ ਬਿਚਾਰਤ ਹੋ ਕਹੂੰ ਨਿਜ ਨਾਰ ਪਰ ਨਾਰ ਕੇ ਨਿਕੇਤ ਹੋ ॥
12.t: katahoo(n) bichaar abichaar ko bichaarat ho kahoo(n) nij naar par naar ke niket ho ||
12.e: Somewhere Thou discriminatest between good and bad intellect, somewhere Thou art with Thy own spouse and somewhere with another’s wife.

12.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਬੇਦ ਰੀਤ ਕਹੂੰ ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਬਿਪ੍ਰੀਤ ਕਹੂੰ ਤ੍ਰਿਗੁਨ ਅਤੀਤ ਕਹੂੰ ਸੁਰਗੁਨ ਸਮੇਤ ਹੋ ॥੩॥੧੩॥
12.t: kahoo(n) bedh reet kahoo(n) taa siau bipreet kahoo(n) tiragun ateet kahoo(n) suragun samet ho ||3||13||
12.e: Somewhere Thou workest in accordance with Vedic rites and somewhere Thou art quite opposed to it,  somewhere Thou art without three modes of maya and somewhere Thou hast all godly attributes. 3.13.

12.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਸਸਤ੍ਰਧਾਰੀ ਕਹੂੰ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਕੇ ਬਿਚਾਰੀ ਕਹੂੰ ਮਾਰਤ ਅਹਾਰੀ ਕਹੂੰ ਨਾਰ ਕੇ ਨਿਕੇਤ ਹੋ ॥
12.t: kahoo(n) sasatradhaaree kahoo(n) bidhiaa ke bichaaree kahoo(n) maarat ahaaree kahoo(n) naar ke niket ho ||
12.e: O Lord! Somewhere Thou art an armed warrior, somewhere Thou art an armed warrior, somewhere a learned thinker, somewhere a hunter and somewhere an enjoyer of women.

12.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਦੇਵਬਾਨੀ ਕਹੂੰ ਸਾਰਦਾ ਭਵਾਨੀ ਕਹੂੰ ਮੰਗਲਾ ਮ੍ਰਿੜਾਨੀ ਕਹੂੰ ਸਿਆਮ ਕਹੂੰ ਸੇਤ ਹੋ ॥
12.t: kahoo(n) dhevabaanee kahoo(n) saaradhaa bhavaanee kahoo(n) ma(n)galaa miraRaanee kahoo(n) siaam kahoo(n) set ho ||
12.e: Somewhere Thou art the divine speech, somewhere Sarada and Bhavani, somewhere Durga, the trampler of corpses, somewhere in black colour and somewhere in white colour.

12.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਧਰਮ ਧਾਮੀ ਕਹੂੰ ਸਰਬ ਠਉਰ ਗਾਮੀ ਕਹੂੰ ਜਤੀ ਕਹੂੰ ਕਾਮੀ ਕਹੂੰ ਦੇਤ ਕਹੂੰ ਲੇਤ ਹੋ ॥
12.t: kahoo(n) dharam dhaamee kahoo(n) sarab Thaur gaamee kahoo(n) jatee kahoo(n) kaamee kahoo(n) dhet kahoo(n) let ho ||
12.e: Somewhere Thou art abode of Dharma (righteousness), somewhere All-Pervading, somewhere a celibate, somewhere a lustful person, somewhere a donor and somewhere a taker.

12.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਬੇਦ ਰੀਤ ਕਹੂੰ ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਬਿਪ੍ਰੀਤ ਕਹੂੰ ਤ੍ਰਿਗੁਨ ਅਤੀਤ ਕਹੂੰ ਸੁਰਗੁਨ ਸਮੇਤ ਹੋ ॥੪॥੧੪॥
12.t: kahoo(n) bedh reet kahoo(n) taa siau bipreet kahoo(n) tiragun ateet kahoo(n) suragun samet ho ||4||14||
12.e: Somewhere Thou workest in accordance with Vedic rites, and somewhere Thou art quite opposed to it,  somewhere Thou art without three modes of maya and somewhere Thou hast all gldly attributes.4.14.

12.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਜਟਾਧਾਰੀ ਕਹੂੰ ਕੰਠੀ ਧਰੇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਚਾਰੀ ਕਹੂੰ ਜੋਗ ਸਾਧੀ ਕਹੂੰ ਸਾਧਨਾ ਕਰਤ ਹੋ ॥
12.t: kahoo(n) jaTaadhaaree kahoo(n) ka(n)Thee dhare brahamachaaree kahoo(n) jog saadhee kahoo(n) saadhanaa karat ho ||
12.e: O Lord! Somewhere Thou art a sage wearing matted hair, somewhere Thu art a rosary-wearing celibate, somewhere Thou art a rosary-wearing celibate, somewhere Thou hast practiced Yoga and somewhere Thou art practicing Yoga.

12.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਕਾਨ ਫਾਰੇ ਕਹੂੰ ਡੰਡੀ ਹੁਇ ਪਧਾਰੇ ਕਹੂੰ ਫੂਕ ਫੂਕ ਪਾਵਨ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਥੀ ਪੈ ਧਰਤ ਹੋ ॥
12.t: kahoo(n) kaan faare kahoo(n) dda(n)ddee hui padhaare kahoo(n) fook fook paavan kau pirathee pai dharat ho ||
12.e: Somewhere Thou art a Kanphata Yougi and somewhere Thou roamest like a Dandi saint, somewhere Thou steppest on the earth very cautiously.

12.g: ਕਤਹੂੰ ਸਿਪਾਹੀ ਹੁਇ ਕੈ ਸਾਧਤ ਸਿਲਾਹਨ ਕੌ ਕਹੂੰ ਛਤ੍ਰੀ ਹੁਇ ਕੈ ਅਰ ਮਾਰਤ ਮਰਤ ਹੋ ॥
12.t: katahoo(n) sipaahee hui kai saadhat silaahan kau kahoo(n) chhatree hui kai ar maarat marat ho ||
12.e: Somewhere becoming a soldier, Thou practisest arms and somewhere becoming a kshatriya, Thou slayest the enemy or be slayed Thyself.

12.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਭੂਮ ਭਾਰ ਕੌ ਉਤਾਰਤ ਹੋ ਮਹਾਰਾਜ ਕਹੂੰ ਭਵ ਭੂਤਨ ਕੀ ਭਾਵਨਾ ਭਰਤ ਹੋ ॥੫॥੧੫॥
12.t: kahoo(n) bhoom bhaar kau utaarat ho mahaaraaj kahoo(n) bhav bhootan kee bhaavanaa bharat ho ||5||15||
12.e: Somewhere Thou removest the burden of the earth, O Supreme Sovereign! And somewhere Thou the wishes of the worldly beings. 5.15.

12.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਗੀਤ ਨਾਦ ਕੇ ਨਿਦਾਨ ਕੌ ਬਤਾਵਤ ਹੋ ਕਹੂੰ ਨ੍ਰਿਤਕਾਰੀ ਚਿਤ੍ਰਕਾਰੀ ਕੇ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਹੋ ॥
12.t: kahoo(n) geet naadh ke nidhaan kau bataavat ho kahoo(n) niratakaaree chitrakaaree ke nidhaan ho ||
12.e: O Lord! Somewhere Thou elucidatest the traits of song and sound and somewhere Thou art the treasure of dancing and painting.

12.g: ਕਤਹੂੰ ਪਯੂਖ ਹੁਇ ਕੈ ਪੀਵਤ ਪਿਵਾਵਤ ਹੋ ਕਤਹੂੰ ਮਯੂਖ ਊਖ ਕਹੂੰ ਮਦ ਪਾਨ ਹੋ ॥
12.t: katahoo(n) payookh hui kai peevat pivaavat ho katahoo(n) mayookh uookh kahoo(n) madh paan ho ||
12.e: Somewhere Thou art ambrosia which Thou drinkest and causest to drink, somewhere Thou art honey and sugarcane juice and somewhere Thou seemest intoxicated with wine.

12.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਮਹਾ ਸੂਰ ਹੁਇ ਕੈ ਮਾਰਤ ਮਵਾਸਨ ਕੌ ਕਹੂੰ ਮਹਾਦੇਵ ਦੇਵਤਾਨ ਕੇ ਸਮਾਨ ਹੋ ॥
12.t: kahoo(n) mahaa soor hui kai maarat mavaasan kau kahoo(n) mahaadhev dhevataan ke samaan ho ||
12.e: Somewhere, becoming a great warrior Thou slayeth the enemies and somewhere Thou art like the chief gods.

12.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਮਹਾਦੀਨ ਕਹੂੰ ਦ੍ਰਬ ਕੇ ਅਧੀਨ ਕਹੂੰ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰਬੀਨ ਕਹੂੰ ਭੂਮ ਕਹੂੰ ਭਾਨ ਹੋ ॥੬॥੧੬॥
12.t: kahoo(n) mahaadheen kahoo(n) dhrab ke adheen kahoo(n) bidhiaa mai prabeen kahoo(n) bhoom kahoo(n) bhaan ho ||6||16||
12.e: Somewhere thou art very humble, somewhere Thou art full of ego, somewhere Thou art an adept in learning, somewhere Thou art earth and somewhere Thou art the sun. 6.16.

12.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਅਕਲੰਕ ਕਹੂੰ ਮਾਰਤ ਮਯੰਕ ਕਹੂੰ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਜੰਕ ਕਹੂੰ ਸੱੁਧਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਹੋ ॥
12.t: kahoo(n) akala(n)k kahoo(n) maarat maya(n)k kahoo(n) pooran praja(n)k kahoo(n) sa'udhataa kee saar ho ||
12.e: O Lord! Somewhere Thou art without any blemish, somewhere Thou smitest the moon, somewhere Thou art completely engrossed in enjoyment on Thy couch and somewhere Thou art the essence of Purity.

12.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਦੇਵ ਧਰਮ ਕਹੂੰ ਸਾਧਨਾ ਕੇ ਹਰਮ ਕਹੂੰ ਕੁਤਸਤ ਕੁਕਰਮ ਕਹੂੰ ਧਰਮ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਹੋ ॥
12.t: kahoo(n) dhev dharam kahoo(n) saadhanaa ke haram kahoo(n) kutasat kukaram kahoo(n) dharam ke prakaar ho ||
12.e: Somewhere Thou performest godly rituals, somewhere Thou art the Abode of religious discipline, somewhere Thou art the vicious actions and somewhere Thou art the vicious actions and somewhere Thou appearest in variety of virtuous acts.

12.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਪਉਨ ਅਹਾਰੀ ਕਹੂੰ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਕੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ਕਹੂੰ ਜੋਗੀ ਜਤੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਚਾਰੀ ਨਰ ਕਹੂੰ ਨਾਰ ਹੋ ॥
12.t: kahoo(n) paun ahaaree kahoo(n) bidhiaa ke beechaaree kahoo(n) jogee jatee brahamachaaree nar kahoo(n) naar ho ||
12.e: Somewhere Thou subsistest on air, somewhere Thou art a learned thinker and somewhere Thou art a Yogi, a Celibate, a Brahmchari ( disciplined student), a man and a womean.

12.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਛਤ੍ਰਧਾਰੀ ਕਹੂੰ ਛਾਲਾ ਧਰੇ ਛੈਲ ਭਾਰੀ ਕਹੂੰ ਛਕਵਾਰੀ ਕਹੂੰ ਛਲ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਹੋ ॥੭॥੧੭॥
12.t: kahoo(n) chhatradhaaree kahoo(n) chhaalaa dhare chhail bhaaree kahoo(n) chhakavaaree kahoo(n) chhal ke prakaar ho ||7||17||
12.e: Somewhere Thou art a mighty sovereign, somewhere Thou art a great preceptor sitting on a deer-skin, somewhere Thou art prone to be deceived and somewhere Thou art various types of deception Thyself. 7.17.

12.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਗੀਤ ਕੇ ਗਵੱਯਾ ਕਹੂੰ ਬੇਨ ਕੇ ਬਜੱਯਾ ਕਹੂੰ ਨ੍ਰਿਤ ਕੇ ਨਚੱਯਾ ਕਹੂੰ ਨਰ ਕੋ ਅਕਾਰ ਹੋ ॥
12.t: kahoo(n) geet ke gava'yaa kahoo(n) ben ke baja'yaa kahoo(n) nirat ke nacha'yaa kahoo(n) nar ko akaar ho ||
12.e: O Lord! Somewhere Thou art singer of song somewhere Thou art player of flute, somewhere Thou art a dancer and somewhere in the form of a man.

12.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਬੇਦ ਬਾਨੀ ਕਹੂੰ ਕੋਕ ਕੀ ਕਹਾਨੀ ਕਹੂੰ ਰਾਜਾ ਕਹੂੰ ਰਾਨੀ ਕਹੂੰ ਨਾਰ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਹੋ ॥
12.t: kahoo(n) bedh baanee kahoo(n) kok kee kahaanee kahoo(n) raajaa kahoo(n) raanee kahoo(n) naar ke prakaar ho ||
12.e: Somewhere Thou art the vedic hymns and somewhere the story of the elucidator of the mystery of love,  somewhere Thou art Thyself the king, the queen and also various types of woman.

12.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਬੇਨ ਕੇ ਬਜੱਯਾ ਕਹੂੰ ਧੇਨ ਕੇ ਚਰੱਯਾ ਕਹੂੰ ਲਾਖਨ ਲਵੱਯਾ ਕਹੂੰ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਕੁਮਾਰ ਹੋ ॥
12.t: kahoo(n) ben ke baja'yaa kahoo(n) dhen ke chara'yaa kahoo(n) laakhan lava'yaa kahoo(n) su(n)dhar kumaar ho ||
12.e: Somewhere Thou art the player of flute, somewhere the grazier of cows and somewhere Thou art the beautiful youth, enticer of lakhs (of lovely maids.)

12.g: ਸੁਧਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਾਨ ਹੋ ਕਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਹੋ ਕਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਮਹਾ ਦਾਨ ਹੋ ਕਿ ਨ੍ਰਿਦੋਖੀ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਹੋ ॥੮॥੧੮॥
12.t: sudhataa kee saan ho k sa(n)tan ke praan ho k dhaataa mahaa dhaan ho k niradhokhee nira(n)kaar ho ||8||18||
12.e: Somewhere Thou art the splendour of Purity, the life of the saints, the Donor of great charities and the immaculate Formless Lord. 8.18.

12.g: ਨਿਰਜੁਰ ਨਿਰੂਪ ਹੋ ਕਿ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸਰੂਪ ਹੋ ਕਿ ਭੂਪਨ ਕੇ ਭੂਪ ਹੋ ਕਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਮਹਾ ਦਾਨ ਹੋ ॥
12.t: nirajur niroop ho k su(n)dhar saroop ho k bhoopan ke bhoop ho k dhaataa mahaa dhaan ho ||
12.e: O Lord! Thou art the Invisible Cataract, the Most Beautiful Entity, the King of Kings and the Donor of great charities.

12.g: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਕੇ ਬਚੱਯਾ ਦੂਧ ਪੂਤ ਕੇ ਦਿਵੱਯਾ ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਕੇ ਮਿਟੱਯਾ ਕਿਧੌ ਮਾਨੀ ਮਹਾ ਮਾਨ ਹੋ ॥
12.t: praan ke bacha'yaa dhoodh poot ke dhiva'yaa rog sog ke miTa'yaa kidhau maanee mahaa maan ho ||
12.e: Thou art the Saviour of life, the Giver of milk and offspring, the Remover of ailments and sufferings and somewhere Thou art the Lord of Highest Honour.

12.g: ਬਿਦਿਆ ਕੇ ਬਿਚਾਰ ਹੋ ਕਿ ਅਦ੍ਵੈ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਹੋ ਕਿ ਸਿੱਧਤਾ ਕੀ ਸੂਰਤਿ ਹੋ ਕਿ ਸੁਧਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਾਨ ਹੋ ॥
12.t: bidhiaa ke bichaar ho k adhavai avataar ho k si'dhataa kee soorat ho k sudhataa kee saan ho ||
12.e: Thou art the essence of all learning, the embodiment of monism, the Being of All-Powers and the Glory of Sanctification.

12.g: ਜੋਬਨ ਕੇ ਜਾਲ ਹੋ ਕਿ ਕਾਲ ਹੂੰ ਕੇ ਕਾਲ ਹੋ ਕਿ ਸਤ੍ਰਨ ਕੇ ਸੂਲ ਹੋ ਕਿ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਨ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਹੋ ॥੯॥੧੯॥
12.t: joban ke jaal ho k kaal hoo(n) ke kaal ho k satran ke sool ho k mitran ke praan ho ||9||19||
12.e: Thou art the snare of youth, the Death of Death, the anguish of enemies and the life of the friends. 9.19.

12.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਾਦ ਕਹੂੰ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਕੋ ਬਿਖਾਦ ਕਹੂੰ ਨਾਦ ਕੋ ਨਨਾਦ ਕਹੂੰ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਗਤ ਹੋ ॥
12.t: kahoo(n) braham baadh kahoo(n) bidhiaa ko bikhaadh kahoo(n) naadh ko nanaadh kahoo(n) pooran bhagat ho ||
12.e: O Lord! Somewhere Thou art in defic conduct, somewhere Thou appearest as contention in learning somewhere Thou art the tune of sound and somewhere a perfect saint (attuned with celestial strain).

12.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਬੇਦ ਰੀਤ ਕਹੂੰ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਤ ਕਹੂੰ ਨੀਤ ਅਉ ਅਨੀਤ ਕਹੂੰ ਜੁਆਲਾ ਸੀ ਜਗਤ ਹੋ ॥
12.t: kahoo(n) bedh reet kahoo(n) bidhiaa kee prateet kahoo(n) neet aau aneet kahoo(n) juaalaa see jagat ho ||
12.e: Somewhere Thou art Vedic ritual, somewhere the love for learning, somewhere ethical and unethical, and somewhere appearest as the glow of fire.

12.g: ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪ ਕਹੂੰ ਇਕਾਤੀ ਕੋ ਜਾਪ ਕਹੂੰ ਤਾਪ ਕੋ ਅਤਾਪ ਕਹੂੰ ਜੋਗ ਤੇ ਡਿਗਤ ਹੋ ॥
12.t: pooran prataap kahoo(n) ikaatee ko jaap kahoo(n) taap ko ataap kahoo(n) jog te ddigat ho ||
12.e: Somewhere Thou art perfectly Glorious, somewhere engrossed in solitary recitation, somewhere Remover of Suffering in great Agony and somewhere Thou appearest as a fallen yogi.

12.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਬਰ ਦੇਤ ਕਹੂੰ ਛਲ ਸਿਉ ਛਿਨਾਇ ਲੇਤ ਸਰਬ ਕਾਲ ਸਰਬ ਠਉਰ ਏਕ ਸੇ ਲਗਤ ਹੋ ॥੧੦॥੨੦॥
12.t: kahoo(n) bar dhet kahoo(n) chhal siau chhinai let sarab kaal sarab Thaur ek se lagat ho ||10||20||
12.e: Somewhere Thou bestowest the Boon and somewhere withdraw it with deceit. Thou at all times and at all the places Thou comest into view as the same. 10.20.

12.g: ਤ੍ਵ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥ ਸਵੱਯੇ ॥
12.t: tavai prasaadh || sava'ye ||
12.e: BY THY GRACE SWAYYAS

12.g: ਸ੍ਰਾਵਗ ਸੁੱਧ ਸਮੂਹ ਸਿਧਾਨ ਕੇ ਦੇਖਿ ਫਿਰਿਓ ਘਰ ਜੋਗ ਜਤੀ ਕੇ ॥
12.t: sraavag su'dh samooh sidhaan ke dhekh firio ghar jog jatee ke ||
12.e: I have seen during my tours pure Sravaks (Jaina and Buddhist monks), group of adepts and abodes of ascetics and Yogi.

12.g: ਸੂਰ ਸੁਰਾਰਦਨ ਸੁੱਧ ਸੁਧਾਦਿਕ ਸੰਤ ਸਮੂਹ ਅਨੇਕ ਮਤੀ ਕੇ ॥
12.t: soor suraaradhan su'dh sudhaadhik sa(n)t samooh anek matee ke ||
12.e: Valiant heroes, demons killing gods, gods drinking nectar and assemblies of saints of various sects.

12.g: ਸਾਰੇ ਹੀ ਦੇਸ ਕੋ ਦੇਖਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਮਤ ਕੋਊ ਨ ਦੇਖੀਅਤ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤੀ ਕੇ ॥
12.t: saare hee dhes ko dhekh rahio mat kouoo na dhekheeat praanapatee ke ||
12.e: I have seen the disciplines of the religious systems of all the countries, but seen none of the Lord, the Master of my life.

12.g: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਭਗਵਾਨ ਕੀ ਭਾਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਹੂ ਤੇ ਏਕ ਰਤੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਏਕ ਰਤੀ ਕੇ ॥੧॥੨੧॥
12.t: sree bhagavaan kee bhai kirapaa hoo te ek ratee bin ek ratee ke ||1||21||
12.e: They are worth nothing without an iota of the Grace of the Lord. 1.21.

12.g: ਮਾਤੇ ਮਤੰਗ ਜਰੇ ਜਰ ਸੰਗ ਅਨੂਪ ਉਤੰਗ ਸੁਰੰਗ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
12.t: maate mata(n)g jare jar sa(n)g anoop uta(n)g sura(n)g savaare ||
12.e: With intoxicated elephants, studded with gold, incomparable and huge, painted in bright colours.

12.g: ਕੋਟ ਤੁਰੰਗ ਕੁਰੰਗ ਸੇ ਕੂਦਤ ਪਉਨ ਕੇ ਗਉਨ ਕੋ ਜਾਤ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
12.t: koT tura(n)g kura(n)g se koodhat paun ke gaun ko jaat nivaare ||
12.e: With millions of horses galloping like deer, moving faster than the wind.

12.g: ਭਾਰੀ ਭੁਜਾਨ ਕੇ ਭੂਪ ਭਲੀ ਬਿਧਿ ਨਿਆਵਤ ਸੀਸ ਨ ਜਾਤ ਬਿਚਾਰੇ ॥
12.t: bhaaree bhujaan ke bhoop bhalee bidh niaavat sees na jaat bichaare ||
12.e: With many kings indescribable, having long arms (of heavy allied forces), bowing their heads in fine array.

12.g: ਏਤੇ ਭਏ ਤੁ ਕਹਾ ਭਏ ਭੂਪਤਿ ਅੰਤ ਕੋ ਨਾਂਗੇ ਹੀ ਪਾਂਇ ਪਧਾਰੇ ॥੨॥੨੨॥
12.t: ete bhe ta kahaa bhe bhoopat a(n)t ko naa(n)ge hee paa(n)i padhaare ||2||22||
12.e: What matters if such mighty emperors were there, because they had to leave the world with bare feet.2.22.

12.g: ਜੀਤ ਫਿਰੈ ਸਭ ਦੇਸ ਦਿਸਾਨ ਕੋ ਬਾਜਤ ਢੋਲ ਮ੍ਰਿਦੰਗ ਨਗਾਰੇ ॥
12.t: jeet firai sabh dhes dhisaan ko baajat ddol miradha(n)g nagaare ||
12.e: With the beat of drums and trumpets if the emperor conquers all the countries.

13.g: ਗੁੰਜਤ ਗੂੜ ਗਜਾਨ ਕੇ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਹਿੰਸਤ ਹੈਂ ਹਯਰਾਜ ਹਜਾਰੇ ॥
13.t: gu(n)jat gooR gajaan ke su(n)dhar hi(n)sat hai(n) hayaraaj hajaare ||
13.e: Along with many beautiful roaring elephants and thousands of neighing houses of best breed.

13.g: ਭੂਤ ਭਵਿੱਖ ਭਵਾਨ ਕੇ ਭੂਪਤ ਕਉਨੁ ਗਨੈ ਨਹੀਂ ਜਾਤ ਬਿਚਾਰੇ ॥
13.t: bhoot bhavi'kh bhavaan ke bhoopat kaun ganai nahee(n) jaat bichaare ||
13.e: Such like emperors of the past, present and future cannot be counted and ascertained.

13.g: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਪਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਭਗਵਾਨ ਭਜੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਅੰਤ ਕਉ ਅੰਤ ਕੇ ਧਾਮ ਸਿਧਾਰੇ ॥੩॥੨੩॥
13.t: sree pat sree bhagavaan bhaje bin a(n)t kau a(n)t ke dhaam sidhaare ||3||23||
13.e: But without remembering the Name of the Lord, they ultimately leave for their final abode. 3.23.

13.g: ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਨ ਦਇਆ ਦਮ ਦਾਨ ਸੁ ਸੰਜਮ ਨੇਮ ਅਨੇਕ ਬਿਸੇਖੈ ॥
13.t: teerath naan dhiaa dham dhaan su sa(n)jam nem anek bisekhai ||
13.e: Taking bath at holy places, exercising mercy, controlling passions, performing acts of charity, practicing austerity and many special rituals.

13.g: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਕਤੇਬ ਕੁਰਾਨ ਜਮੀਨ ਜਮਾਨ ਸਬਾਨ ਕੇ ਪੇਖੈ ॥
13.t: bedh puraan kateb kuraan jameen jamaan sabaan ke pekhai ||
13.e: Studying of Vedas, Puranas and holy Quran and scanning all this world and the next world.

13.g: ਪਉਨ ਅਹਾਰ ਜਤੀ ਜਤ ਧਾਰ ਸਬੈ ਸੁ ਬਿਚਾਰ ਹਜਾਰ ਕ ਦੇਖੈ ॥
13.t: paun ahaar jatee jat dhaar sabai su bichaar hajaar k dhekhai ||
13.e: Subsisting only on air, practicing continence and meeting thousands of persons of all good thoughts.

13.g: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਭਗਵਾਨ ਭਜੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਭੂਪਤਿ ਏਕ ਰਤੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਏਕ ਨ ਲੇਖੈ ॥੪॥੨੪॥
13.t: sree bhagavaan bhaje bin bhoopat ek ratee bin ek na lekhai ||4||24||
13.e: But O King! Without the remembrance of the Name of the Lord, all this is of no account, being without an iota of the Grace of the Lord. 4.24.

13.g: ਸੱੁਧ ਸਿਪਾਹ ਦੁਰੰਤ ਦੁਬਾਹ ਸੁ ਸਾਜ ਸਨਾਹ ਦੁਰਜਾਨ ਦਲੈਂਗੇ ॥
13.t: sa'udh sipaeh dhura(n)t dhubaeh su saaj sanaeh dhurajaan dhalai(n)ge ||
13.e: The trained soldiers, mightly and invincible, clad in coat of mail, who would be able to crush the enemies.

13.g: ਭਾਰੀ ਗੁਮਾਨ ਭਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੈਂ ਕਰ ਪਰਬਤ ਪੰਖ ਹਲੇ ਨ ਹਲੈਂਗੇ ॥
13.t: bhaaree gumaan bhare man mai(n) kar parabat pa(n)kh hale na halai(n)ge ||
13.e: With great ego in their mind that they would not be vanquished even if the mountains move with wings.

13.g: ਤੋਰਿ ਅਰੀਨ ਮਰੋਰਿ ਮਵਾਸਨ ਮਾਤੇ ਮਤੰਗਨ ਮਾਨ ਮਲੈਂਗੇ ॥
13.t: tor areen maror mavaasan maate mata(n)gan maan malai(n)ge ||
13.e: They would destroy the enemies, twist the rebels and smash the pride of intoxicated elephants.

13.g: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਪਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਭਗਵਾਨ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਜਹਾਨ ਨਿਦਾਨ ਚਲੈਂਗੇ ॥੫॥੨੫॥
13.t: sree pat sree bhagavaan kirapaa bin tiaag jahaan nidhaan chalai(n)ge ||5||25||
13.e: But without the Grace of the Lord-God, they would ultimately leave the world. 5.25.

13.g: ਬੀਰ ਅਪਾਰ ਬਡੇ ਬਰਿਆਰ ਅਬਿਚਾਰਹਿ ਸਾਰ ਕੀ ਧਾਰ ਭਛੱਯਾ ॥
13.t: beer apaar badde bariaar abichaareh saar kee dhaar bhachha'yaa ||
13.e: Innumerable brave and mighty heroes, fearlessly facing the edge of the sword.

13.g: ਤੋਰਤ ਦੇਸ ਮਲਿੰਦ ਮਵਾਸਨ ਮਾਤੇ ਗਜਾਨ ਕੇ ਮਾਨ ਮਲੱਯਾ ॥
13.t: torat dhes mali(n)dh mavaasan maate gajaan ke maan mala'yaa ||
13.e: Conquering the countries, subjugating the rebels and crushing the pride of the intoxicated elephants.

13.g: ਗਾੜ੍ਹੇ ਗੜ੍ਹਾਨ ਕੋ ਤੋੜਨਹਾਰ ਸੁ ਬਾਤਨ ਹੀਂ ਚਕ ਚਾਰ ਲਵੱਯਾ ॥
13.t: gaaRhe gaRhaan ko toRanahaar su baatan hee(n) chak chaar lava'yaa ||
13.e: Capturing the strong forts and conquering all sides with mere threats.

13.g: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਸਭ ਕੋ ਸਿਰਨਾਇਕ ਜਾਚਕ ਅਨੇਕ ਸੁ ਏਕ ਦਿਵੱਯਾ ॥੬॥੨੬॥
13.t: saahib sree sabh ko siranaik jaachak anek su ek dhiva'yaa ||6||26||
13.e: The Lord God is the Cammander of all and is the only Donor, the beggars are many. 6.26.

13.g: ਦਾਨਵ ਦੇਵ ਫਨਿੰਦ ਨਿਸਾਚਰ ਭੂਤ ਭਵਿਖ ਭਵਾਨ ਜਪੈਂਗੇ ॥
13.t: dhaanav dhev fani(n)dh nisaachar bhoot bhavikh bhavaan japai(n)ge ||
13.e: Demons, gods, huge serpents, ghosts, past, present and future would repeat His Name.

13.g: ਜੀਵ ਜਿਤੇ ਜਲ ਮੈ ਥਲ ਮੈ ਪਲ ਹੀ ਪਲ ਮੈ ਸਭ ਥਾਪ ਥਪੈਂਗੇ ॥
13.t: jeev jite jal mai thal mai pal hee pal mai sabh thaap thapai(n)ge ||
13.e: All the creatures in the sea and on land would increase and the heaps of sins would be destroyed.

13.g: ਪੁੰਨ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪਨ ਬਾਢ ਜੈਤ ਧੁਨ ਪਾਪਨ ਕੇ ਬਹੁ ਪੁੰਜ ਖਪੈਂਗੇ ॥
13.t: pu(n)n prataapan baadd jait dhun paapan ke bahu pu(n)j khapai(n)ge ||
13.e: The praises of the glories of virtues would increase and the heaps of sins would be destroyed

13.g: ਸਾਧ ਸਮੂਹ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਫਿਰੈਂ ਜਗ ਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਭੈ ਅਵਿਲੋਕ ਚਪੈਂਗੇ ॥੭॥੨੭॥
13.t: saadh samooh prasa(n)n firai(n) jag satr sabhai avilok chapai(n)ge ||7||27||
13.e: All the saints would wander in the world with bliss and the enemies would be annoyed on seeing them.7.27.

13.g: ਮਾਨਵ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਗਜਿੰਦ੍ਰ ਨਰਾਧਪ ਜੌਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਲੋਕ ਕੋ ਰਾਜ ਕਰੈਂਗੇ ॥
13.t: maanav i(n)dhr gaji(n)dhr naraadhap jauan tiralok ko raaj karai(n)ge ||
13.e: King of men and elephants, emperors who would rule over the three worlds.

13.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਇਸਨਾਨ ਗਜਾਦਿਕ ਦਾਨ ਅਨੇਕ ਸੁਅੰਬਰ ਸਾਜ ਬਰੈਂਗੇ ॥
13.t: koT isanaan gajaadhik dhaan anek sua(n)bar saaj barai(n)ge ||
13.e: Who would perform millions of ablutions, give elephants and other animals in charity and arrange many svayyamuaras (self-marriage functions) for weddings.

13.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਮਹੇਸਰ ਬਿਸਨ ਸਚੀਪਤਿ ਅੰਤ ਫਸੇ ਜਮ ਫਾਸ ਪਰੈਂਗੇ ॥
13.t: braham mahesar bisan sacheepat a(n)t fase jam faas parai(n)ge ||
13.e: Brahma, Shiva, Vishnu and Consort of Sachi (Indra) would ultimately fall in the noose of death.

13.g: ਜੇ ਨਰ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਪਤਿ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਸ ਹੈਂ ਪਗ ਤੇ ਨਰ ਫੇਰ ਨ ਦੇਹ ਧਰੈਂਗੇ ॥੮॥੨੮॥
13.t: je nar sree pat ke pras hai(n) pag te nar fer na dheh dharai(n)ge ||8||28||
13.e: But those who fall at the feet of Lord-God, they would not appear again in physical form. 8.28.

13.g: ਕਹਾ ਭਯੋ ਜੋ ਦੋਊ ਲੋਚਨ ਮੂੰਦ ਕੈ ਬੈਠਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਬਕ ਧਿਆਨ ਲਗਾਇਓ ॥
13.t: kahaa bhayo jo dhouoo lochan moo(n)dh kai baiTh rahio bak dhiaan lagaio ||
13.e: Of what use it is if one sits and meditates like a crane with his eyes closed.

13.g: ਨ੍ਹਾਤ ਫਿਰਿਓ ਲੀਏ ਸਾਤ ਸਮੁਦ੍ਰਨਿ ਲੋਕ ਗਯੋ ਪਰਲੋਕ ਗਵਾਇਓ ॥
13.t: nhaat firio le'ee saat samudhran lok gayo paralok gavaio ||
13.e: If he takes bath at holy places upto the seventh sea, he loses this world and also the next world.

13.g: ਬਾਸ ਕੀਓ ਬਿਖਿਆਨ ਸੋਂ ਬੈਠ ਕੈ ਐਸੇ ਹੀ ਐਸੇ ਸੁ ਬੈਸ ਬਿਤਾਇਓ ॥
13.t: baas keeo bikhiaan so(n) baiTh kai aaise hee aaise su bais bitaio ||
13.e: He spends his life in such performing evil actions and wastes his life in such pursuits.

13.g: ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹੋਂ ਸੁਨ ਲੇਹੁ ਸਭੈ ਜਿਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੀਓ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਓ ॥੯॥੨੯॥
13.t: saach kaho(n) sun leh sabhai jin prem keeo tin hee prabh paio ||9||29||
13.e: I speak Truth, all should turn their ears towards it: he, who is absorbed in True Love, he would realize the Lord. 9.29.

13.g: ਕਾਹੂ ਲੈ ਪਾਹਨ ਪੂਜ ਧਰਯੋ ਸਿਰ ਕਾਹੂ ਲੈ ਲਿੰਗੁ ਗਰੇ ਲਟਕਾਇਓ ॥
13.t: kaahoo lai paahan pooj dharayo sir kaahoo lai li(n)g gare laTakaio ||
13.e: Someone worshipped stone and placed it on his head. Someone hung the phallus (lingam) from his neck.

13.g: ਕਾਹੂ ਲਖਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਅਵਾਚੀ ਦਿਸਾ ਮਹਿ ਕਾਹੂ ਪਛਾਹ ਕੋ ਸੀਸੁ ਨਿਵਾਇਓ ॥
13.t: kaahoo lakhio har avaachee dhisaa meh kaahoo pachhaeh ko sees nivaio ||
13.e: Someone visualized God in the South and someone bowed his head towards the West.

13.g: ਕੋਊ ਬੁਤਾਨ ਕੋ ਪੂਜਤ ਹੈ ਪਸੁ ਕੋਊ ਮ੍ਰਿਤਾਨ ਕੋ ਪੂਜਨ ਧਾਇਓ ॥
13.t: kouoo butaan ko poojat hai pas kouoo mritaan ko poojan dhaio ||
13.e: Some fool worships the idols and someone goes to worship the dead.

13.g: ਕੂਰ ਕ੍ਰਿਆ ਉਰਝਿਓ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਜਗ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਭਗਵਾਨ ਕੋ ਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ॥੧੦॥੩੦॥
13.t: koor kriaa urajhio sabh hee jag sree bhagavaan ko bhedh na paio ||10||30||
13.e: The whole world is entangled in false rituals and has not known the secret of Lord-God 10.30.
BY THY GRACE. TOMAR STANZA
The Lord is sans birth and death,
He is skiful in all eighteen sciences.
That unblemished Entity is Infinite,
His Benevolent Glory is Everlasting. 1.31.
His Unaffected Entity is All-Pervasive,
He is the Supreme Lord of the saints of all the world.
He is the frontal mark of Glory and life-giver sun of the earth,
He is the Treasure of eighteen sciences. 2.32.
He  the Unblemished Entity is Infinite,
He is the destroyer of sufferings of all the worlds.
He is without the rituals of Iron age,
He is an adept in all religious works. 3.33.
His Glory is Indivisible and Inestimable,
He is the Establisher of all the institutions.
He is Indestructible with Imperishable mysteries,
And the four-handed Brahma sings the Vedas. 4.34.
To Him  the Nigam (Vedas) call “Neti” (Not this),
The four-handed Brahma Speak of Him as Unlimited.
His Glory is Unaffected and Inestimable,
He is Undivided Unlimited and Un-established. 5.35.
He  who hath created the expanse of the world,
He hath Created it in full Consciousness.
His Infinite Form is Indivisible,
His Immeasurable Glory is Powerful 6.36.
He  who hath Created the universe from the Cosmic egg,
He hath Created the fourteen regions.
He hath Created all the expanse of the world,
That Benevolent Lord is Unmanifested. 7.37.
He  who hath Created millions of king Indras,
He hath Created many Brahmas and Vishnus after consideration.
He hath Created many Ramas , Krishnas and Rasuls (Prophets),
None of them is approved by the Lord without devotion. 8.38.
Created many oceans and mountains like Vindhyachal,
Tortoise incarnations and Sheshanagas.
Created many gods , many fish incarnations  and Adi Kumars.,
Sons of Brahma (Sanak  Sanandan , Sanatan and Sant Kumar) , many Krishnas and incarnations of Vishnu.9.39.
Many Indras sweep at His door,
Many Vedas and four-headed Brahmas are there.
Many Rudras (Shivas) of ghastly appearance are there,
Many unique Ramas and Krishnas are there. 10.40.
Many poets compose poetry there,
Many speak of the distinction of the knowledge of Vedas.
Many elucideate Shastras and Smritis,
Many hold discourses of Puranas. 11.41.
Many perform Agnihotras (fire-worship),
Many perform arduous austerities while standing.
Many are ascetics with raised arms and many are anchorities,
Many are in the garbs of Yogis and Udasis (stoics). 12.42.
Many perform Neoli rituals of Yogis of purging intestines,
There are innumerable who subsist on air.
Many offer great charities at pilgrim-stations. ,
Benevolent sacrificial rituals are performed 13.43.
Somewhere exquisite fire-worship is arranged. ,
Somewhere justice is done with emblem of royalty.
Somewhere ceremonies are performed in accordance with Shastras and Smritis,
Somewhere the performance is antagonistic to Vedic injunctions. 14.44.
Many wander in various countries,
Many stay only at one place.
Somewhere the meditation is performed in water,
Somewhere heat is endured on the body.15.45.
Somewhere some reside in the forest,
Somewhere heat is endured on the body.
Somewhere many follow the householder’s path,
Somewhere many followed.16.46.
Somewhere people are without ailment and illusion,
Somewhere forbidden actions are being done.
Somewhere there are Sheikhs,  somewhere there are Brahmins
Somewhere there is the prevalence of unique politics.17.47.
Somewhere someone is without suffering and ailment,
Somewhere someone follows the path of devotion closely.
Somewhere someone is poor and someone a prince,
Somewhere someone is incarnation of Ved Vyas. 18.48.
Some Brahmins recite Vedas,
Some Sheikhs repeat the Name of the Lord.
Somewhere there is a follower of the path of Bairag (detachment) ,
And somewhere one follows the path of Sannyas (asceticism),somewhere someone wanders as an Udasi (stoic).19.49.
Know all the Karmas (actions) as useless,
Consider all the religious paths of no value.
Without the prop of the only Name of the Lord,
All the Karmas be considered as illusion.20.50.
BY THY GRACE. LAGHUU NIRAAJ STANZA
The Lord is in water!
The Lord is on land!
The Lord is in the heart!
The Lord is in the forests! 1. 51.
The Lord is in the mountains!
The Lord is in the cave!
The Lord is in the earth!
The Lord is in the sky! 2. 52.
The Lord is in here!
The Lord is there!
The Lord is in the earth!
The Lord is in the sky! 3. 53.
The Lord is Accountless!
The Lord is guiseless!
The Lord is blemishless!
The Lord is without duality! 4. 54.
The Lord is timeless!
The Lord does not need to be nurtured!
The Lord is Indestructible!
The Lord’s secrets cannot be known! 5. 55.
The Lord is not in mystical digrams!
The Lord is not in incantations!
The Lord is a bright light!
The Lord is not in Tantras (magical formulas)! 6. 56.
The Lord does not take birth!
The Lord does not experience death!
The Lord is without any friend!
The Lord is without a mother! 7. 57.
The Lord is without any ailment!
The Lord is without grief!
The Lord is Illusionless!
The Lord is Actionless!! 8. 58.
The Lord is Unconquerable!
The Lord is Fearless!
The Lord’s secrets cannot be known!
The Lord is Unassailable! 9. 59.
The Lord is Indivisible!
The Lord cannot be slandered!
The Lord cannot be punished!
The Lord is Supremenly Glorious! 10. 60.
The Lord is extremely Great!
The Lord’s mystery cannot be known!
The Lord needs no food!
The Lord is Invincible! 11. 61.
Meditate on the Lord!
Worship the Lord!
Perform devotion for the Lord!
Repeat the Name of the lord! 12. 62.
(Lord,) You are the water!
(Lord,) You are the dry land!
(Lord,) You are the stream!
(Lord,) You are the ocean!
(Lord,) You are the tree!
(Lord,) You are the leaf!
(Lord,) You are the earth!
(Lord,) You are the sky! 14. 64.
(Lord,) I meditate on you!
(Lord,) I meditate on you!
(Lord,) I repeat Your Name!
(Lord,) I intuitively remember you! 15. 65.
(Lord,) You are the earth!
(Lord,) You are the sky!
(Lord,) You are the Landlord!
(Lord,) You are the house itself! 16. 66.
(Lord,) You are birthless!
(Lord,) You are Fearless!
(Lord,) You are Untouchable!
(Lord,) You are Invincible! 17. 67.
(Lord,) You are the definition of celibacy!
(Lord,) You are the means for a virtuous deed!
(Lord,) You are salvation!
(Lord,) You are Redemption! 18. 68.
(Lord,) You are! You are!

14.g: ਤ੍ਵ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥ ਕਬਿੱਤੁ ॥
14.t: tavai prasaadh || kabi't ||
14.e: BY THY GRACE KABITT

14.g: ਖੂਕ ਮਲਹਾਰੀ ਗਜ ਗਦਾਹਾ ਬਿਭੂਤਧਾਰੀ ਗਿਦੂਆ ਮਸਾਨ ਬਾਸ ਕਰਿਓ ਈ ਕਰਤ ਹੈਂ ॥
14.t: khook malahaaree gaj gadhaahaa bibhootadhaaree gidhooaa masaan baas kario iee karat hai(n) ||
14.e: If the Lord is realized by eating filth, by besmearing the body with ashes and by residing in he cremation-ground, then the hog eats filth, the elephant and ass get their bodies filled with ashes and the bager resides in the cremation-ground.

14.g: ਘੁਘੂ ਮਟਬਾਸੀ ਲਗੇ ਡੋਲਤ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਤਰਵਰ ਸਦੀਵ ਮੋਨ ਸਾਧੇ ਈ ਮਰਤ ਹੈਂ ॥
14.t: ghughoo maTabaasee lage ddolat udhaasee mirag taravar sadheev mon saadhe iee marat hai(n) ||
14.e: If the Lord meets in the cloister of mendicants, by wandering like a stoic and abiding in silence, then the owl lives in the cloister of mendicants, the deer wanders like a stoic and the tree abides in silence till death.

14.g: ਬਿੰਦ ਕੇ ਸਧੱਯਾ ਤਾਹਿ ਹੀਜ ਕੀ ਬਡੱਯਾ ਦੇਤ ਬੰਦਰਾ ਸਦੀਵ ਪਾਇ ਨਾਗੇ ਈ ਫਿਰਤ ਹੈਂ ॥
14.t: bi(n)dh ke sadha'yaa taeh heej kee badda'yaa dhet ba(n)dharaa sadheev pai naage iee firat hai(n) ||
14.e: If the Lord is realized by restraining the emission of semen and by wandering with bare feet, then a eunuch may be eulogized for restraining the emission of semen and the monkey always wanders with bare feet.

14.g: ਅੰਗਨਾ ਅਧੀਨ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰਬੀਨ ਏਕ ਗਿਆਨ ਕੇ ਬਿਹੀਨ ਛੀਨ ਕੈਸੇ ਕੈ ਤਰਤ ਹੈਂ ॥੧॥੭੧॥
14.t: a(n)ganaa adheen kaam krodh mai prabeen ek giaan ke biheen chheen kaise kai tarat hai(n) ||1||71||
14.e: One who is under the control of a woman and whou is active in lust and anger and also who is ignorant of the Knowledge of the ONE LORD, how can such person ferry across the world-ocean? 1.71.

14.g: ਭੂਤ ਬਨਚਾਰੀ ਛਿਤ ਛਉਨਾ ਸਭੈ ਦੂਧਾਧਾਰੀ ਪਉਨ ਕੇ ਅਹਾਰੀ ਸੁ ਭੁਜੰਗ ਜਾਨੀਅਤੁ ਹੈਂ ॥
14.t: bhoot banachaaree chhit chhaunaa sabhai dhoodhaadhaaree paun ke ahaaree su bhuja(n)g jaaneeat hai(n) ||
14.e: If the Lord is realized by wandering in the forest, by drinking only the milk and by subsisting on air, then the ghost wanders in the forest, all the infants live on milk and the serpents subsist on air.

14.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਣ ਕੇ ਭਛੱਯਾ ਧਨ ਲੋਭ ਕੇ ਤਜੱਯਾ ਤੇ ਤੋ ਗਊਅਨ ਕੇ ਜੱਯਾ ਬ੍ਰਿਖਭੱਯਾ ਮਾਨੀਅਤੁ ਹੈਂ ॥
14.t: tiran ke bhachha'yaa dhan lobh ke taja'yaa te to guooan ke ja'yaa birakhabha'yaa maaneeat hai(n) ||
14.e: If the Lord meets by eating grass and forsaking the gred of wealth, then the Bulls, the young ones of cows do that.

14.g: ਨਭ ਕੇ ਉਡੱਯਾ ਤਾਹਿ ਪੰਛੀ ਕੀ ਬਡੱਯਾ ਦੇਤ ਬਗੁਲਾ ਬਿੜਾਲ ਬ੍ਰਿਕ ਧਿਆਨੀ ਠਾਨੀਅਤੁ ਹੈਂ ॥
14.t: nabh ke udda'yaa taeh pa(n)chhee kee badda'yaa dhet bagulaa biRaal birak dhiaanee Thaaneeat hai(n) ||
14.e: If the Lord is realized by flying in the sky and by closing the eyes in meditation, then the birds fly in the sky and those who close their eyes in meditation are considered like crane, cat and wolf.

14.g: ਜੇਤੋ ਬਡੇ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਤਿਨੋ ਜਾਨੀ ਪੈ ਬਖਾਨੀ ਨਾਹਿ ਐਸੇ ਨ ਪ੍ਰਪੰਚ ਮਨਿ ਭੂਲਿ ਆਨੀਅਤੁ ਹੈਂ ॥੨॥੭੨॥
14.t: jeto badde giaanee tino jaanee pai bakhaanee naeh aaise na prapa(n)ch man bhool aaneeat hai(n) ||2||72||
14.e: All the Knowers of Brahman know the reality of these imposters, but I have not related it never bring in your mind such deceitful thoughts even by mistake. 2.72.

14.g: ਭੂਮ ਕੇ ਬਸੱਯਾ ਤਾਹਿ ਭੂਚਰੀ ਕੈ ਜੱਯਾ ਕਹੈ ਨਭ ਕੇ ਉਡੱਯਾ ਸੋ ਚਿਰੱਯਾ ਕੈ ਬਖਾਨੀਐ ॥
14.t: bhoom ke basa'yaa taeh bhoocharee kai ja'yaa kahai nabh ke udda'yaa so chira'yaa kai bakhaaneeaai ||
14.e: He who lives on the earth should be called the young one of white ant and those who fly in the sky may be called sparrows.

14.g: ਫਲ ਕੇ ਭਛੱਯਾ ਤਾਹਿ ਬਾਂਦਰੀ ਕੇ ਜੱਯਾ ਕਹੈ ਆਦਿਸ ਫਿਰੱਯਾ ਤੇ ਤੋ ਭੂਤ ਕੈ ਪਛਾਨੀਐ ॥
14.t: fal ke bhachha'yaa taeh baa(n)dharee ke ja'yaa kahai aadhis fira'yaa te to bhoot kai pachhaaneeaai ||
14.e: They, who eat fruit may be called the young ones of monkeys, those who wander invisibly, may be considered as ghosts.

14.g: ਜਲ ਕੇ ਤਰੱਯਾ ਕੋ ਗੰਗੇਰੀ ਸੀ ਕਹਤ ਜਗ ਆਗ ਕੇ ਭਛੱਯਾ ਸੋ ਚਕੋਰ ਸਮ ਮਾਨੀਐ ॥
14.t: jal ke tara'yaa ko ga(n)geree see kahat jag aag ke bhachha'yaa so chakor sam maaneeaai ||
14.e: One, who swims on water is called water-fly by the world one, who eats fire, may be considered like Chakor (redlegged partridge).

14.g: ਸੂਰਜ ਸਿਵੱਯਾ ਤਾਹਿ ਕੌਲ ਕੀ ਬਡਾਈ ਦੇਤ ਚੰਦ੍ਰਮਾ ਸਿਵੱਯਾ ਕੌ ਕਵੀ ਕੈ ਪਹਿਚਾਨੀਐ ॥੩॥੭੩॥
14.t: sooraj siva'yaa taeh kaual kee baddaiee dhet cha(n)dhramaa siva'yaa kau kavee kai pahichaaneeaai ||3||73||
14.e: One who worships the sun, may be symbolized as lotus and one, who worships the moon may be recognized as water-lily (The lotus blooms on seeing the sun and the water-lily blossoms on seeing the moon). 3.73.

14.g: ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਕੱਛ ਮੱਛ ਤਿੰਦੂਆ ਕਹਤ ਸਭ ਕਉਲ ਨਾਭ ਕਉਲ ਜਿਹ ਤਾਲ ਮੈਂ ਰਹਤੁ ਹੈਂ ॥
14.t: naarain ka'chh ma'chh ti(n)dhooaa kahat sabh kaul naabh kaul jeh taal mai(n) rahat hai(n) ||
14.e: If the Name of the Lord is Narayana (One whose house is in water), then Kachh (tortoise incarnation), Machh (fish incarnation) and Tandooaa (octopus) will be called Naryana and if the Name of the Lord is Kaul-Naabh (Navel-lotus), then the tank in which th

14.g: ਗੋਪੀ ਨਾਥ ਗੂਜਰ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਸਭੈ ਧੇਨਚਾਰੀ ਰਿਖੀਕੇਸ ਨਾਮ ਕੈ ਮਹੰਤ ਲਹੀਅਤੁ ਹੈਂ ॥
14.t: gopee naath goojar gupaal sabhai dhenachaaree rikheekes naam kai maha(n)t laheeat hai(n) ||
14.e: If the Name of the Lord is Gopi Nath, then the Lord of Gopi is a cowherd if the Name of the Lord is GOPAL, the Sustainer of cows, then all the cowherds are Dhencharis (the Graziers of cows) if the Name of the Lord is Rikhikes, then there are several chief

14.g: ਮਾਧਵ ਭਵਰ ਔ ਅਟੇਰੂ ਕੋ ਕਨ੍ਹਯਾ ਨਾਮ ਕੰਸ ਕੇ ਬਧੱਯਾ ਜਮਦੂਤ ਕਹੀਅਤੁ ਹੈਂ ॥
14.t: maadhav bhavar aau aTeroo ko kanhayaa naam ka(n)s ke badha'yaa jamadhoot kaheeat hai(n) ||
14.e: If the Name of Lord is Madhva, then the black bee is also called Madhva if the Name of the Lord is Kanhaya, then the spider is also called Kanhaya if the Name of he Lord is the "Slayer of Kansa," then the messenger of Yama, who slayed Kansa, may be called

14.g: ਮੂੜ੍ਹ ਰੂੜ੍ਹ ਪੀਟਤ ਨ ਗੂੜ੍ਹਤਾ ਕੋ ਭੇਦ ਪਾਵੈ ਪੂਜਤ ਨ ਤਾਹਿ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਰਾਖੇ ਰਹੀਅਤੁ ਹੈਂ ॥੪॥੭੪॥
14.t: mooRh rooRh peeTat na gooRhataa ko bhedh paavai poojat na taeh jaa ke raakhe raheeat hai(n) ||4||74||
14.e: The foolish people wail and weep. But do not know the profound secret, therefore they do not worship Him, who protects our life. 4.74.

14.g: ਬਿਸ੍ਵਪਾਲ ਜਗਤ ਕਾਲ ਦੀਨ ਦਿਆਲ ਬੈਰੀ ਸਾਲ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਪਾਲ ਜਮ ਜਾਲ ਤੇ ਰਹਤ ਹੈਂ ॥
14.t: bisavaipaal jagat kaal dheen dhiaal bairee saal sadhaa pratapaal jam jaal te rahat hai(n) ||
14.e: The Sustainer and Destroyer of the Universe is Benevolent towards the poor, tortures the enemies, preserves ever and is without the snare of death.

14.g: ਜੋਗੀ ਜਟਾਧਾਰੀ ਸਤੀ ਸਾਚੇ ਬਡੇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਚਾਰੀ ਧਿਆਨ ਕਾਜ ਭੂਖ ਪਿਆਸ ਦੇਹ ਪੈ ਸਹਤ ਹੈਂ ॥
14.t: jogee jaTaadhaaree satee saache badde brahamachaaree dhiaan kaaj bhookh piaas dheh pai sahat hai(n) ||
14.e: The Yogis, hermits with matted locks, true donors and great celibates, for a Sight of Him, endure hunger and thirst on their bodies.

14.g: ਨਿਉਲੀ ਕਰਮ ਜਲ ਹੋਮ ਪਾਵਕ ਪਵਨ ਹੋਮ ਅਧੋ ਮੁਖ ਏਕ ਪਾਇ ਠਾਢੇ ਨ ਬਹਤ ਹੈਂ ॥
14.t: niaulee karam jal hom paavak pavan hom adho mukh ek pai Thaadde na bahat hai(n) ||
14.e: For a Sight of Him, the intestines are purged, offerings are made to water, fire and air, austerities are performed with face upside down and standing on a single foot.

14.g: ਮਾਨਵ ਫਨਿੰਦ ਦੇਵ ਦਾਨਵ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਭੇਦ ਬੇਦ ਔ ਕਤੇਬ ਨੇਤ ਨੇਤ ਕੈ ਕਹਤ ਹੈਂ ॥੫॥੭੫॥
14.t: maanav fani(n)dh dhev dhaanav na paavai bhedh bedh aau kateb net net kai kahat hai(n) ||5||75||
14.e: The men, Sheshanaga, gods and demons have not been able to know His Secret and the Vedas and Katebs (Semitic Scriptures) speak of Him as “Neti, Neti” (Not this, Not this) and Infinite. 5.75.

14.g: ਨਾਚਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਮੋਰ ਬਾਦਰ ਕਰਤ ਘੋਰ ਦਾਮਨੀ ਅਨੇਕ ਭਾਉ ਕਰਿਓ ਈ ਕਰਤ ਹੈ ॥
14.t: naachat firat mor baadhar karat ghor dhaamanee anek bhaau kario iee karat hai ||
14.e: If the Lord is realized by devotional dancing, then the peacocks dance with the thundering of the clouds and if the Lord gets pleased on seeing the devotion through friendliness, then the lightning performs it by various flashes.

14.g: ਚੰਦ੍ਰਮਾ ਤੇ ਸੀਤਲ ਨ ਸੂਰਜ ਕੇ ਤਪਤ ਤੇਜ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਸੋ ਨ ਰਾਜਾ ਭਵ ਭੂਮ ਕੋ ਭਰਤ ਹੈ ॥
14.t: cha(n)dhramaa te seetal na sooraj ke tapat tej i(n)dhr so na raajaa bhav bhoom ko bharat hai ||
14.e: If the Lord meets by adopting coolness and serenity, then there is none cooler than the moon if the Lord meets by the endurance of heat, then none is hotter than the sun, and if the Lord is realized by the munificence, then none is more munificent than In

14.g: ਸਿਵ ਸੇ ਤਪਸੀ ਆਦਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਸੇ ਨ ਬੇਦਚਾਰੀ ਸਨਤ ਕੁਮਾਰ ਸੀ ਤਪੱਸਿਆ ਨ ਅਨਤ ਹੈ ॥
14.t: siv se tapasee aadh brahamaa se na bedhachaaree sanat kumaar see tapa'siaa na anat hai ||
14.e: If the Lord is realised by the practice of austerities, then none is more austere than god Shiva if the Lord meets by the recitation of Vedas, then none is more conversant with the Vedas than the god Brahma: there is also no great performer of asceticism

14.g: ਗਿਆਨ ਕੇ ਬਿਹੀਨ ਕਾਲ ਫਾਸ ਕੇ ਅਧੀਨ ਸਦਾ ਜੁੱਗਨ ਕੀ ਚਉਕਰੀ ਫਿਰਾਏ ਈ ਫਿਰਤ ਹੈ ॥੬॥੭੬॥
14.t: giaan ke biheen kaal faas ke adheen sadhaa ju'gan kee chaukaree firaae iee firat hai ||6||76||
14.e: The persons without the Knowledge of the Lord, entrapped in the snare of death always transmigrate in all the four ages. 6.76.

14.g: ਏਕ ਸਿਵ ਭਏ ਏਕ ਗਏ ਏਕ ਫੇਰ ਭਏ ਰਾਮਚੰਦ੍ਰ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਕੇ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਭੀ ਅਨੇਕ ਹੈਂ ॥
14.t: ek siv bhe ek ge ek fer bhe raamacha(n)dhr kirasan ke avataar bhee anek hai(n) ||
14.e: There was one Shiva, who passed away and another one came into being there are many incarnations of Ramchandra and Krishna.

14.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਅਰੁ ਬਿਸਨ ਕੇਤੇ ਬੇਦ ਔ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਕੇਤੇ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਮੂਹਨ ਕੈ ਹੁਇ ਹੁਇ ਬਿਤਏ ਹੈਂ ॥
14.t: brahamaa ar bisan kete bedh aau puraan kete si(n)mirat samoohan kai hui hui bite hai(n) ||
14.e: There are many Brahmas and Vishnus, there are many Vedas and Puranas, there have been the authors of all the Smritis, who created their works and passed away.

14.g: ਮੋਨਦੀ ਮਦਾਰ ਕੇਤੇ ਅਸੁਨੀ ਕੁਮਾਰ ਕੇਤੇ ਅੰਸਾ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਕੇਤੇ ਕਾਲ ਬਸ ਭਏ ਹੈਂ ॥
14.t: monadhee madhaar kete asunee kumaar kete a(n)saa avataar kete kaal bas bhe hai(n) ||
14.e: Many religious leaders, many chieftains of clans, many Ashwani Kumars and many degrees of incarnations, they had all been subject to death.

14.g: ਪੀਰ ਔ ਪਿਕਾਂਬਰ ਕੇਤੇ ਗਨੇ ਨ ਪਰਤ ਏਤੇ ਭੂਮ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਹੁਇ ਕੈ ਫੇਰਿ ਭੂਮਿ ਹੀ ਮਿਲਏ ਹੈਂ ॥੭॥੭੭॥
14.t: peer aau pikaa(n)bar kete gane na parat ete bhoom hee te hui kai fer bhoom hee mile hai(n) ||7||77||
14.e: Many Muslim preceptors (Pirs) and Prophets, who cannot be count ed, they were born out of the earth, ultimately merged in the earth. 7.77.

14.g: ਜੋਗੀ ਜਤੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਚਾਰੀ ਬਡੇ ਬਡੇ ਛਤ੍ਰਧਾਰੀ ਛਤ੍ਰ ਹੀ ਕੀ ਛਾਇਆ ਕਈ ਕੋਸ ਲੌ ਚਲਤ ਹੈਂ ॥
14.t: jogee jatee brahamachaaree badde badde chhatradhaaree chhatr hee kee chhaiaa kiee kos lau chalat hai(n) ||
14.e: The Yougis, celibates and students observing celibacy, many great sovereigns, who walk several miles under the shade of canopy.

14.g: ਬਡੇ ਬਡੇ ਰਾਜਨ ਕੇ ਦਾਬਤਿ ਫਿਰਤਿ ਦੇਸ ਬਡੇ ਬਡੇ ਰਾਜਨ ਕੇ ਦ੍ਰਪ ਕੋ ਦਲਤੁ ਹੈਂ ॥
14.t: badde badde raajan ke dhaabat firat dhes badde badde raajan ke dhrap ko dhalat hai(n) ||
14.e: Who conquer the countries of many great kings and bruise their ego.

14.g: ਮਾਨ ਸੇ ਮਹੀਪ ਔ ਦਿਲੀਪ ਕੈਸੇ ਛਤ੍ਰਧਾਰੀ ਬਡੋ ਅਭਿਮਾਨ ਭੁਜ ਦੰਡ ਕੋ ਕਰਤ ਹੈਂ ॥
14.t: maan se maheep aau dhileep kaise chhatradhaaree baddo abhimaan bhuj dha(n)dd ko karat hai(n) ||
14.e: The Sovereign like Mandhata and the Canopied Sovereign like Dalip, who were proud of their mightly forces.

14.g: ਦਾਰਾ ਸੇ ਦਿਲੀਸਰ ਦ੍ਰੁਜੋਧਨ ਸੇ ਮਾਨਧਾਰੀ ਭੋਗ ਭੋਗ ਭੂਮਿ ਅੰਤ ਭੂਮਿ ਮੈ ਮਿਲਤ ਹੈਂ ॥੮॥੭੮॥
14.t: dhaaraa se dhileesar dhrujodhan se maanadhaaree bhog bhog bhoom a(n)t bhoom mai milat hai(n) ||8||78||
14.e: The emperor like Darius and the great egoist like Duryodhana, after enjoying the earthly pleasures, finally merged in the earth.8.78.

14.g: ਸਿਜਦੇ ਕਰੇ ਅਨੇਕ ਤੋਪਚੀ ਕਪਟ ਭੇਸ ਪੋਸਤੀ ਅਨੇਕ ਦਾ ਨਿਵਾਵਤ ਹੈ ਸੀਸ ਕੌ ॥
14.t: sijadhe kare anek topachee kapaT bhes posatee anek dhaa nivaavat hai sees kau ||
14.e: If the Lord is pleased by prostrating before Him, then the gunner full of deceit bows his head several times while igniting the gun and the addict acts in the same manner in intoxication.

14.g: ਕਹਾ ਭਇਓ ਮੱਲ ਜੌ ਪੈ ਕਾਢਤ ਅਨੇਕ ਡੰਡ ਸੋ ਤੌ ਨ ਡੰਡੌਤ ਅਸਟਾਂਗ ਅਥਤੀਸ ਕੌ ॥
14.t: kahaa bhio ma'l jau pai kaaddat anek dda(n)dd so tau na dda(n)ddauat asaTaa(n)g athatees kau ||
14.e: What, then, if the wrestler bends his body several times during his rehearsal of exercises, but that is not the prostration of eight parts of the body.

14.g: ਕਹਾ ਭਇਓ ਰੋਗੀ ਜੌ ਪੈ ਡਾਰਿਓ ਰਹਿਓ ਉਰਧ ਮੁਖ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਨ ਮੂੰਡ ਨਿਹਰਾਇਓ ਆਦਿ ਈਸ ਕੌ ॥
14.t: kahaa bhio rogee jau pai ddaario rahio uradh mukh man te na moo(n)dd niharaio aadh iees kau ||
14.e: What, then, if the patient lies down with his face upwards, he has not bowed his head before the Primal Lord with single-mindedness.

14.g: ਕਾਮਨਾ ਅਧੀਨ ਸਦਾ ਦਾਮਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਬੀਨ ਏਕ ਭਾਵਨਾ ਬਿਹੀਨ ਕੈਸੇ ਪਾਵੈ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਕੌ ॥੯॥੭੯॥
14.t: kaamanaa adheen sadhaa dhaamanaa prabeen ek bhaavanaa biheen kaise paavai jagadhees kau ||9||79||
14.e: But one always subservient to desire and active in telling the beads of the rosary, and also without faith, how can he realize the Lord of the world? 9.79.

14.g: ਸੀਸ ਪਟਕਤ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਕਾਨ ਮੈ ਖਜੂਰਾ ਧਸੈ ਮੂੰਡ ਛਟਕਤ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਹੂੰ ਕੇ ਸੋਕ ਸੌ ॥
14.t: sees paTakat jaa ke kaan mai khajooraa dhasai moo(n)dd chhaTakat mitr putr hoo(n) ke sok sau ||
14.e: If the Lord is realized by knocking the head, then that person repeatedly knocks his head, in whose ear the centipede enters and if the Lord meets by beating the head, then one beats his head in grief over the death of friends or sons.

14.g: ਆਕ ਕੋ ਚਰੱਯਾ ਫਲ ਫੂਲ ਕੋ ਭਛੱਯਾ ਸਦਾ ਬਨ ਕੌ ਭ੍ਰਮੱਯਾ ਔਰ ਦੂਸਰੋ ਨ ਬੋਕ ਸੌ ॥
14.t: aak ko chara'yaa fal fool ko bhachha'yaa sadhaa ban kau bhrama'yaa aauar dhoosaro na bok sau ||
14.e: If the Lord is realized by wandering in the forest, then there is none other like the he-goat, who grazes the akk (Calotropis Procera), eats the flowers and fruit and always wanders in the forest.

14.g: ਕਹਾ ਭਯੋ ਭੇਡ ਜਉ ਘਸੱਤ ਸੀਸ ਬ੍ਰਿਛੱਨ ਸੋਂ ਮਾਟੀ ਕੋ ਭਛੱਯਾ ਬੋਲ ਪੂਛ ਲੀਜੈ ਜੋਕ ਸੌ ॥
14.t: kahaa bhayo bhedd jau ghasa't sees birachha'n so(n) maaTee ko bhachha'yaa bol poochh leejai jok sau ||
14.e: If the Lord meets by rubbing the head with the trees in order to remove drowsiness, then the sheep always rubs its head with the trees and if the Lord meets by eating the earth, then you can ask the leech.

14.g: ਕਾਮਨਾ ਅਧੀਨ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਮੈਂ ਪ੍ਰਬੀਨ ਏਕ ਭਾਵਨਾ ਬਿਹੀਨ ਕੈਸੇ ਭੇਟੈ ਪਰਲੋਕ ਸੌ ॥੧੦॥੮੦॥
14.t: kaamanaa adheen kaam krodh mai(n) prabeen ek bhaavanaa biheen kaise bheTai paralok sau ||10||80||
14.e: How can one meet the Lord in the next world, who is subservient to desire, active in lust and anger and without faith? 10.80.

14.g: ਨਾਚਿਓ ਈ ਕਰਤ ਮੋਰ ਦਾਦਰ ਕਰਤ ਸੋਰ ਸਦਾ ਘਨਘੋਰ ਘਨ ਕਰਿਓ ਈ ਕਰਤ ਹੈਂ ॥
14.t: naachio iee karat mor dhaadhar karat sor sadhaa ghanaghor ghan kario iee karat hai(n) ||
14.e: If the Lord is realised by dancing and shouting, then pecock dances, the frog croaks and the clouds thunder.

14.g: ਏਕ ਪਾਇ ਠਾਢੇ ਸਦਾ ਬਨ ਮੈ ਰਹਤ ਬ੍ਰਿਛ ਫੂਕ ਫੂਕ ਪਾਵ ਭੂਮ ਸ੍ਰਾਵਗ ਧਰਤ ਹੈਂ ॥
14.t: ek pai Thaadde sadhaa ban mai rahat birachh fook fook paav bhoom sraavag dharat hai(n) ||
14.e: If the Lord meets by standing on one leg, then the tree stands on one foot in the forest, and if the Lord meets on observing non-violence, then the Sravak (aina monk) places his feet very cautiously on the earth.

14.g: ਪਾਹਨ ਅਨੇਕ ਜੁਗ ਏਕ ਠਉਰ ਬਾਸੁ ਕਰੈ ਕਾਗ ਅਉਰ ਚੀਲ ਦੇਸ ਦੇਸ ਬਿਚਰਤ ਹੈਂ ॥
14.t: paahan anek jug ek Thaur baas karai kaag aaur cheel dhes dhes bicharat hai(n) ||
14.e: If the Lord is realised by not moving from one place or by wandering, then the stone remains at one place for many ages and the crow and kite continue wandering in several countries.

14.g: ਗਿਆਨ ਕੇ ਬਿਹੀਨ ਮਹਾ ਦਾਨ ਮੈ ਨ ਹੂਜੈ ਲੀਨ ਭਾਵਨਾ ਯਕੀਨ ਦੀਨ ਕੈਸੇ ਕੈ ਤਰਤ ਹੈਂ ॥੧੧॥੮੧॥
14.t: giaan ke biheen mahaa dhaan mai na hoojai leen bhaavanaa yakeen dheen kaise kai tarat hai(n) ||11||81||
14.e: When a person without knowledge cannot merge in the Supreme Lorrd, then how can these devoid of trust and faith ferry across the world-ocean?11.81.

15.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਏਕ ਸ੍ਵਾਂਗੀ ਕਹੂੰ ਜੋਗੀਆ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਬਨੈ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਸਨਿਆਸ ਭੇਸ ਬਨ ਕੈ ਦਿਖਾਵਈ ॥
15.t: jaise ek savaiaa(n)gee kahoo(n) jogeeaa bairaagee banai kabahoo(n) saniaas bhes ban kai dhikhaaviee ||
15.e: Just as an actor sometimes becomes a Yogi, sometimes a Bairagi (recluse) and sometimes shows himself in the guise of a Sannyasi (mendicant).

15.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਪਉਨਹਾਰੀ ਕਹੂੰ ਬੈਠੇ ਲਾਇ ਤਾਰੀ ਕਹੂੰ ਲੋਭ ਕੀ ਖੁਮਾਰੀ ਸੌਂ ਅਨੇਕ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਈ ॥
15.t: kahoo(n) paunahaaree kahoo(n) baiThe lai taaree kahoo(n) lobh kee khumaaree saua(n) anek gun gaaviee ||
15.e: Sometimes he becomes a person subsisting on air, sometimes sits observing abstract meditation and sometimes under the intoxication greed, sings praises of many kinds.

15.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਚਾਰੀ ਕਹੂੰ ਹਾਥ ਪੈ ਲਗਾਵੈ ਬਾਰੀ ਕਹੂੰ ਡੰਡ ਧਾਰੀ ਹੁਇ ਕੈ ਲੋਗਨ ਭ੍ਰਮਾਵਈ ॥
15.t: kahoo(n) brahamachaaree kahoo(n) haath pai lagaavai baaree kahoo(n) dda(n)dd dhaaree hui kai logan bhramaaviee ||
15.e: Sometimes he becomes a Brahmchari (student observing celibacy), sometimes shows his promptness and sometimes becoming a staff- bearing hermit deludes the people.

15.g: ਕਾਮਨਾ ਅਧੀਨ ਪਰਿਓ ਨਾਚਤ ਹੈ ਨਾਚਨ ਸੋਂ ਗਿਆਨ ਕੇ ਬਿਹੀਨ ਕੈਸੇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਲੋਕ ਪਾਵਈ ॥੧੨॥੮੨॥
15.t: kaamanaa adheen pario naachat hai naachan so(n) giaan ke biheen kaise braham lok paaviee ||12||82||
15.e: He dances becoming subordinate to passions how will he be able to attain an entry into Lord’s Abode without knowledge?.12.82.

15.g: ਪੰਚ ਬਾਰ ਗੀਦਰ ਪੁਕਾਰੇ ਪਰੇ ਸੀਤਕਾਲ ਕੁੰਚਰ ਔ ਗਦਹਾ ਅਨੇਕਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਹੀਂ ॥
15.t: pa(n)ch baar geedhar pukaare pare seetakaal ku(n)char aau gadhahaa anekadhaa prakaar hee(n) ||
15.e: If the jackal howls for five times, then either the winter sets in or there is famine, but nothing happens if the elephant trumpets and ass brays many times. (Similarly the actions of a knowledgeable person are fruitful and those of an ignorant one are fr

15.g: ਕਹਾ ਭਯੋ ਜੋ ਪੈ ਕਲਵਤ੍ਰ ਲੀਓ ਕਾਂਸੀ ਬੀਚ ਚੀਰ ਚੀਰ ਚੋਰਟਾ ਕੁਠਾਰਨ ਸੋਂ ਮਾਰ ਹੀ ॥
15.t: kahaa bhayo jo pai kalavatr leeo kaa(n)see beech cheer cheer choraTaa kuThaaran so(n) maar hee ||
15.e: If one observes the ritual of sawing at Kashi, nothing will happen, because a chief is slayed and sawed several times with axes.

15.g: ਕਹਾ ਭਯੋ ਫਾਂਸੀ ਡਾਰਿ ਬੂਡਿਓ ਜੜ ਗੰਗ ਧਾਰਿ ਡਾਰਿ ਡਾਰਿ ਫਾਂਸ ਠਗ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਡਾਰ ਹੀਂ ॥
15.t: kahaa bhayo faa(n)see ddaar booddio jaR ga(n)g dhaar ddaar ddaar faa(n)s Thag maar maar ddaar hee(n) ||
15.e: If a fool, with a noose around his neck, is drowned on the current of Ganges, nothing will happen, because several times the dacoits kill the wayfarer by putting the noose around his neck.

15.g: ਡੂਬੇ ਨਰਕ ਧਾਰ ਮੂੜ੍ਹ ਗਿਆਨ ਕੇ ਬਿਨਾ ਬਿਚਾਰ ਭਾਵਨਾ ਬਿਹੀਨ ਕੈਸੇ ਗਿਆਨ ਕੋ ਬਿਚਾਰ ਹੀਂ ॥੧੩॥੮੩॥
15.t: ddoobe narak dhaar mooRh giaan ke binaa bichaar bhaavanaa biheen kaise giaan ko bichaar hee(n) ||13||83||
15.e: The fools have drowned in the current of hell without deliberations of knowledge, because how can a faithless person comprehend the concepts of knowledge?.13.83.

15.g: ਤਾਪ ਕੇ ਸਹੇ ਤੇ ਜੋ ਪੈ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਤਾਪ ਨਾਥ ਤਾਪਨਾ ਅਨੇਕ ਤਨ ਘਾਇਲ ਸਹਤ ਹੈਂ ॥
15.t: taap ke sahe te jo pai paieeaai ataap naath taapanaa anek tan ghail sahat hai(n) ||
15.e: If the Blissful Lord is realised by the endurance of sufferings, then a wounded person endures several types of sufferings on his body.

15.g: ਜਾਪ ਕੇ ਕੀਏ ਤੇ ਜੋ ਪੈ ਪਾਯਤ ਅਜਾਪ ਦੇਵ ਪੂਦਨਾ ਸਦੀਵ ਤੁਹੀਂ ਤੁਹੀਂ ਉਚਰਤ ਹੈਂ ॥
15.t: jaap ke ke'ee te jo pai paayat ajaap dhev poodhanaa sadheev tuhee(n) tuhee(n) ucharat hai(n) ||
15.e: If the unmutterable Lord can be realised by the repetition of His Name, then a small bird called pudana repeats “Tuhi, Tuhi” (Thou art everyting) all the time.

16.g: ਨਭ ਕੇ ਉਡੇ ਤੇ ਜੋ ਪੈ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਪਾਈਯਤ ਅਨਲ ਅਕਾਸ ਪੰਛੀ ਡੋਲਬੋ ਕਰਤ ਹੈਂ ॥
16.t: nabh ke udde te jo pai naarain paieeyat anal akaas pa(n)chhee ddolabo karat hai(n) ||
16.e: If the Lord can be realised by flying in the sky, then the phonix always flies in the sky.

16.g: ਆਗ ਮੈ ਜਰੇ ਤੇ ਗਤਿ ਰਾਂਡ ਕੀ ਪਰਤ ਕਰ ਪਤਾਲ ਕੇ ਬਾਸੀ ਕਿਉ ਭੁਜੰਗ ਨ ਤਰਤ ਹੈਂ ॥੧੪॥੮੪॥
16.t: aag mai jare te gat raa(n)dd kee parat kar pataal ke baasee kiau bhuja(n)g na tarat hai(n) ||14||84||
16.e: If the salvation is attained by burning oneself in fire, then the woman burning herself on the funeral pyre of her husband (Sati) should get salvation and if one achieves liberation by residing in a cave, then why the serpents residing in the nether-world

16.g: ਕੋਊ ਭਇਓ ਮੁੰਡੀਆ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਕੋਊ ਜੋਗੀ ਭਇਓ ਕੋਊ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਚਾਰੀ ਕੋਊ ਜਤੀ ਅਨੁਮਾਨਬੋ ॥
16.t: kouoo bhio mu(n)ddeeaa sa(n)niaasee kouoo jogee bhio kouoo brahamachaaree kouoo jatee anumaanabo ||
16.e: Somebody became a Bairagi (recluse), somebody a Sannyasi (mendicant). Somebody a Yogi, somebody a Brahmchari (student observing celibacy) and someone is considered a celibate.

16.g: ਹਿੰਦੂ ਤੁਰਕ ਕੋਊ ਰਾਫਜੀ ਇਮਾਮ ਸਾਫੀ ਮਾਨਸ ਕੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਸਬੈ ਏਕੈ ਪਹਿਚਾਨਬੋ ॥
16.t: hi(n)dhoo turak kouoo raafajee imaam saafee maanas kee jaat sabai ekai pahichaanabo ||
16.e: Someone is Hindu and someone a Muslim, then someone is Shia, and someone a Sunni, but all the human beings, as a species, are recognized as one and the same.

16.g: ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੀਮ ਸੋਈ ਰਾਜਕ ਰਹੀਮ ਓਈ ਦੂਸਰੋ ਨ ਭੇਦ ਕੋਈ ਭੂਲ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਮਾਨਬੋ ॥
16.t: karataa kareem soiee raajak raheem oiee dhoosaro na bhedh koiee bhool bhram maanabo ||
16.e: Karta (The Creator) and Karim (Merciful) is the same Lord, Razak (The Sustainer) and Rahim (Compassionate) is the same Lord, there is no other second, therefore consider this verbal distinguishing feature of Hindusim and Islam as an error and an illusion.

16.g: ਏਕ ਹੀ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਕੋ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਏਕ ਏਕ ਹੀ ਸਰੂਪ ਸਬੈ ਏਕੈ ਜੋਤ ਜਾਨਬੋ ॥੧੫॥੮੫॥
16.t: ek hee kee sev sabh hee ko gurdhev ek ek hee saroop sabai ekai jot jaanabo ||15||85||
16.e: Thus worship the One Lord, who is the common enlightener of all, who have been created in His Image and amongst all comprehend the same One Light. 15.85.

16.g: ਦੇਹਰਾ ਮਸੀਤ ਸੋਈ ਪੂਜਾ ਔ ਨਿਵਾਜ ਓਈ ਮਾਨਸ ਸਬੈ ਏਕ ਪੈ ਅਨੇਕ ਕੋ ਭ੍ਰਮਾਉ ਹੈ ॥
16.t: dheharaa maseet soiee poojaa aau nivaaj oiee maanas sabai ek pai anek ko bhramaau hai ||
16.e: The temple and the mosque are the same, there is no difference between a Hindu worship and Muslim prayer all the human beings are the same, but the illusion is of various types.

16.g: ਦੇਵਤਾ ਅਦੇਵ ਜੱਛ ਗੰਧ੍ਰਬ ਤੁਰਕ ਹਿੰਦੂ ਨਿਆਰੇ ਨਿਆਰੇ ਦੇਸਨ ਕੇ ਭੇਸ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਉ ਹੈ ॥
16.t: dhevataa adhev ja'chh ga(n)dhrab turak hi(n)dhoo niaare niaare dhesan ke bhes ko prabhaau hai ||
16.e: The gods, demons, Yakshas, Gandharvas, Turks and Hindus… all these are due to the differences of the various garbs of different countries.

17.g: ਏਕੈ ਨੈਨ ਏਕੈ ਕਾਨ ਏਕੈ ਦੇਹ ਏਕੈ ਬਾਨ ਖਾਕ ਬਾਦ ਆਤਸ ਔ ਆਬ ਕੋ ਰਲਾਉ ਹੈ ॥
17.t: ekai nain ekai kaan ekai dheh ekai baan khaak baadh aatas aau aab ko ralaau hai ||
17.e: The eyes are the same, the ears the same, the bodies are the same and the habits are the same, all the creation is the amalgam of earth, air, fire and water.

17.g: ਅਲਹ ਅਭੇਖ ਸੋਈ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਔ ਕੁਰਾਨ ਓਈ ਏਕ ਹੀ ਸਰੂਪ ਸਭੈ ਏਕ ਹੀ ਬਨਾਉ ਹੈ ॥੧੬॥੮੬॥
17.t: aleh abhekh soiee puraan aau kuraan oiee ek hee saroop sabhai ek hee banaau hai ||16||86||
17.e: Allah of Muslims and Abhekh (Guiseless) of Hindus are the same, the Puranas of Hindus and the holy Quran of the Muslims depict the same reality all have been created in the image of the same Lord and have the same formation. 16.86.

17.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਏਕ ਆਗ ਤੇ ਕਨੂਕਾ ਕੋਟ ਆਗ ਉਠੇ ਨਿਆਰੇ ਨਿਆਰੇ ਹੁਇ ਕੈ ਫੇਰਿ ਆਗ ਮੈ ਮਿਲਾਹਿਂਗੇ ॥
17.t: jaise ek aag te kanookaa koT aag uThe niaare niaare hui kai fer aag mai milaahi(n)ge ||
17.e: Just as millions of sparks are created from the fire although they are different entities, they merge in the same fire.

17.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਏਕ ਧੂਰ ਤੇ ਅਨੇਕ ਧੂਰ ਪੂਰਤ ਹੈ ਧੂਰ ਕੇ ਕਨੂਕਾ ਫੇਰ ਧੂਰ ਹੀ ਸਮਾਹਿਂਗੇ ॥
17.t: jaise ek dhoor te anek dhoor poorat hai dhoor ke kanookaa fer dhoor hee samaahi(n)ge ||
17.e: Just as many creatures are born from dirt and eventually become dirt again.

17.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਏਕ ਨਦ ਤੇ ਤਰੰਗ ਕੋਟ ਉਪਜਤ ਹੈਂ ਪਾਨ ਕੇ ਤਰੰਗ ਸਬੈ ਪਾਨ ਹੀ ਕਹਾਹਿਂਗੇ ॥
17.t: jaise ek nadh te tara(n)g koT upajat hai(n) paan ke tara(n)g sabai paan hee kahaahi(n)ge ||
17.e: Just as from of waves are created on the surface of the big rivers and all the waves are called water.

17.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਬਿਸ੍ਵ ਰੂਪ ਤੇ ਅਭੂਤ ਭੂਤ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਹੁਇ ਤਾਹੀ ਤੇ ਉਪਜ ਸਬੈ ਤਾਹੀ ਮੈ ਸਮਾਹਿਂਗੇ ॥੧੭॥੮੭॥
17.t: taise bisavai roop te abhoot bhoot pragaT hui taahee te upaj sabai taahee mai samaahi(n)ge ||17||87||
17.e: Similarly the animate and inanimate objects come out of the Supreme Lord having been created from the same Lord, they merge in the same Lord. 17.87.

17.g: ਕੇਤੇ ਕੱਛ ਮੱਛ ਕੇਤੇ ਉਨ ਕਉ ਕਰਤ ਭੱਛ ਕੇਤੇ ਅੱਛ ਵੱਛ ਹੁਇ ਸਪੱਛ ਉਡ ਜਾਹਿਂਗੇ ॥
17.t: kete ka'chh ma'chh kete un kau karat bha'chh kete a'chh va'chh hui sapa'chh udd jaahi(n)ge ||
17.e: There are many a tortoise and fish and there are many who devour them there are many a winged phoenix, who always continue flying.

17.g: ਕੇਤੇ ਨਭ ਬੀਚ ਅੱਛ ਪੱਛ ਕਉ ਕਰੈਂਗੇ ਭੱਛ ਕੇਤਕ ਪ੍ਰੱਤਛ ਹੁਇ ਪਚਾਇ ਖਾਇ ਜਾਹਿਂਗੇ ॥
17.t: kete nabh beech a'chh pa'chh kau karai(n)ge bha'chh ketak pra'tachh hui pachai khai jaahi(n)ge ||
17.e: There are many who devour even the phonenix in the sky and there are many, who even eat and digest the materialized devourers.

18.g: ਜਲ ਕਹਾ ਥਲ ਕਹਾ ਗਗਨ ਕੇ ਗਉਨ ਕਹਾ ਕਾਲ ਕੇ ਬਨਾਇ ਸਬੈ ਕਾਲ ਹੀ ਚਬਾਹਿਂਗੇ ॥
18.t: jal kahaa thal kahaa gagan ke gaun kahaa kaal ke banai sabai kaal hee chabaahi(n)ge ||
18.e: Not only to speak of the residents of water, earth and wanders of the sky, all those created by god of death will ultimately be devoured ( destroyed) by him.

18.g: ਤੇਜ ਜਿਉ ਅਤੇਜ ਮੈ ਅਤੇਜ ਜੈਸੇ ਤੇਜ ਲੀਨ ਤਾਹੀ ਤੇ ਉਪਜ ਸਬੈ ਤਾਹੀ ਮੈ ਸਮਾਹਿਂਗੇ ॥੧੮॥੮੮॥
18.t: tej jiau atej mai atej jaise tej leen taahee te upaj sabai taahee mai samaahi(n)ge ||18||88||
18.e: Just as the light merged in darkness and the darkness in the light all the created beings generated by the Lord will ultimately merge in Him. 18.88.

18.g: ਕੂਕਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਕੇਤੇ ਰੋਵਤ ਮਰਤ ਕੇਤੇ ਜਲ ਮੈਂ ਡੁਬਤ ਕੇਤੇ ਆਗ ਮੈਂ ਜਰਤ ਹੈਂ ॥
18.t: kookat firat kete rovat marat kete jal mai(n) ddubat kete aag mai(n) jarat hai(n) ||
18.e: Many cry out while wandering, many weep and many die many are drowned in water and many are burnt in fire.

18.g: ਕੇਤੇ ਗੰਗ ਬਾਸੀ ਕੇਤੇ ਮਦੀਨਾ ਮਕਾ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਕੇਤਕ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਕੇ ਭ੍ਰਮਾਏ ਈ ਫਿਰਤ ਹੈਂ ॥
18.t: kete ga(n)g baasee kete madheenaa makaa nivaasee ketak udhaasee ke bhramaae iee firat hai(n) ||
18.e: Many live on the banks of Ganges and many reside in Mecca and Medina, many becoming hermits, indulge in wanderings.

18.g: ਕਰਵਤ ਸਹਤ ਕੇਤੇ ਭੂਮਿ ਮੈ ਗਡਤ ਕੇਤੇ ਸੂਆ ਪੈ ਚੜ੍ਹਤ ਕੇਤੇ ਦੁਖ ਕਉ ਭਰਤ ਹੈਂ ॥
18.t: karavat sahat kete bhoom mai gaddat kete sooaa pai chaRhat kete dhukh kau bharat hai(n) ||
18.e: Many endure the agony of sawing, many get buried in the earth, many are hanged on the gallows and many undergo great angulish.

18.g: ਗੈਨ ਮੈਂ ਉਡਤ ਕੇਤੇ ਜਲ ਮੈਂ ਰਹਤ ਕੇਤੇ ਗਿਆਨ ਕੇ ਬਿਹੀਨ ਜਕ ਜਾਰੇ ਈ ਮਰਤ ਹੈਂ ॥੧੯॥੮੯॥
18.t: gain mai(n) uddat kete jal mai(n) rahat kete giaan ke biheen jak jaare iee marat hai(n) ||19||89||
18.e: Many fly in the sky, many lives in water and many without knowledge. In their waywardness burn themselves to death. 19.89.

18.g: ਸੋਧ ਹਾਰੇ ਦੇਵਤਾ ਬਿਰੋਧ ਹਾਰੇ ਦਾਨੋ ਬਡੇ ਬੋਧ ਹਾਰੇ ਬੋਧਕ ਪ੍ਰਬੋਧ ਹਾਰੇ ਜਾਪਸੀ ॥
18.t: sodh haare dhevataa birodh haare dhaano badde bodh haare bodhak prabodh haare jaapasee ||
18.e: The gods got weary of making offerings of fragrances, the antagonistic demons have got weary, he knowledgeable sages have got weary and worshippers of good understanding have also got weary.

18.g: ਘਸ ਹਾਰੇ ਚੰਦਨ ਲਗਾਇ ਹਾਰੇ ਚੋਆ ਚਾਰੁ ਪੂਜ ਹਾਰੇ ਪਾਹਨ ਚਢਾਇ ਹਾਰੇ ਲਾਪਸੀ ॥
18.t: ghas haare cha(n)dhan lagai haare choaa chaar pooj haare paahan chaddai haare laapasee ||
18.e: Those who rub sandalwood have got tired, the appliers of fine scent (otto) have got tired, the image-worshippers have got tired and those making offerings of sweet curry, have also got tired.

18.g: ਗਾਹ ਹਾਰੇ ਗੋਰਨ ਮਨਾਇ ਹਾਰੇ ਮੜ੍ਹੀ ਮੱਟ ਲੀਪ ਹਾਰੇ ਭੀਤਨ ਲਗਾਇ ਹਾਰੇ ਛਾਪਸੀ ॥
18.t: gaeh haare goran manai haare maRhee ma'T leep haare bheetan lagai haare chhaapasee ||
18.e: The visitors of graveyards have got tired, the worshippers of hermitages and monuments have got tired those who besmear the walls images have got tired and those who print with embossing seal have also got tired.

19.g: ਗਾਇ ਹਾਰੇ ਗੰਧ੍ਰਬ ਬਜਾਏ ਹਾਰੇ ਕਿੰਨਰ ਸਭ ਪਚ ਹਾਰੇ ਪੰਡਤ ਤਪੰਤ ਹਾਰੇ ਤਾਪਸੀ ॥੨੦॥੯੦॥
19.t: gai haare ga(n)dhrab bajaae haare ki(n)nar sabh pach haare pa(n)ddat tapa(n)t haare taapasee ||20||90||
19.e: Gandharvas, the musicians of goods have got tired, Kinnars, the players of musical instruments have got tired, the Pundits have got highly weary and the ascetics observing austerities have also got tired. None of the above-mentioned people have been able
BY THY GRACE. BHUJANG PRAYAAT STANZA

19.g: ਨ ਰਾਗੰ ਨ ਰੰਗੰ ਨ ਰੂਪੰ ਨ ਰੇਖੰ ॥
19.t: n raaga(n) na ra(n)ga(n) na roopa(n) na rekha(n) ||
19.e: The Lord is without an affection, without colour, without form and without line.

19.g: ਨ ਮੋਹੰ ਨ ਕ੍ਰੋਹੰ ਨ ਦ੍ਰੋਹੰ ਨ ਦ੍ਵੈਖੰ ॥
19.t: n moha(n) na kroha(n) na dhroha(n) na dhavaikha(n) ||
19.e: He without attachment, without anger, without deceit and without malice.

19.g: ਨ ਕਰਮੰ ਨ ਭਰਮੰ ਨ ਜਨਮੰ ਨ ਜਾਤੰ ॥
19.t: n karama(n) na bharama(n) na janama(n) na jaata(n) ||
19.e: He is actionless, illusionless, birthless and casteless.

19.g: ਨ ਮਿੱਤ੍ਰੰ ਨ ਸੱਤ੍ਰੰ ਨ ਪਿੱਤੰ੍ਰ ਨ ਮਾਤੰ ॥੧॥੯੧॥
19.t: n mi'tra(n) na sa'tra(n) na pi'ta(n)r na maata(n) ||1||91||
19.e: He is sans friend, sans enemy, sans father and sans mother.1.91.

19.g: ਨ ਨੇਹੰ ਨ ਗੇਹੰ ਨ ਕਾਮੰ ਨ ਧਾਮੰ ॥
19.t: n neha(n) na geha(n) na kaama(n) na dhaama(n) ||
19.e: He is without love, without home, without just and without home.

19.g: ਨ ਪੱੁਤ੍ਰੰ ਨ ਮਿੱਤ੍ਰੰ ਨ ਸੱਤ੍ਰੰ ਨ ਭਾਮੰ ॥
19.t: n pa'utra(n) na mi'tra(n) na sa'tra(n) na bhaama(n) ||
19.e: He is without son, without friend, without enemy and without wife.

20.e: He is accountless, guiseless, and Unborn entity.

20.g: ਸਦਾ ਸਿੱਧ ਦਾ ਬੱੁਧ ਦਾ ਬ੍ਰਿੱਧ ਰੂਪੰ ॥੨॥੯੨॥
20.t: sadhaa si'dh dhaa ba'udh dhaa bira'dh roopa(n) ||2||92||
20.e: He is ever the Giver of Power and Intellect, He is most Beautiful. 2.92.

20.g: ਨਹੀਂ ਜਾਨ ਜਾਈ ਕਛੂ ਰੂਪ ਰੇਖੰ ॥
20.t: nahee(n) jaan jaiee kachhoo roop rekha(n) ||
20.e: Nothing can be known about His Form and Mark.

20.g: ਕਹਾ ਬਾਸੁ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਫਿਰੈ ਕਉਨ ਭੇਖੰ ॥
20.t: kahaa baas taa ko firai kaun bhekha(n) ||
20.e: Where doth He live? In what Garb He moves?

20.g: ਕਹਾ ਨਾਮ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਕਹਾ ਕੈ ਕਹਾਵੈ ॥
20.t: kahaa naam taa kai kahaa kai kahaavai ||
20.e: What is His Name? Of what Place He is told?

20.g: ਕਹਾ ਕੈ ਬਖਾਨੋ ਕਹੇ ਮੋ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥੩॥੯੩॥
20.t: kahaa kai bakhaano kahe mo na aavai ||3||93||
20.e: How should He be described? Nothing can be said. 3.93.

20.g: ਨ ਰੋਗੰ ਨ ਸੋਗੰ ਨ ਮੋਹੰ ਨ ਮਾਤੰ ॥
20.t: n roga(n) na soga(n) na moha(n) na maata(n) ||
20.e: He is without ailment, without sorrow, without attachment and without mother.

20.g: ਨ ਕਰਮੰ ਨ ਭਰਮੰ ਨ ਜਨਮੰ ਨ ਜਾਤੰ ॥
20.t: n karama(n) na bharama(n) na janama(n) na jaata(n) ||
20.e: He is without work, without illusion, without birth and without caste.

21.e: He is without malice, without guise, and Unborn Entity.

21.g: ਨਮੋ ਏਕ ਰੂਪੇ ਨਮੋ ਏਕ ਰੂਪੇ ॥੪॥੯੪॥
21.t: namo ek roope namo ek roope ||4||94||
21.e: Salutation to Him of One Form, Salutation to Him of One Form. 4.94.
Yonder and Yonder is He, the Supreme Lord, He is the Illuminator of Intellect.
He is Invincible, Indestructible, the Primal, Non-dual and Eternal.

21.g: ਨ ਜਾਤੰ ਨ ਪਾਤੰ ਨ ਰੂਪੰ ਨ ਰੰਗੇ ॥
21.t: n jaata(n) na paata(n) na roopa(n) na ra(n)ge ||
21.e: He is without caste, without line, without form and without colour.

21.g: ਨਮੋ ਆਦਿ ਅਭੰਗੇ ਨਮੋ ਆਦਿ ਅਭੰਗੇ ॥੫॥੯੫॥
21.t: namo aadh abha(n)ge namo aadh abha(n)ge ||5||95||
21.e: Salutation to Him, Who is Primal and Immortal Salutation to Him who is Primal and Immortal.5.95.

21.g: ਕਿਤੇ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਸੇ ਕੀਟ ਕੋਟੈ ਉਪਾਏ ॥
21.t: kite kirasan se keeT koTai upaae ||
21.e: He hath Created millions of Krishnas like worms.
He Created them, annihilated them, again destroyed them, still again Created them.
He is Unfathomable, Fearless, Primal, Non-dual and Indestructible.

22.e: Yonder and Yonder is He, the supreme Lord, He is the Perfect Illuminator. 6.96.

22.g: ਨ ਆਧੰ ਨ ਬਿਆਧੰ ਅਗਾਧੰ ਸਰੂਪੇ ॥
22.t: n aadha(n) na biaadha(n) agaadha(n) saroope ||
22.e: He, the Unfathomable Entity is without the ailments of the mind and body.
He the Lord of Indivisible Glory and Master of eternal wealth from the very beginging.

22.g: ਨ ਜਨਮੰ ਨ ਮਰਨੰ ਨ ਬਰਨੰ ਨ ਬਿਆਧੇ ॥
22.t: n janama(n) na marana(n) na barana(n) na biaadhe ||
22.e: He is without birth, without death, without colour and without ailment.
He is Partless, Mighty, Unpunishable and Incorrigible.7.97.

22.g: ਨ ਨੇਹੰ ਨ ਗੇਹੰ ਸਨੇਹੰ ਸਨਾਥੇ ॥
22.t: n neha(n) na geha(n) saneha(n) sanaathe ||
22.e: He is without love, without home, without affection and without company.

22.g: ਨ ਜਾਤੇ ਨ ਪਾਤੇ ਨ ਸੱਤ੍ਰੇ ਨ ਮਿੱਤ੍ਰੇ ॥
22.t: n jaate na paate na sa'tre na mi'tre ||
22.e: He is without caste, without line, without enemy and without friend.

23.e: That Imageless Lord was in the past, is in the present and will be in the future. 8.98.

23.g: ਨ ਰਾਯੰ ਨ ਰੰਕੰ ਨ ਰੂਪੰ ਨ ਰੇਖੰ ॥
23.t: n raaya(n) na ra(n)ka(n) na roopa(n) na rekha(n) ||
23.e: He is neither the king, nor the poor, without form and without mark.

23.g: ਨ ਲੋਭੰ ਨ ਚੋਭੰ ਅਭੂਤੰ ਅਭੇਖੰ ॥
23.t: n lobha(n) na chobha(n) abhoota(n) abhekha(n) ||
23.e: He is without greed, without jealousy, without body and without guise.

23.g: ਨ ਸਤ੍ਰੰ ਨ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੰ ਨ ਨੇਹੰ ਨ ਗੇਹੰ ॥
23.t: n satra(n) na mitra(n) na neha(n) na geha(n) ||
23.e: He is without enemy, without friend, without love and without home.
He always has love for all at all times. 9.99.

23.g: ਨ ਕਾਮੰ ਨ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੰ ਨ ਲੋਭੰ ਨ ਮੋਹੰ ॥
23.t: n kaama(n) na krodha(n) na lobha(n) na moha(n) ||
23.e: He is without lust, without anger, without greed and without attachment.
He is Unborn, Invincible, the Primal, Non-dual and Imperceptible.

23.g: ਨ ਜਨਮੰ ਨ ਮਰਨੰ ਨ ਬਰਨੰ ਨ ਬਿਆਧੰ ॥
23.t: n janama(n) na marana(n) na barana(n) na biaadha(n) ||
23.e: He is without birth, without death, without colour and without ailment.

24.g: ਨ ਰੋਗੰ ਨ ਸੋਗੰ ਅਭੈ ਨਿਰਬਿਖਾਧੰ ॥੧੦॥੧੦੦॥
24.t: n roga(n) na soga(n) abhai nirabikhaadha(n) ||10||100||
24.e: He is without malady, without sorrow, without Fear and without hatred.10.100.
He Invincible, Indiscriminate, Actionless and Timeles.
He is Indivisible, Indefamable, Mighty and Patronless.

24.g: ਨ ਤਾਤੰ ਨ ਮਾਤੰ ਨ ਜਾਤੰ ਨ ਭਾਇਅੰ ॥
24.t: n taata(n) na maata(n) na jaata(n) na bhaia(n) ||
24.e: He is without father, without mother, without birth and without body.

24.g: ਨ ਨੇਹੰ ਨ ਗੇਹੰ ਨ ਕਰਮੰ ਨ ਕਾਇਅੰ ॥੧੧॥੧੦੧॥
24.t: n neha(n) na geha(n) na karama(n) na kaia(n) ||11||101||
24.e: He is without love, without home, without karma and without body. 11.101.

24.g: ਨ ਰੂਪੰ ਨ ਭੂਪੰ ਨ ਕਾਯੰ ਨ ਕਰਮੰ ॥
24.t: n roopa(n) na bhoopa(n) na kaaya(n) na karama(n) ||
24.e: He is without form, without hunger, without body and without action.

24.g: ਨ ਤ੍ਰਾਸੰ ਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਸੰ ਨ ਭੇਦੰ ਨ ਭਰਮੰ ॥
24.t: n traasa(n) na praasa(n) na bhedha(n) na bharama(n) ||
24.e: He is without suffering, without strife, without discrimination and without illusion.
He is Eternal, He is the Perfect and Oldest Entity.

25.g: ਨਮੋ ਏਕ ਰੂਪੇ ਨਮੋ ਏਕ ਰੂਪੇ ॥੧੨॥੧੦੨॥
25.t: namo ek roope namo ek roope ||12||102||
25.e: Salutation to the Lord of One Form, Salutation to the Lord of One Form. 12.102.
His Glory is inexpressible, His Excellence from the very beginning cannot be described.
Non-aligned, Unassailable and from the very beginning Unmanifested and Unestablished.
He is the Enjoyer in diverse guises, invincible from the very beginning and an Unassailable Entity.

25.g: ਨਮੋ ਏਕ ਰੂਪੇ ਨਮੋ ਏਕ ਰੂਪੇ ॥੧੩॥੧੦੩॥
25.t: namo ek roope namo ek roope ||13||103||
25.e: Salutation to the Lord of One Form Salutation to the Lord of One Form.13.103.

25.g: ਨ ਨੇਹੰ ਨ ਗੇਹੰ ਨ ਸੋਕੰ ਨ ਸਾਕੰ ॥
25.t: n neha(n) na geha(n) na soka(n) na saaka(n) ||
25.e: He is without love, without home, without sorrow and without relations.
He is in the Yond, He is Holy and Immaculate and He is Independent.

25.g: ਨ ਜਾਤੰ ਨ ਪਾਤੰ ਨ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੰ ਨ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੇ ॥
25.t: n jaata(n) na paata(n) na mitra(n) na ma(n)tre ||
25.e: He is without caste, without line, without friend and without adviser.

25.g: ਨਮੋ ਏਕ ਤੰਤ੍ਰੇ ਨਮੋ ਏਕ ਤੰਤ੍ਰੇ ॥੧੪॥੧੦੪॥
25.t: namo ek ta(n)tre namo ek ta(n)tre ||14||104||
25.e: Salutation to the One Lord in wrap and woof Salutation to the One Lord in wrap and woof. 14.104.

26.g: ਨ ਧਰਮੰ ਨ ਭਰਮੰ ਨ ਸਰਮੰ ਨ ਸਾਕੇ ॥
26.t: n dharama(n) na bharama(n) na sarama(n) na saake ||
26.e: He is without religion, without illusion, without shyness and without relations.

26.g: ਨ ਬਰਮੰ ਨ ਚਰਮੰ ਨ ਕਰਮੰ ਨ ਬਾਕੇ ॥
26.t: n barama(n) na charama(n) na karama(n) na baake ||
26.e: He is without coat of mail, without shield, without steps and without speech.

26.g: ਨ ਸਤ੍ਰੰ ਨ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੰ ਨ ਪੁਤ੍ਰੰ ਸਰੂਪੇ ॥
26.t: n satra(n) na mitra(n) na putra(n) saroope ||
26.e: He is without enemy, without friend and without countenance of a son.

26.g: ਨਮੋ ਆਦਿ ਰੂਪੇ ਨਮੋ ਆਦਿ ਰੂਪੇ ॥੧੫॥੧੦੫॥
26.t: namo aadh roope namo aadh roope ||15||105||
26.e: Salutation to that Primal entity Salutation to that Primal Entity.15.105.

26.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਕੰਜ ਕੇ ਮੰਜ ਕੇ ਭਰਮ ਭੂਲੇ ॥
26.t: kahoo(n) ka(n)j ke ma(n)j ke bharam bhoole ||
26.e: Somewhere as a black bee Thou art engaged in the delusion of fragrance of the lotus!

26.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਰੰਕ ਕੇ ਰਾਜ ਕੇ ਧਰਮ ਅਲੂਲੇ ॥
26.t: kahoo(n) ra(n)k ke raaj ke dharam aloole ||
26.e: Somewhere Thou art describing the characteristics of a king and the poor!

26.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਦੇਸ ਕੇ ਭੇਸ ਕੇ ਧਰਮ ਧਾਮੇ ॥
26.t: kahoo(n) dhes ke bhes ke dharam dhaame ||
26.e: Somewhere Thou art the abode of virtues of various guises of the county!

26.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਰਾਜ ਕੇ ਸਾਜ ਕੇ ਬਾਜ ਤਾਮੇ ॥੧੬॥੧੦੬॥
26.t: kahoo(n) raaj ke saaj ke baaj taame ||16||106||
26.e: Somewhere Thou art manifesting the mode of Tamas in a kingly mood!  16. 106

27.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਅਛ੍ਰ ਕੇ ਪਛ੍ਰ ਕੇ ਸਿੱਧ ਸਾਧੇ ॥
27.t: kahoo(n) achhr ke pachhr ke si'dh saadhe ||
27.e: Somewhere Thou art practicing for the realisation of powers through the medium of learning and science!

27.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਸਿੱਧ ਕੇ ਬੁੱਧਿ ਕੇ ਬਿੱ੍ਰਧ ਲਾਧੇ ॥
27.t: kahoo(n) si'dh ke bu'dh ke bi'radh laadhe ||
27.e: Somewhere Thou art searching the secrets of Powers and Intellect!

27.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਅੰਗ ਕੇ ਰੰਗ ਕੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਦੇਖੇ ॥
27.t: kahoo(n) a(n)g ke ra(n)g ke sa(n)g dhekhe ||
27.e: Somewhere Thou art seen in profound love of woman!

27.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਜੰਗ ਕੇ ਰੰਗ ਕੇ ਰੰਗ ਪੇਖੇ ॥੧੭॥੧੦੭॥
27.t: kahoo(n) ja(n)g ke ra(n)g ke ra(n)g pekhe ||17||107||
27.e: Somewhere Thou art seen in excitement of warfare!  17. 107

27.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਧਰਮ ਕੇ ਕਰਮ ਕੇ ਹਰਮ ਜਾਨੇ ॥
27.t: kahoo(n) dharam ke karam ke haram jaane ||
27.e: Somewhere Thou art considered as the abode of the acts of piety!

27.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਧਰਮ ਕੇ ਕਰਮ ਕੇ ਭਰਮ ਮਾਨੇ ॥
27.t: kahoo(n) dharam ke karam ke bharam maane ||
27.e: Somewhere Thou acceptest the ritualistic discipline as illusion!

27.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਚਾਰ ਚੇਸਟਾ ਕਹੂੰ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਰੂਪੰ ॥
27.t: kahoo(n) chaar chesaTaa kahoo(n) chitr roopa(n) ||
27.e: Somewhere Thou makest grand efforts and somewhere Thou lookest like a picture!

27.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਪਰਮ ਪ੍ਰਗਯਾ ਕਹੂੰ ਸਰਬ ਭੂਪੰ ॥੧੮॥੧੦੮॥
27.t: kahoo(n) param pragayaa kahoo(n) sarab bhoopa(n) ||18||108||
27.e: Somewhere Thou art embodiment of fime intellect and somewhere Thou art the Sovereign of all!  18. 108

28.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਨੇਹ ਗ੍ਰੇਹੰ ਕਹੂੰ ਦੇਹ ਦੋਖੰ ॥
28.t: kahoo(n) neh greha(n) kahoo(n) dheh dhokha(n) ||
28.e: Somewhere Thou art an eclipse of love and somewhere Thou art physical ailment!

28.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਔਖਦੀ ਰੋਗ ਕੇ ਸੋਕ ਸੋਖੰ ॥
28.t: kahoo(n) aauakhadhee rog ke sok sokha(n) ||
28.e: Somewhere Thou art the medicine, drying up the grief of malady!

28.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਦੇਵ ਬਿਦ੍ਯਾ ਕਹੂੰ ਦੈਤ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
28.t: kahoo(n) dhev bidhayaa kahoo(n) dhait baanee ||
28.e: Somewhere Thou art the learning of gods and somewhere Thou art the speech of demons!
Somewhere Thou art the episode of Yaksha, Gandharva and Kinnar!  19. 109
Somewhere Thou art Rajsic (full of activity), Sattvic (rhythmic) and Tamsic (full of morbidity)!

28.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਜੋਗ ਬਿਦ੍ਯਾ ਧਰੇ ਤਾਪਸੀ ਹੋ ॥
28.t: kahoo(n) jog bidhayaa dhare taapasee ho ||
28.e: Somewhere Thou art an ascetic, practicing the learning of yoga!

28.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਰੋਗ ਰਹਿਤਾ ਕਹੂੰ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤੰ ॥
28.t: kahoo(n) rog rahitaa kahoo(n) jog jugata(n) ||
28.e: Somewhere Thou art the Remover of malady and somewhere Thou art cohesive with Yoga!

28.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਭੂਮਿ ਕੀ ਭੁਗਤ ਮੈ ਭਰਮ ਭੁਗਤੰ ॥੨੦॥੧੧੦॥
28.t: kahoo(n) bhoom kee bhugat mai bharam bhugata(n) ||20||110||
28.e: Somewhere Thou art cohesive with Yoga , Somewhere Thou art deluded in enjoying the earthly rictuals!  20. 110

28.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਦੇਵ ਕੰਨਿਆ ਕਹੂੰ ਦਾਨਵੀ ਹੋ ॥
28.t: kahoo(n) dhev ka(n)niaa kahoo(n) dhaanavee ho ||
28.e: Somewhere Thou art a daughter of gods and somewhere a daughter of demons!

28.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਜੱਛ ਬਿਦ੍ਯਾ ਧਰੇ ਮਾਨਵੀ ਹੋ ॥
28.t: kahoo(n) ja'chh bidhayaa dhare maanavee ho ||
28.e: Somewhere a daughter of Yakshas, Vidyadhars and men!

28.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਰਾਜਸੀ ਹੋ ਕਹੂੰ ਰਾਜ ਕੰਨਿਆ ॥
28.t: kahoo(n) raajasee ho kahoo(n) raaj ka(n)niaa ||
28.e: Somewhere Thou art the queen and somewhere Thou art the princess!

28.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਿਸਟ ਕੀ ਰਿਸਟ ਪੰਨਿਆ ॥੨੧॥੧੧੧॥
28.t: kahoo(n) sirasaT kee pirasaT kee risaT pa(n)niaa ||21||111||
28.e: Somewhere Thou art the superb daughter of the Nagas of netherworld!  21. 111

28.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਬੇਦ ਬਿੱਦਿਆ ਕਹੂੰ ਬਿਓਮ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
28.t: kahoo(n) bedh bi'dhiaa kahoo(n) biom baanee ||
28.e: Somewhere Thou art the learning of Vedas and somewhere the voice of heaven!

28.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਕੋਕ ਕੀ ਕਾਬਿ ਕੱਥੈ ਕਹਾਨੀ ॥
28.t: kahoo(n) kok kee kaab ka'thai kahaanee ||
28.e: Somewhere Thu art the discourse and story of general poets!

28.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਅਦ੍ਰ ਸਾਰੰ ਕਹੂੰ ਭਦ੍ਰ ਰੂਪੰ ॥
28.t: kahoo(n) adhr saara(n) kahoo(n) bhadhr roopa(n) ||
28.e: Somewhere Thou art iron and somewhere Thou art splendid gold!

29.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਮੱਦ੍ਰ ਬਾਨੀ ਕਹੂੰ ਛਿਦ੍ਰ ਸਰੂਪੰ ॥੨੨॥੧੧੨॥
29.t: kahoo(n) ma'dhr baanee kahoo(n) chhidhr saroopa(n) ||22||112||
29.e: Somewhere Thou art sweet speech and somewhere Thou art sweet speech and somewhere Thou art critical and fault finding!  22. 112

29.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਬੇਦ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਕਹੂੰ ਕਾਬ ਰੂਪੰ ॥
29.t: kahoo(n) bedh bidhiaa kahoo(n) kaab roopa(n) ||
