36.e: All the Vedas call Him ‘Neti, Neti’ (Not this, Not thisl….Infinite).2.232.

36.g: ਕਈ ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਕੀਨੋ ਬਨਾਉ ॥
36.t: kiee uooch neech keeno banaau ||
36.e: He hath Created many beings in upper and lower regions.!

36.g: ਸਭ ਵਾਰ ਪਾਰ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਉ ॥
36.t: sabh vaar paar jaa ko prabhaau ||
36.e: His Glory is spread in all places here and there.

36.g: ਸਭ ਜੀਵ ਜੰਤ ਜਾਨੰਤ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
36.t: sabh jeev ja(n)t jaana(n)t jaeh ||
36.e: All the being and creatures know Him. O foolish mind!

36.g: ਮਨ ਮੂੜ ਕਿਉ ਨ ਸੇਵੰਤ ਤਾਹਿ ॥੩॥੨੩੩॥
36.t: man mooR kiau na seva(n)t taeh ||3||233||
36.e: Why dost thou not remember Him? 3.233.

36.g: ਕਈ ਮੂੜ੍ਹ ਪਾਤ੍ਰ ਪੂਜਾ ਕਰੰਤ ॥
36.t: kiee mooRh paatr poojaa kara(n)t ||
36.e: Many fools worship the leaves (of Tulsi plant). !

36.g: ਕਈ ਸਿੱਧ ਸਾਧੁ ਸੂਰਜ ਸਿਵੰਤ ॥
36.t: kiee si'dh saadh sooraj siva(n)t ||
36.e: Many adepts and saints adore the Sun.

36.g: ਕਈ ਪਲਟ ਸੂਰਜ ਸਿਜਦਾ ਕਰਾਇ ॥
36.t: kiee palaT sooraj sijadhaa karai ||
36.e: Many prostrate towards the west (opposite side of sunrise)!

36.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਏਕ ਰੂਪ ਦ੍ਵੈ ਕੈ ਲਖਾਇ ॥੪॥੨੩੪॥
36.t: prabh ek roop dhavai kai lakhai ||4||234||
36.e: They consider the Lord as dual, who is actually one!4. 234

36.g: ਅਨਛਿੱਜ ਤੇਜ ਅਨਭੈ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸ ॥
36.t: anachhi'j tej anabhai prakaas ||
36.e: His Glory is Unassailable and His illumination is devoid of fear!

36.g: ਦਾਤਾ ਦੁਰੰਤ ਅਦ੍ਵੈ ਅਨਾਸ ॥
36.t: dhaataa dhura(n)t adhavai anaas ||
36.e: He is Infinite Donor, Non-dual and Indestructible

36.g: ਸਭ ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਤੇ ਰਹਤ ਰੂਪ ॥
36.t: sabh rog sog te rahat roop ||
36.e: He is an Entity devoid of all ailments and sorrows!

36.g: ਅਨਭੈ ਅਕਾਲ ਅਛੈ ਸਰੂਪ ॥੫॥੨੩੫॥
36.t: anabhai akaal achhai saroop ||5||235||
36.e: He is Fearless, Immortal and Invincible Entity!5. 235

37.g: ਕਰੁਣਾ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਕਾਮਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥
37.t: karunaa nidhaan kaamal kirapaal ||
37.e: He is treasure of sympathy and perfectly Merciful!

37.g: ਦੂਖ ਦੋਖ ਹਰਤ ਦਾਤਾ ਦਿਆਲ ॥
37.t: dhookh dhokh harat dhaataa dhiaal ||
37.e: He the Donor and Merciful Lord removes all sufferings and blemishes

37.g: ਅੰਜਨ ਬਿਹੀਨ ਅਨਭੰਜ ਨਾਥ ॥
37.t: a(n)jan biheen anabha(n)j naath ||
37.e: He is without the impact of maya and is an Infrangible!

37.g: ਜਲ ਥਲ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਉ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਸਾਥ ॥੬॥੨੩੬॥
37.t: jal thal prabhaau sarabatr saath ||6||236||
37.e: Lord, His Glory pervades in water and on land and is the companion of all!6. 236

37.g: ਜਿਹ ਜਾਤ ਪਾਤ ਨਹੀ ਭੇਦ ਭਰਮ ॥
37.t: jeh jaat paat nahee bhedh bharam ||
37.e: He is without caste, lineage, contrast and illusion,!

37.g: ਜਿਹ ਰੰਗ ਰੂਪ ਨਹੀ ਏਕ ਧਰਮ ॥
37.t: jeh ra(n)g roop nahee ek dharam ||
37.e: He is without colour, form and special religious discipline

37.g: ਜਿਹ ਸਤ੍ਰੁ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਦੋਊ ਏਕ ਸਾਰ ॥
37.t: jeh satr mitr dhouoo ek saar ||
37.e: For Him the enemies and friends are the same!

37.g: ਅੱਛੈ ਸਰੂਪ ਅਬਿਚਲ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੭॥੨੩੭॥
37.t: a'chhai saroop abichal apaar ||7||237||
37.e: His invincible form is Everlasting and Infinite!7. 237

37.g: ਜਾਨੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਜਿਹ ਰੂਪ ਰੇਖ ॥
37.t: jaanee na jai jeh roop rekh ||
37.e: His form and mark cannot be known!

37.g: ਕਹਿ ਬਾਸੁ ਤਾਸੁ ਕਹਿ ਕਉਨੁ ਭੇਖ ॥
37.t: keh baas taas keh kaun bhekh ||
37.e: Where doth He live? And what is His garb?

37.g: ਕਹਿ ਨਾਮ ਤਾਸ ਹੈ ਕਵਨ ਜਾਤ ॥
37.t: keh naam taas hai kavan jaat ||
37.e: What is His Name? and what is His caste?

37.g: ਜਿਹ ਸਤ੍ਰੁ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਹੀ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ॥੮॥੨੩੮॥
37.t: jeh satr mitr nahee putr bhraat ||8||238||
37.e: He is without any enemy, friend, son and brother!8. 238

37.g: ਕਰੁਣਾ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਰੂਪ ॥
37.t: karunaa nidhaan kaaran saroop ||
37.e: He is the treasure of Mercy and the cause of all causes!

37.g: ਜਿਹ ਚਕ੍ਰ ਚਿਹਨ ਨਹੀ ਰੰਗ ਰੂਪ ॥
37.t: jeh chakr chihan nahee ra(n)g roop ||
37.e: He hath no mark, sign, colour and form

37.g: ਜਿਹ ਖੇਦ ਭੇਦ ਨਹੀ ਕਰਮ ਕਾਲ ॥
37.t: jeh khedh bhedh nahee karam kaal ||
37.e: He is without suffering, action and death!

37.g: ਸਭ ਜੀਵ ਜੰਤ ਕੀ ਕਰਤ ਪਾਲ ॥੯॥੨੩੯॥
37.t: sabh jeev ja(n)t kee karat paal ||9||239||
37.e: He is the Sustainer of all the beings and creatures!9. 239

37.g: ਉਰਧੰ ਬਿਰਹਤ ਸੁਧੰ ਸਰੂਪ ॥
37.t: auradha(n) birahat sudha(n) saroop ||
37.e: He is the loftiest, biggest and Perfect Entity!

37.g: ਬੱੁਧੰ ਅਪਾਲ ਜੱੁਧੰ ਅਨੂਪ ॥
37.t: ba'udha(n) apaal ja'udha(n) anoop ||
37.e: His intellect is boundless and is unique in warfare

37.g: ਜਿਹ ਰੂਪ ਰੇਖ ਨਹੀ ਰੰਗ ਰਾਗ ॥
37.t: jeh roop rekh nahee ra(n)g raag ||
37.e: He is without form, line, colour and affection!

37.g: ਅਨਛਿੱਜ ਤੇਜ ਅਨਭਿੱਜ ਅਦਾਗ ॥੧੦॥੨੪੦॥
37.t: anachhi'j tej anabhi'j adhaag ||10||240||
37.e: His Glory is Unassailable, Unappeasable and stainless!10. 240

37.g: ਜਲ ਥਲ ਮਹੀਪ ਬਨ ਤਨ ਦੁਰੰਤ ॥
37.t: jal thal maheep ban tan dhura(n)t ||
37.e: He is the king of waters and lands; He, the Infinite Lord pervades the forests and the blades of grass!;

37.g: ਜਿਹ ਨੇਤਿ ਨੇਤਿ ਨਿਸ ਦਿਨ ਉਚਰੰਤ ॥
37.t: jeh net net nis dhin uchara(n)t ||
37.e: He is called ‘Neti, Neti’ (Not this, Not this…Infinite) night and day

37.g: ਪਾਇਓ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਜਿਹ ਪੈਰ ਪਾਰ ॥
37.t: paio na jai jeh pair paar ||
37.e: His limits cannot be known!

37.g: ਦੀਨਾਨ ਦੋਖ ਦਹਿਤਾ ਉਦਾਰ ॥੧੧॥੨੪੧॥
37.t: dheenaan dhokh dhahitaa udhaar ||11||241||
37.e: He, the Generous Lord, burns the blemishes of the lowly!11. 241

37.g: ਕਈ ਕੋਟ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਜਿਹ ਪਾਨਿਹਾਰ ॥
37.t: kiee koT i(n)dhr jeh paanihaar ||
37.e: Millions of Indras are at His service!

37.g: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਰੱਦ੍ਰ ਜੁਗੀਆ ਦੁਆਰ ॥
37.t: kiee koT ra'dhr jugeeaa dhuaar ||
37.e: Millions of the Yogi Rudras (Shivas stand at His Gate)

37.g: ਕਈ ਬੇਦ ਬਿਆਸ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਅਨੰਤ ॥
37.t: kiee bedh biaas brahamaa ana(n)t ||
37.e: Many Ved Vyas and innumerable Brahmas!

37.g: ਜਿਹ ਨੇਤ ਨੇਤ ਨਿਸ ਦਿਨ ਉਚਰੰਤ ॥੧੨॥੨੪੨॥
37.t: jeh net net nis dhin uchara(n)t ||12||242||
37.e: Utter the words ‘Neti, Neti’ about Him, night and day!12. 242

37.g: ਤ੍ਵ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥ ਸ੍ਵੱਯੇ ॥
37.t: tavai prasaadh || savai'ye ||
37.e: BY THY GRACE. SWAYYAS

37.g: ਦੀਨਨ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ਕਰੈ ਨਿਤ ਸੰਤ ਉਬਾਰਿ ਗਨੀਮਨ ਗਾਰੈ ॥
37.t: dheenan kee pratipaal karai nit sa(n)t ubaar ganeeman gaarai ||
37.e: He always Sustains the Lowly, protects the saints and destroys the enemies.

37.g: ਪੱਛ ਪਸੂ ਨਗ ਨਾਗ ਨਰਾਧਪ ਸਰਬ ਸਮੈ ਸਭ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰੈ ॥
37.t: pa'chh pasoo nag naag naraadhap sarab samai sabh ko pratipaarai ||
37.e: At all times he Sustains all, animals, birds, mountains (or trees), serpents and men (kings of men).

37.g: ਪੋਖਤ ਹੈ ਜਲ ਮੈ ਥਲ ਮੈ ਪਲ ਮੈ ਕਲਿ ਕੇ ਨਹੀਂ ਕਰਮ ਬਿਚਾਰੈ ॥
37.t: pokhat hai jal mai thal mai pal mai kal ke nahee(n) karam bichaarai ||
37.e: He Sustains in an instant all the beings living in water and on land and doth not ponder over their actions.

37.g: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਦਇਆ ਨਿਧਿ ਦੋਖਨ ਦੇਖਤ ਹੈ ਪਰੁ ਦੇਤ ਨ ਹਾਰੈ ॥੧॥੨੪੩॥
37.t: dheen dhiaal dhiaa nidh dhokhan dhekhat hai par dhet na haarai ||1||243||
37.e: The Merciful Lord of the Lowly and the treasure of Mercy sees their blemishes, but doth not fail in His Bounty. 1.243.

37.g: ਦਾਹਤ ਹੈ ਦੁਖ ਦੋਖਨ ਕੌ ਦਲ ਦੁੱਜਨ ਕੇ ਪਲ ਮੈ ਦਲ ਡਾਰੈ ॥
37.t: dhaahat hai dhukh dhokhan kau dhal dhu'jan ke pal mai dhal ddaarai ||
37.e: He burns the sufferings and blemishes and in an instant mashes the forces of the vicious people.

37.g: ਖੰਡ ਅਖੰਡ ਪ੍ਰਚੰਡ ਪਹਾਰਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤ ਸੰਭਾਰੈ ॥
37.t: kha(n)dd akha(n)dd pracha(n)dd pahaaran pooran prem kee preet sa(n)bhaarai ||
37.e: He even destroys them who are mighty and Glorious and assail the unassailable and responds the devotion of perfect love.

37.g: ਪਾਰ ਨ ਪਾਇ ਸਕੈ ਪਦਮਾ ਪਤਿ ਬੇਦ ਕਤੇਬ ਅਭੇਦ ਉਚਾਰੈ ॥
37.t: paar na pai sakai padhamaa pat bedh kateb abhedh uchaarai ||
37.e: Even Vishnu cannot know His end and the Vedas and Katebs (Semitic Scriptures) call Him Indiscriminate.

37.g: ਰੋਜੀ ਹੀ ਰਾਜ ਬਿਲੋਕਤ ਰਾਜਕ ਰੋਖ ਰੂਹਾਨ ਕੀ ਰੋਜੀ ਨ ਟਾਰੈ ॥੨॥੨੪੪॥
37.t: rojee hee raaj bilokat raajak rokh roohaan kee rojee na Taarai ||2||244||
37.e: The Provider-Lord always sees our secrets, even then in anger He doth not stop His munificence.2.244.

37.g: ਕੀਟ ਪਤੰਗ ਕੁਰੰਗ ਭੁਜੰਗਮ ਭੂਤ ਭਵਿੱਖ ਭਵਾਨ ਬਨਾਏ ॥
37.t: keeT pata(n)g kura(n)g bhuja(n)gam bhoot bhavi'kh bhavaan banaae ||
37.e: He Created in the past, creates in the present and shall create in the future the beings including insects, moths, deer and snakes.

37.g: ਦੇਵ ਅਦੇਵ ਖਪੇ ਅਹੰਮੇਵ ਨ ਭੇਵ ਲਖਿਓ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਸਿਉ ਭਰਮਾਏ ॥
37.t: dhev adhev khape aha(n)mev na bhev lakhio bhram siau bharamaae ||
37.e: The goods and demons have been consumed in ego, but could not know the mystery of the Lord, being engrossed in delusion.

37.g: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਕਤੇਬ ਕੁਰਾਨ ਹਸੇਬ ਥਕੇ ਕਰ ਹਾਥ ਨ ਆਏ ॥
37.t: bedh puraan kateb kuraan haseb thake kar haath na aae ||
37.e: The Vedas, Puranas, Katebs and the Quran have tired of giving His account, but the Lord could not be comprehended.

37.g: ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਉ ਬਿਨਾ ਪਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਕਿਨ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਪਦਮਾ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥੨੪੫॥
37.t: pooran prem prabhaau binaa pat siau kin sree padhamaa pat paae ||3||245||
37.e: Without the impact of perfect love, who hath realized Lord-God with grace? 3.245.

37.g: ਆਦਿ ਅਨੰਤ ਅਗਾਧ ਅਦ੍ਵੈਖ ਸੁ ਭੂਤ ਭਵਿੱਖ ਭਵਾਨ ਅਭੈ ਹੈ ॥
37.t: aadh ana(n)t agaadh adhavaikh su bhoot bhavi'kh bhavaan abhai hai ||
37.e: The Primal, Infinite, Unfathomable Lord is without malice and is fearless in the past, present and future.

37.g: ਅੰਤਿ ਬਿਹੀਨ ਅਨਾਤਮ ਆਪ ਅਦਾਗ ਅਦੋਖ ਅਛਿੱਦ੍ਰ ਅਛੈ ਹੈ ॥
37.t: a(n)t biheen anaatam aap adhaag adhokh achhi'dhr achhai hai ||
37.e: He is endless, Himself Selfless, stainless, blemishless, flawless and invincible.

37.g: ਲੋਗਨ ਕੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਹਰਤਾ ਜਲ ਮੈ ਥਲ ਮੈ ਭਰਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਵੈ ਹੈ ॥
37.t: logan ke karataa harataa jal mai thal mai bharataa prabh vai hai ||
37.e: He is the Creator and Destroyer of all in water and on land and also their Sustainer-Lord.

37.g: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਦਇਆ ਕਰ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਪਤਿ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਪਦਮਾ ਪਤਿ ਏਹੈ ॥੪॥੨੪੬॥
37.t: dheen dhiaal dhiaa kar sree pat su(n)dhar sree padhamaa pat ehai ||4||246||
37.e: He, the Lord of maya, is Compassionate to the Lowly, source of Mercy and most beautiful.4.246.

37.g: ਕਾਮ ਨ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਨ ਲੋਭ ਨ ਮੋਹ ਨ ਰੋਗ ਨ ਸੋਗ ਨ ਭੋਗ ਨ ਭੈ ਹੈ ॥
37.t: kaam na krodh na lobh na moh na rog na sog na bhog na bhai hai ||
37.e: He is without lust, anger, greed, attachment, ailment, sorrow, enjoyment and fear.

37.g: ਦੇਹ ਬਿਹੀਨ ਸਨੇਹ ਸਭੋ ਤਨ ਨੇਹ ਬਿਰਕਤ ਅਗੇਹ ਅਛੈ ਹੈ ॥
37.t: dheh biheen saneh sabho tan neh birakat ageh achhai hai ||
37.e: He is body-less, loving everybody but without worldly attachment, invincible and cannot be held in grasp.

37.g: ਜਾਨ ਕੋ ਦੇਤ ਅਜਾਨ ਕੋ ਦੇਤ ਜਮੀਨ ਕੋ ਦੇਤ ਜਮਾਨ ਕੋ ਦੈ ਹੈ ॥
37.t: jaan ko dhet ajaan ko dhet jameen ko dhet jamaan ko dhai hai ||
37.e: He provides sustenance to all animate and inanimate beings and all those living on the earth and in the sky.

37.g: ਕਾਹੇ ਕੋ ਡੋਲਤ ਹੈ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਸੁਧ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਪਦਮਾ ਪਤਿ ਲੈਹੈ ॥੫॥੨੪੭॥
37.t: kaahe ko ddolat hai tumaree sudh su(n)dhar sree padhamaa pat laihai ||5||247||
37.e: Why dost thou waver, O creature! The beautiful Lord of maya will take care of thee. 5.247.

37.g: ਰੋਗਨ ਤੇ ਅਰ ਸੋਗਨ ਤੇ ਜਲ ਜੋਗਨ ਤੇ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਬਚਾਵੈ ॥
37.t: rogan te ar sogan te jal jogan te bahu bhaa(n)t bachaavai ||
37.e: He protects in many blows, but none doth inflict thy body.

37.g: ਸੱਤ੍ਰ ਅਨੇਕ ਚਲਾਵਤ ਘਾਵ ਤਊ ਤਨ ਏਕੁ ਨ ਲਾਗਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
37.t: sa'tr anek chalaavat ghaav tuoo tan ek na laagan paavai ||
37.e: The enemy strikes many blows, but none doth inflict thy body.

37.g: ਰਾਖਤ ਹੈ ਅਪਨੋ ਕਰੁ ਦੈ ਕਰ ਪਾਪ ਸੰਬੂਹ ਨ ਭੇਟਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
37.t: raakhat hai apano kar dhai kar paap sa(n)booh na bheTan paavai ||
37.e: When the Lord protects with his own hands, but none of the sins even comes near thee.

37.g: ਔਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਤ ਕਹਾ ਕਹ ਤੋ ਸੌਂ ਸੁ ਪੇਟ ਹੀ ਕੇ ਪਟ ਬੀਚ ਬਚਾਵੈ ॥੬॥੨੪੮॥
37.t: aauar kee baat kahaa keh to saua(n) su peT hee ke paT beech bachaavai ||6||248||
37.e: What else should I say unto you, He protects (the infant) even in the membranes of the womb.6.248.

37.g: ਜੱਛ ਭੁਜੰਗ ਸੁ ਦਾਨਵ ਦੇਵ ਅਭੇਵ ਤੁਮੈ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਕਰਿ ਧਿਆਵੈਂ ॥
37.t: ja'chh bhuja(n)g su dhaanav dhev abhev tumai sabh hee kar dhiaavai(n) ||
37.e: The Yakshas, serpents, demons and gods meditate on Thee considering Thee as Indiscriminant.

37.g: ਭੂਮਿ ਅਕਾਸ ਪਤਾਲ ਰਸਾਤਲ ਜੱਛ ਭੁਜੰਗ ਸਭੈ ਸਿਰ ਨਿਆਵੈਂ ॥
37.t: bhoom akaas pataal rasaatal ja'chh bhuja(n)g sabhai sir niaavai(n) ||
37.e: The beings of the earth, Yakshas of the sky and the serpents of the nether-world bow their heads before thee.

37.g: ਪਾਇ ਸਕੈ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਭਾ ਹੂ ਕੋ ਨੇਤ ਹੀ ਨੇਤਹ ਬੇਦ ਬਤਾਵੈਂ ॥
37.t: pai sakai nahee paar prabhaa hoo ko net hee neteh bedh bataavai(n) ||
37.e: None could comprehend the limits of Thy Glory and even the Vedas declare Thee as ‘Neti, Neti’

37.g: ਖੋਜ ਥਕੇ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਖੁਜੀਆ ਸੁਰ ਹਾਰ ਪਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਾਥ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥੭॥੨੪੯॥
37.t: khoj thake sabh hee khujeeaa sur haar pare har haath na aavai ||7||249||
37.e: All the searchers have got tired in their search and none of them could realize the Lord. 7.249.

37.g: ਨਾਰਦ ਸੇ ਚਤੁਰਾਨਨ ਸੇ ਰੁਮਨਾ ਰਿਖ ਸੇ ਸਭ ਹੂੰ ਮਿਲਿ ਗਾਇਓ ॥
37.t: naaradh se chaturaanan se rumanaa rikh se sabh hoo(n) mil gaio ||
37.e: Narada, Brahma and the sage Rumna all have together sung Thy Praises.

37.g: ਬੇਦ ਕਤੇਬ ਨ ਭੇਦ ਲਖਿਓ ਸਭ ਹਾਰ ਪਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਾਥਿ ਨ ਆਇਓ ॥
37.t: bedh kateb na bhedh lakhio sabh haar pare har haath na aaio ||
37.e: The Vedas and Katebs could not know His sectet  all have got tired, but the Lord could not be realised.

37.g: ਪਾਇ ਸਕੈ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਰ ਉਮਾਪਤਿ ਸਿੱਧ ਸਨਾਥ ਸਨੰਤਨ ਧਿਆਇਓ ॥
37.t: pai sakai nahee paar umaapat si'dh sanaath sana(n)tan dhiaaio ||
37.e: Shiva also could not know His limits  the adepts (Siddhas) alongwith Naths and Sanak etc. meditated upon Him.

37.g: ਧਿਆਨ ਧਰੋ ਤਿਹ ਕੋ ਮਨ ਮੈਂ ਜਿਹ ਕੋ ਅਮਿਤੋਜਿ ਸਭੈ ਜਗੁ ਛਾਇਓ ॥੮॥੨੫੦॥
37.t: dhiaan dharo teh ko man mai(n) jeh ko amitoj sabhai jag chhaio ||8||250||
37.e: Concentrate upon Him in thy mind, whose Unlimited Glory is spread in all the world.8.250.

37.g: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਕਤੇਬ ਕੁਰਾਨ ਅਭੇਦ ਨ੍ਰਿਪਾਨ ਸਭੈ ਪਚ ਹਾਰੇ ॥
37.t: bedh puraan kateb kuraan abhedh nirapaan sabhai pach haare ||
37.e: The Vedas, Puranas, Katebs and the Quran and kings…all are tired and greatly afflicted by not knowing the Lord’s mystery.

37.g: ਭੇਦ ਨ ਪਾਇ ਸਕਿਓ ਅਨਭੇਦ ਕੋ ਖੇਦਤ ਹੈ ਅਨਛੇਦ ਪੁਕਾਰੇ ॥
37.t: bhedh na pai sakio anabhedh ko khedhat hai anachhedh pukaare ||
37.e: They could not comprehend the mystery of the Indis-criminate Lord, being greatly aggrieved, they recite Name of the Unassailable Lord.

37.g: ਰਾਗ ਨ ਰੂਪ ਨ ਰੇਖ ਨ ਰੰਗ ਨ ਸਾਕ ਨ ਸੋਗ ਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਤਿਹਾਰੇ ॥
37.t: raag na roop na rekh na ra(n)g na saak na sog na sa(n)g tihaare ||
37.e: The Lord who is without affection, form, mark, colour, relative, and sorrow, abides with thee.

37.g: ਆਦਿ ਅਨਾਦਿ ਅਗਾਧ ਅਭੇਖ ਅਦ੍ਵੈਖ ਜਪਿਓ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰੇ ॥੯॥੨੫੧॥
37.t: aadh anaadh agaadh abhekh adhavaikh japio tin hee kul taare ||9||251||
37.e: Those who have remembered that Primal , beginningless, guiseless and blemishless Lord, they have ferried across their whole clan.9.251

37.g: ਤੀਰਥ ਕੋਟ ਕੀਏ ਇਸਨਾਨ ਦੀਏ ਬਹੁ ਦਾਨ ਮਹਾ ਬ੍ਰਤ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
37.t: teerath koT ke'ee isanaan dhe'ee bahu dhaan mahaa brat dhaare ||
37.e: Having taken bath at millions of pilgrim-stations, having given many gifts in charity and giving observed important fasts.

37.g: ਦੇਸ ਫਿਰਿਓ ਕਰ ਭੇਸ ਤਪੋਧਨ ਕੇਸ ਧਰੇ ਨ ਮਿਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
37.t: dhes firio kar bhes tapodhan kes dhare na mile har piaare ||
37.e: Having wandered in the garb of an ascetic in many countries and having worn matted hair, the beloved Lord could not be realised.

37.g: ਆਸਨ ਕੋਟ ਕਰੇ ਅਸਟਾਂਗ ਧਰੇ ਬਹੁ ਨਿਆਸ ਕਰੇ ਮੁਖ ਕਾਰੇ ॥
37.t: aasan koT kare asaTaa(n)g dhare bahu niaas kare mukh kaare ||
37.e: Adopting millions of postures and observing the eight steps of Yoga, touching the limbs while reciting the mantras and blackening the face.

37.g: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਅਕਾਲ ਭਜੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਅੰਤ ਕੋ ਅੰਤ ਕੇ ਧਾਮ ਸਿਧਾਰੇ ॥੧੦॥੨੫੨॥
37.t: dheen dhiaal akaal bhaje bin a(n)t ko a(n)t ke dhaam sidhaare ||10||252||
37.e: But without the remembrance of the Non-temporal and Merciful Lord of the lowly, one will ultimately go to the abode of Yama. 10.252.

37.g: ਤ੍ਵ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥ ਕਬਿੱਤ ॥
37.t: tavai prasaadh || kabi't ||
37.e: BY THY GRACE KABITT

37.g: ਅਤ੍ਰ ਕੇ ਚਲੱਯਾ ਛਿਤ ਛਤ੍ਰ ਕੇ ਧਰੱਯਾ ਛਤ੍ਰ ਧਾਰੀਓ ਕੇ ਛਲੱਯਾ ਮਹਾ ਸਤ੍ਰਨ ਕੇ ਸਾਲ ਹੈਂ ॥
37.t: atr ke chala'yaa chhit chhatr ke dhara'yaa chhatr dhaareeo ke chhala'yaa mahaa satran ke saal hai(n) ||
37.e: He operates the weapons, beguiles the sovereigns of the earth having canopies over their heads and mashes the mighty enemies.

37.g: ਦਾਨ ਕੇ ਦਿਵੱਯਾ ਮਹਾ ਮਾਨ ਕੇ ਬਢੱਯਾ ਅਵਸਾਨ ਕੇ ਦਿਵੱਯਾ ਹੈਂ ਕਟੱਯਾ ਜਮ ਜਾਲ ਹੈਂ ॥
37.t: dhaan ke dhiva'yaa mahaa maan ke badda'yaa avasaan ke dhiva'yaa hai(n) kaTa'yaa jam jaal hai(n) ||
37.e: He is the Donor of gifts, He causes to enhance the great honour, He is the giver of encouragement for greater effort and is the cutter of the snare of death.

38.g: ਜੁੱਧ ਕੇ ਜਿਤੱਯਾ ਔ ਬਿਰੱੁਧ ਕੇ ਮਿਟੱਯਾ ਮਹਾਂ ਬੱੁਧਿ ਕੇ ਦਿਵੱਯਾ ਮਹਾਂ ਮਾਨਹੂੰ ਕੇ ਮਾਨ ਹੈਂ ॥
38.t: ju'dh ke jita'yaa aau bira'udh ke miTa'yaa mahaa(n) ba'udh ke dhiva'yaa mahaa(n) maanahoo(n) ke maan hai(n) ||
38.e: He is the conqueror of war and effacer of the opposition, He is giver of great intellect and the Honour of the illustrious.

38.g: ਗਿਆਨ ਹੂੰ ਕੇ ਗਿਆਤਾ ਮਹਾਂ ਬੁੱਧਿਤਾ ਕੇ ਦਾਤਾ ਦੇਵ ਕਾਲ ਹੂੰ ਕੇ ਕਾਲ ਮਹਾ ਕਾਲ ਹੂੰ ਕੇ ਕਾਲ ਹੈਂ ॥੧॥੨੫੩॥
38.t: giaan hoo(n) ke giaataa mahaa(n) bu'dhitaa ke dhaataa dhev kaal hoo(n) ke kaal mahaa kaal hoo(n) ke kaal hai(n) ||1||253||
38.e: He is the knower of the knowledge, the giver-god of he supreme intellect  He is the death of death and also the death of the supreme death (Maha Kal).1.253.

38.g: ਪੂਰਬੀ ਨ ਪਾਰ ਪਾਵੈਂ ਹਿੰਗੁਲਾ ਹਿਮਾਲੈ ਧਿਆਵੈਂ ਗੋਰ ਗਰਦੇਜੀ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈਂ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਹੈਂ ॥
38.t: poorabee na paar paavai(n) hi(n)gulaa himaalai dhiaavai(n) gor garadhejee gun gaavai(n) tere naam hai(n) ||
38.e: The inhabitants of the east could not know Thy end, the people of Hingala and Himalaya mountains remember Thee, residents of Gor and Gardez sing he Praises of Thy Name.

38.g: ਜੋਗੀ ਜੋਗ ਸਾਧੈ ਪਉਨ ਸਾਧਨਾ ਕਿਤੇਕ ਬਾਧੈ ਆਰਬ ਕੇ ਆਰਬੀ ਅਰਾਧੈਂ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਹੈਂ ॥
38.t: jogee jog saadhai paun saadhanaa kitek baadhai aarab ke aarabee araadhai(n) tere naam hai(n) ||
38.e: The Yogis perform Yoga, many are absorbed in doing Pranayama and residents of Arabia remember Thy Name.

38.g: ਫਰਾ ਕੇ ਫਿਰੰਗੀ ਮਾਨੈਂ ਕੰਧਾਰੀ ਕੁਰੇਸੀ ਜਾਨੈਂ ਪਛਮ ਕੇ ਪੱਛਮੀ ਪਛਾਨੈਂ ਨਿਜ ਕਾਮ ਹੈਂ ॥
38.t: faraa ke fira(n)gee maanai(n) ka(n)dhaaree kuresee jaanai(n) pachham ke pa'chhamee pachhaanai(n) nij kaam hai(n) ||
38.e: The people of France and England revere Thee, the inhabitants of Kandhaar and Quraishis know Thee  the people of western side recognize their duty towards Thee.

38.g: ਮਰਹਟਾ ਮਘੇਲੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਮਨ ਸੋਂ ਤਪਸਿਆ ਕਰੈ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਵੈ ਤਿਲੰਗੀ ਪਹਚਾਨੇ ਧਰਮ ਧਾਮ ਹੈਂ ॥੨॥੨੫੪॥
38.t: marahaTaa maghele teree man so(n) tapasiaa karai dhiraRavai tila(n)gee pahachaane dharam dhaam hai(n) ||2||254||
38.e: The inhabitants of Maharashtra and Magadha perform austerities with profound affection  the residents of Drawar and Tilang countries recognise Thee as the Abode of Dharma.2.254

38.g: ਬੰਗ ਕੇ ਬੰਗਾਲੀ ਫਿਰਹੰਗ ਕੇ ਫਿਰੰਗਾਵਾਲੀ ਦਿਲੀ ਕੇ ਦਿਲਵਾਲੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਮੈ ਚਲਤ ਹੈਂ ॥
38.t: ba(n)g ke ba(n)gaalee firaha(n)g ke fira(n)gaavaalee dhilee ke dhilavaalee teree aagiaa mai chalat hai(n) ||
38.e: The Bengalis of Bengal, the Phirangis of Phirangistan and Dilwalis of Delhi are the followers of Thy Command.

38.g: ਰੋਹ ਕੇ ਰੁਹੇਲੇ ਮਾਘ ਦੇਸ ਕੇ ਮਘੇਲੇ ਬੀਰ ਬੰਗਸੀ ਬੁੰਦੇਲੇ ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਜ ਕੋ ਮਲਤ ਹੈਂ ॥
38.t: roh ke ruhele maagh dhes ke maghele beer ba(n)gasee bu(n)dhele paap pu(n)j ko malat hai(n) ||
38.e: The Rohelas of Rohu mountain, the Maghelas of Magadha, the heroic Bangasis of Bangas and the Bundhelas of Bundhelkhand destroy their sins in Thy devotion.

38.g: ਗੋਖਾ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ਚੀਨ ਮਚੀਨ ਕੇ ਸੀਸ ਨ੍ਯਾਵੈ ਤਿੱਬਤੀ ਧਿਆਇ ਦੋਖ ਦੇਹ ਕੋ ਦਲਤ ਹੈਂ ॥
38.t: gokhaa gun gaavai cheen macheen ke sees nayaavai ti'batee dhiaai dhokh dheh ko dhalat hai(n) ||
38.e: Gorkhas sing Thy Praises, the residents of China and Manchuria bow their heads before Thee and the Tibetans destroy the sufferings of their bodies by remembering Thee.

38.g: ਜਿਨੈ ਤੋਹਿ ਧਿਆਇਓ ਤਿਨੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪ ਪਾਇਓ ਸਰਬ ਧਨ ਧਾਮ ਫਲ ਫੂਲ ਸੋਂ ਫਲਤ ਹੈਂ ॥੩॥੨੫੫॥
38.t: jinai toh dhiaaio tinai pooran prataap paio sarab dhan dhaam fal fool so(n) falat hai(n) ||3||255||
38.e: Those who meditated on Thee, they obtained perfect Glory, they obtained perfect Glory, they prosper greatly with wealth, fruit and flowers in their homes.3.255.

38.g: ਦੇਵ ਦੇਵਤਾਨ ਕੌ ਸੁਰੇਸ ਦਾਨਵਾਨ ਕੌ ਮਹੇਸ ਗੰਗ ਧਾਨ ਕੌ ਅਭੇਸ ਕਹੀਅਤੁ ਹੈਂ ॥
38.t: dhev dhevataan kau sures dhaanavaan kau mahes ga(n)g dhaan kau abhes kaheeat hai(n) ||
38.e: Thou art called Indra among gods, Shiva among the donors and also garbless though he wears the Ganges.

38.g: ਰੰਗ ਮੈ ਰੰਗੀਨ ਰਾਗ ਰੂਪ ਮੈਂ ਪ੍ਰਬੀਨ ਔਰ ਕਾਹੂ ਪੈ ਨ ਦੀਨ ਸਾਧ ਅਧੀਨ ਕਹੀਅਤੁ ਹੈਂ ॥
38.t: ra(n)g mai ra(n)geen raag roop mai(n) prabeen aauar kaahoo pai na dheen saadh adheen kaheeat hai(n) ||
38.e: Thou art the brightness in colour, adept in sound and beauty, and not low before anybody, but obedient to the saint.

38.g: ਪਾਈਐ ਨ ਪਾਰ ਤੇਜ ਪੁੰਜ ਮੈਂ ਅਪਾਰ ਸਰਬ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਕੇ ਉਦਾਰ ਹੈਂ ਅਪਾਰ ਕਹੀਅਤੁ ਹੈਂ ॥
38.t: paieeaai na paar tej pu(n)j mai(n) apaar sarab bidhiaa ke udhaar hai(n) apaar kaheeat hai(n) ||
38.e: One cannot know Thy limit, O Infinitely Glorious Lord! Thou art the Giver of all learning, therefore Thou art called Boundless.

38.g: ਹਾਥੀ ਕੀ ਪੁਕਾਰ ਪਲ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਹੁਚਤ ਤਾਹਿ ਚੀਟੀ ਕੀ ਚਿੰਘਾਰ ਪਹਿਲੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਨੀਅਤੁ ਹੈਂ ॥੪॥੨੫੬॥
38.t: haathee kee pukaar pal paachhai pahuchat taeh cheeTee kee chi(n)ghaar pahile hee suneeat hai(n) ||4||256||
38.e: The cry of an elephant reaches Thee after some time, but the trumpet of an ant is heard by Thee before it.4.256

38.g: ਕੇਤੇ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਦੁਆਰ ਕੇਤੇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਮੁਖ ਚਾਰ ਕੇਤੇ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਕੇਤੇ ਰਾਮ ਕਹੀਅਤੁ ਹੈਂ ॥
38.t: kete i(n)dhr dhuaar kete brahamaa mukh chaar kete kirasan avataar kete raam kaheeat hai(n) ||
38.e: There are many Indras, many four-headded Brahmas, many incarnations of Krishna and many called Ram at His Gate.

38.g: ਕੇਤੇ ਸਸਿ ਰਾਸੀ ਕੇਤੇ ਸੂਰਜ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸੀ ਕੇਤੇ ਮੁੰਡੀਆ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਜੋਗ ਦੁਆਰ ਕਹੀਅਤੁ ਹੈਂ ॥
38.t: kete sas raasee kete sooraj prakaasee kete mu(n)ddeeaa udhaasee jog dhuaar kaheeat hai(n) ||
38.e: There are many moons, many signs of Zodiac and many illuminating suns, there are many ascetics, stoics and Yogis consuming their bodies with austerity at His Gate.

38.g: ਕੇਤੇ ਮਹਾਦੀਨ ਕੇਤੇ ਬਿਆਸ ਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਬੀਨ ਕੇਤੇ ਕੁਮੇਰ ਕੁਲੀਨ ਕੇਤੇ ਜਛ ਕਹੀਅਤੁ ਹੈਂ ॥
38.t: kete mahaadheen kete biaas se prabeen kete kumer kuleen kete jachh kaheeat hai(n) ||
38.e: There are many Muhammads, many adepts like Vyas, many Kumars (Kubers) and many belonging to high clans and many are called Yakshas.

38.g: ਕਰਤ ਹੈਂ ਬਿਚਾਰ ਪੈ ਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਕੋ ਪਾਵੈ ਪਾਰ ਤਾਹੀ ਤੇ ਅਪਾਰ ਨਿਰਾਧਾਰ ਲਹੀਅਤੁ ਹੈਂ ॥੫॥੨੫੭॥
38.t: karat hai(n) bichaar pai na pooran ko paavai paar taahee te apaar niraadhaar laheeat hai(n) ||5||257||
38.e: All of them reflect upon Him, but none can know His limit, therefore they consider the Infinite Lord Supportless.5.257.

38.g: ਪੂਰਨ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਨਿਰਾਧਾਰ ਹੈ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰ ਪਾਈਐ ਨ ਪਾਰ ਪੈ ਅਪਾਰ ਕੈ ਬਖਾਨੀਐ ॥
38.t: pooran avataar niraadhaar hai na paaraavaar paieeaai na paar pai apaar kai bakhaaneeaai ||
38.e: He is Perfect Entity, Supportless and without Limits, His end is unknown, therefore He is described as Infinite.

38.g: ਅਦ੍ਵੈ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਪਰਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸੀ ਮਹਾ ਰੂਪ ਹੂੰ ਕੇ ਰਾਸੀ ਹੈਂ ਅਨਾਸੀ ਕੈ ਕੈ ਮਾਨੀਐ ॥
38.t: adhavai abinaasee param pooran prakaasee mahaa roop hoo(n) ke raasee hai(n) anaasee kai kai maaneeaai ||
38.e: He is Non-dual, Immortal, Supreme, Perfectly Lustrous, Treasure of Supreme Beauty and deemed eternal.

38.g: ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਹੂੰ ਨ ਜਾਤ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਬਾਪ ਹੂੰ ਨ ਮਾਇ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਭਾ ਕੀ ਸੁ ਛਟਾ ਕੈ ਅਨੁਮਾਨੀਐ ॥
38.t: ja(n)tr hoo(n) na jaat jaa kee baap hoo(n) na mai taa kee pooran prabhaa kee su chhaTaa kai anumaaneeaai ||
38.e: He is without Yantra (mystical diagram) and caste, without father and mother and presumed as the splash of Perfect beauty.

38.g: ਤੇਜ ਹੂੰ ਕੋ ਤੰਤ੍ਰ ਹੈਂ ਕਿ ਰਾਜਸੀ ਕੋ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਹੈਂ ਕਿ ਮੋਹਨੀ ਕੋ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਹੈਂ ਨਿਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਕੈ ਕੈ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥੬॥੨੫੮॥
38.t: tej hoo(n) ko ta(n)tr hai(n) k raajasee ko ja(n)tr hai(n) k mohanee ko ma(n)tr hai(n) nija(n)tr kai kai jaaneeaai ||6||258||
38.e: It cannot be said whether He is the Abode of Splendour of political mechanism or the incantaion of an enchantress or the inspiration of all of them. 6.258.

38.g: ਤੇਜ ਹੂੰ ਕੋ ਤਰੁ ਹੈਂ ਕਿ ਰਾਜਸੀ ਕੋ ਸਰੁ ਹੈਂ ਕਿ ਸੱੁਧਤਾ ਕੋ ਘਰੁ ਹੈਂ ਕਿ ਸਿੱਧਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਾਰੁ ਹੈਂ ॥
38.t: tej hoo(n) ko tar hai(n) k raajasee ko sar hai(n) k sa'udhataa ko ghar hai(n) k si'dhataa kee saar hai(n) ||
38.e: Is He the tree of Splendour? Is He the tank of activity? Is He the Abode of Purity? Is He the essence of Powers?

38.g: ਕਾਮਨਾ ਕੀ ਖਾਨ ਹੈਂ ਕਿ ਸਾਧਨਾ ਕੀ ਸਾਨ ਹੈਂ ਬਿਰਕਤਤਾ ਕੀ ਬਾਨ ਹੈਂ ਕਿ ਬੁੱਧਿ ਕੋ ਉਦਾਰ ਹੈਂ ॥
38.t: kaamanaa kee khaan hai(n) k saadhanaa kee saan hai(n) birakatataa kee baan hai(n) k bu'dh ko udhaar hai(n) ||
38.e: Is He the treasure of he fulfillment of desires? Is He the Glory of discipline? Is He the dignity of asceticism? Is He the master of generous intellect?

38.g: ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸਰੂਪ ਹੈਂ ਕਿ ਭੂਪਨ ਕੋ ਭੂਪ ਹੈਂ ਕਿ ਰੂਪ ਹੂੰ ਕੋ ਰੂਪ ਹੈਂ ਕੁਮਤਿ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰੁ ਹੈਂ ॥
38.t: su(n)dhar saroop hai(n) k bhoopan ko bhoop hai(n) k roop hoo(n) ko roop hai(n) kumat ko prahaar hai(n) ||
38.e: Doth He contain beautiful form? Is He the king of kings? Is He the beauty? Is He the Destroyer of bad intellect?

38.g: ਦੀਨਨ ਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਹੈਂ ਗਨੀਮਨ ਕੋ ਗਾਰਕ ਹੈਂ ਸਾਧਨ ਕੋ ਰੱਛਕ ਹੈ ਗੁਨਨ ਕੋ ਪਹਾਰੁ ਹੈਂ ॥੭॥੨੫੯॥
38.t: dheenan ko dhaataa hai(n) ganeeman ko gaarak hai(n) saadhan ko ra'chhak hai gunan ko pahaar hai(n) ||7||259||
38.e: Is He the Donor of the poor? Is He the perisher of the enemies? Is he the Protector of the saints? Is He the mountain of qualities? 7.259.

38.g: ਸਿੱਧ ਕੋ ਸਰੂਪ ਹੈਂ ਕਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਕੋ ਬਿਭੂਤਿ ਹੈਂ ਕਿ ਕ੍ਰੁਧ ਕੋ ਅਭੂਤ ਹੈਂ ਕਿ ਅੱਛੈ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਹੈਂ ॥
38.t: si'dh ko saroop hai(n) k budh ko bibhoot hai(n) k krudh ko abhoot hai(n) k a'chhai abinaasee hai(n) ||
38.e: He is the salvation-incarnate, He is the wealth of intellect, He is the destroyer of anger, He is Unassailable and eternal.

38.g: ਕਾਮ ਕੋ ਕੁਨਿੰਦਾ ਹੈਂ ਕਿ ਖੂਬੀ ਕੋ ਦਿਹੰਦਾ ਹੈਂ ਗਨੀਮ ਗਰਿੰਦਾ ਹੈਂ ਕਿ ਤੇਜ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸੀ ਹੈਂ ॥
38.t: kaam ko kuni(n)dhaa hai(n) k khoobee ko dhiha(n)dhaa hai(n) ganeem gari(n)dhaa hai(n) k tej ko prakaasee hai(n) ||
38.e: He is the doer of errand and the giver of qualities. He is the perisher of enemies and igniter of fire.;

38.g: ਕਾਲ ਹੂੰ ਕੋ ਕਾਲ ਹੈਂ ਕਿ ਸਤ੍ਰਨ ਕੋ ਸਾਲ ਹੈਂ ਕਿ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਨ ਕੋ ਪੋਖਤ ਹੈਂ ਕਿ ਬ੍ਰਿਧਤਾ ਕੋ ਬਾਸੀ ਹੈਂ ॥
38.t: kaal hoo(n) ko kaal hai(n) k satran ko saal hai(n) k mitran ko pokhat hai(n) k biradhataa ko baasee hai(n) ||
38.e: He is the death of death and smasher of enemies; He is the Protector of Friends and subduer of excellence.

38.g: ਜੋਗ ਹੂੰ ਕੋ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਹੈਂ ਕਿ ਤੇਜ ਹੂੰ ਕੋ ਤੰਤ੍ਰ ਹੈਂ ਕਿ ਮੋਹਨੀ ਕੋ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਹੈਂ ਕਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸੀ ਹੈਂ ॥੮॥੨੬੦॥
38.t: jog hoo(n) ko ja(n)tr hai(n) k tej hoo(n) ko ta(n)tr hai(n) k mohanee ko ma(n)tr hai(n) k pooran prakaasee hai(n) ||8||260||
38.e: He is the mystical diagram of gaining control over Yoga, He is the mystical formula of overpowering glory; He is the incantation of bewitching the enchantress and perfect enlightener.8.260.

38.g: ਰੂਪ ਕੋ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਹੈਂ ਕਿ ਬੁੱਧਿ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸ ਹੈਂ ਕਿ ਸਿੱਧਤਾ ਕੋ ਬਾਸ ਹੈਂ ਕਿ ਬੁੱਧਿ ਹੂੰ ਕੋ ਘਰੁ ਹੈਂ ॥
38.t: roop ko nivaas hai(n) k bu'dh ko prakaas hai(n) k si'dhataa ko baas hai(n) k bu'dh hoo(n) ko ghar hai(n) ||
38.e: He is the Abode of Beauty and enlightener of intellect; He is the home of salvation and the dwelling of intelligence.

38.g: ਦੇਵਨ ਕੋ ਦੇਵ ਹੈਂ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਅਭੇਵ ਹੈਂ ਅਦੇਵਨ ਕੋ ਦੇਵ ਹੈਂ ਕਿ ਸੁੱਧਤਾ ਕੋ ਸਰੁ ਹੈਂ ॥
38.t: dhevan ko dhev hai(n) nira(n)jan abhev hai(n) adhevan ko dhev hai(n) k su'dhataa ko sar hai(n) ||
38.e: He is the god of gods and the Indiscriminate Transcendent Lord; He is the Deity of the demons and the tank of Purity.

38.g: ਜਾਨ ਕੋ ਬਚੱਯਾ ਹੈਂ ਇਮਾਨ ਕੋ ਦਿਵੱਯਾ ਹੈਂ ਜਮ ਜਾਲ ਕੋ ਕੱਟਯਾ ਹੈਂ ਕਿ ਕਾਮਨਾ ਕੋ ਕਰੁ ਹੈਂ ॥
38.t: jaan ko bacha'yaa hai(n) imaan ko dhiva'yaa hai(n) jam jaal ko ka'Tayaa hai(n) k kaamanaa ko kar hai(n) ||
38.e: He is the Saviour of life and giver of faith; He is the chopper of the god of Death and the fulfiller of desires.

38.g: ਤੇਜ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਚੰਡ ਹੈਂ ਅਖੰਡਣ ਕੋ ਖੰਡ ਹੈਂ ਮਹੀਪਨ ਕੋ ਮੰਡ ਹੈਂ ਕਿ ਇਸਤ੍ਰੀ ਹੈਂ ਨ ਨਰੁ ਹੈਂ ॥੯॥੨੬੧॥
38.t: tej ko pracha(n)dd hai(n) akha(n)ddan ko kha(n)dd hai(n) maheepan ko ma(n)dd hai(n) k isatree hai(n) na nar hai(n) ||9||261||
38.e: He is the intensifier of Glory and breaker of the unbreakable; He is the establisher of kings, but Himself He is neither male nor female.9.261.

38.g: ਬਿਸ੍ਵ ਕੋ ਭਰਨ ਹੈਂ ਕਿ ਅਪਦਾ ਕੋ ਹਰਨ ਹੈਂ ਕਿ ਸੁਖ ਕੋ ਕਰਨ ਹੈਂ ਕਿ ਤੇਜ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸ਼ ਹੈਂ ॥
38.t: bisavai ko bharan hai(n) k apadhaa ko haran hai(n) k sukh ko karan hai(n) k tej ko prakaash hai(n) ||
38.e: He is the Sustainer of the Universe and remover of the trouble; He is the giver of comfort and igniter of the fire.

38.g: ਪਾਈਐ ਨ ਪਾਰ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰ ਹੂੰ ਕੋ ਪਾਰ ਜਾਂ ਕੋ ਕੀਜਤ ਬਿਚਾਰ ਸੁਬਿਚਾਰ ਕੋ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਹੈਂ ॥
38.t: paieeaai na paar paaraavaar hoo(n) ko paar jaa(n) ko keejat bichaar subichaar ko nivaas hai(n) ||
38.e: His limits and bounds cannot be known; if we reflect on Him, He is the Abode of all thoughts.

38.g: ਹਿੰਗੁਲਾ ਹਿਮਾਲੈ ਗਾਵੈ ਹਬਸੀ ਹੱਲਬੀ ਧਿਆਵੈ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਨ ਪਾਰ ਪਾਵੈ ਆਸਾ ਤੇ ਅਨਾਸ ਹੈਂ ॥
38.t: hi(n)gulaa himaalai gaavai habasee ha'labee dhiaavai poorabee na paar paavai aasaa te anaas hai(n) ||
38.e: The beings of Hingala and Himalaya sing His Praises; the people of Habash country and Halb city meditate on Him. The residents of the East do not know His end and losing all hope they have become disappointed.

38.g: ਦੇਵਨ ਕੋ ਦੇਵ ਮਹਾਦੇਵ ਹੂੰ ਕੇ ਦੇਵ ਹੈਂ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਅਭੇਵ ਨਾਥ ਅਦ੍ਵੈ ਅਬਿਨਾਸ ਹੈਂ ॥੧੦॥੨੬੨॥
38.t: dhevan ko dhev mahaadhev hoo(n) ke dhev hai(n) nira(n)jan abhev naath adhavai abinaas hai(n) ||10||262||
38.e: He is the god of gods and god of Supreme gods, He is Transcendent, Indiscriminate, Non-dual and Immortal Lord. 10.262.;

38.g: ਅੰਜਨ ਬਿਹੀਨ ਹੈਂ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਪ੍ਰਬੀਨ ਹੈਂ ਕਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਅਧੀਨ ਹੈ ਕਟੱਯਾ ਜਮ ਜਾਲ ਕੇ ॥
38.t: a(n)jan biheen hai(n) nira(n)jan prabeen hai(n) k sevak adheen hai kaTa'yaa jam jaal ke ||
38.e: He is without the impact of maya, He is adept and Transcendent Lord; He is obedient to his servant and is the chopper of the snare of Yama (god of death).

38.g: ਦੇਵਨ ਕੇ ਦੇਵ ਮਹਾਦੇਵ ਹੂੰ ਕੇ ਦੇਵਨਾਥ ਭੂਮ ਕੇ ਭੁਜੱਯਾ ਹੈ ਮੁਹੱਯਾ ਮਹਾ ਬਾਲ ਕੇ ॥
38.t: dhevan ke dhev mahaadhev hoo(n) ke dhevanaath bhoom ke bhuja'yaa hai muha'yaa mahaa baal ke ||
38.e: He is the god of gods and the Lord-God of the Supreme gods, He is Enjoyer of the earth and the Provider of the great power.;

38.g: ਰਾਜਨ ਕੇ ਰਾਜਾ ਮਹਾ ਸਾਜ ਹੂੰ ਕੇ ਸਾਜਾ ਮਹਾ ਜੋਗ ਹੂੰ ਕੇ ਜੋਗ ਹੈਂ ਧਰੱਯਾ ਦ੍ਰੁਮ ਛਾਲ ਕੇ ॥
38.t: raajan ke raajaa mahaa saaj hoo(n) ke saajaa mahaa jog hoo(n) ke jog hai(n) dhara'yaa dhrum chhaal ke ||
38.e: He is the king of kings and the decoration of the supreme decorations, He is the Supreme Yogi of the yogis wearing the bark of trees.;

38.g: ਕਾਮਨਾ ਕੇ ਕਰੁ ਹੈਂ ਕੁਬਿੱਧਿਤਾ ਕੋ ਹਰੁ ਹੈਂ ਕਿ ਸਿੱਧਤਾ ਕੇ ਸਾਥੀ ਹੈਂ ਕਿ ਕਾਲ ਹੈਂ ਕੁਚਾਲ ਕੇ ॥੧੧॥੨੬੩॥
38.t: kaamanaa ke kar hai(n) kubi'dhitaa ko har hai(n) k si'dhataa ke saathee hai(n) k kaal hai(n) kuchaal ke ||11||263||
38.e: He is the fulfiller of desire and remover of vicious intellect; He is the comrade of perfection and the destroyer of bad conduct.11.263.

38.g: ਛੀਰ ਕੈਸੀ ਛੀਰਾਵਧ ਛਾਛ ਕੈਸੀ ਛੱਤ੍ਰਾਨੇਰ ਛਪਾਕਰ ਕੈਸੀ ਛਬਿ ਕਾਲਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਕੇ ਕੂਲ ਕੈ ॥
38.t: chheer kaisee chheeraavadh chhaachh kaisee chha'traaner chhapaakar kaisee chhab kaali(n)dhree ke kool kai ||
38.e: Awadh is like milk and the town of Chhatraner is like buttermilk; the banks of Yamuna are beautiful like the brilliance of the moon.

38.g: ਹੰਸਨੀ ਸੀ ਸੀਹਾਰੂਮ ਹੀਰਾ ਸੀ ਹੁਸੈਨਾਬਾਦ ਗੰਗਾ ਕੈਸੀ ਧਾਰ ਚਲੀ ਸਾਤੋ ਸਿੰਧ ਰੂਲ ਕੈ ॥
38.t: ha(n)sanee see seehaaroom heeraa see husainaabaadh ga(n)gaa kaisee dhaar chalee saato si(n)dh rool kai ||
38.e: The country of rum is like the beautiful Hansani (damsel), the town of Husainabad is like a diamond; the winsome current of the Ganges make the seven seas diffident.

38.g: ਪਾਰਾ ਸੀ ਪਲਾਊਗਢ ਰੂਪਾ ਕੈਸੀ ਰਾਮਪੁਰ ਸੋਰਾ ਸੀ ਸੁਰੰਗਾਬਾਦ ਨੀਕੈ ਰਹੀ ਝੂਲ ਕੈ ॥
38.t: paaraa see palaauoogadd roopaa kaisee raamapur soraa see sura(n)gaabaadh neekai rahee jhool kai ||
38.e: Palayugarh is like mercury and Rampur is like siver; Surangabad is like nitre (swinging elegantly).

38.g: ਚੰਪਾ ਸੀ ਚੰਦੇਰੀ ਕੋਟ ਚਾਂਦਨੀ ਸੀ ਚਾਂਦਾਗੜ੍ਹ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਤਿਹਾਰੀ ਰਹੀ ਮਾਲਤੀ ਸੀ ਫੂਲ ਕੈ ॥੧੨॥੨੬੪॥
38.t: cha(n)paa see cha(n)dheree koT chaa(n)dhanee see chaa(n)dhaagaRh keerat tihaaree rahee maalatee see fool kai ||12||264||
38.e: Kot Chanderi is like Champa flower (Michelia Champacca), Chandagarh is like moonlight, but Thy Glory, O Lord! is like the beautiful flower of Malti (a creeper). 12.264.;

38.g: ਫਟਕ ਸੀ ਕੈਲਾਸ ਕਮਾਂਊਗੜ੍ਹ ਕਾਂਸੀਪੁਰ ਸੀਸਾ ਸੀ ਸੁਰੰਗਾਬਾਦਿ ਨੀਕੈ ਸੋਹੀਅਤੁ ਹੈ ॥
38.t: faTak see kailaas kamaa(n)uoogaRh kaa(n)seepur seesaa see sura(n)gaabaadh neekai soheeat hai ||
38.e: The places like Kaiilash, Kumayun and Kashipur are clear like crystal, and Surangabad looks graceful like glass.;

38.g: ਹਿਮਾ ਸੀ ਹਿਮਾਲੈਹਰ ਹਾਰ ਸੀ ਹੱਲਬਾ ਨੇਰ ਹੰਸ ਕੈਸੀ ਹਾਜੀਪੁਰ ਦੇਖੇ ਮੋਹੀਅਤੁ ਹੈ ॥
38.t: himaa see himaalaihar haar see ha'labaa ner ha(n)s kaisee haajeepur dhekhe moheeat hai ||
38.e: Himalaya bewitches the mind with whiteness of snow, Halbaner like milkyway and Hajipur like swan.;

38.g: ਚੰਦਨ ਸੀ ਚੰਪਾਵਤੀ ਚੰਦ੍ਰਮਾ ਸੀ ਚੰਦ੍ਰਾਗਿਰ ਚਾਂਦਨੀ ਸੀ ਚਾਂਦਗੜ੍ਹ ਜੌਨ ਜੋਹੀਅਤੁ ਹੈ ॥
38.t: cha(n)dhan see cha(n)paavatee cha(n)dhramaa see cha(n)dhraagir chaa(n)dhanee see chaa(n)dhagaRh jauan joheeat hai ||
38.e: Champawati looks like sandalwood, Chandragiri like moon and Chandagarh town like moonlight.;

38.g: ਗੰਗਾ ਸਮ ਗੰਗਧਾਰ ਬਕਾਨ ਸੀ ਬਲਿੰਦਾਵਾਦ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਤਿਹਾਰੀ ਕੀ ਉਜੀਆਰੀ ਸੋਹੀਅਤੁ ਹੈ ॥੧੩॥੨੬੫॥
38.t: ga(n)gaa sam ga(n)gadhaar bakaan see bali(n)dhaavaadh keerat tihaaree kee ujeeaaree soheeat hai ||13||265||
38.e: Gangadhar (Gandhar) seems like the Ganges and Bulandabad like a crane; all of them are the symbols of the splendour of Thy Praise.13.265.

38.g: ਫਰਾ ਸੀ ਫਿਰੰਗੀ ਫਰਾਸੀਸ ਕੇ ਦੁਰੰਗੀ ਮਕਰਾਨ ਕੇ ਮ੍ਰਿਦੰਗੀ ਤੇਰੇ ਗੀਤ ਗਾਈਅਤੁ ਹੈ ॥
38.t: faraa see fira(n)gee faraasees ke dhura(n)gee makaraan ke miradha(n)gee tere geet gaieeat hai ||
38.e: The Persians and the residents of Firangistan and France, people of two different colours and the Mridangis (inhabitants) of Makran sing the songs of Thy Praise.

38.g: ਭਖਰੀ ਕੰਧਾਰੀ ਗੋਰ ਗਖਰੀ ਗਰਦੇਜਾ ਚਾਰੀ ਪਉਨ ਕੇ ਅਹਾਰੀ ਤੇਰੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਅਤੁ ਹੈ ॥
38.t: bhakharee ka(n)dhaaree gor gakharee garadhejaa chaaree paun ke ahaaree tero naam dhiaaieeat hai ||
38.e: The people of Bhakkhar, Kandhar, Gakkhar and Arabia and others living only on air remember Thy Name.

38.g: ਪੂਰਬ ਪਲਾਊਂ ਕਾਮ ਰੂਪ ਔ ਕਮਾਊਂ ਸਰਬ ਠਉਰ ਮੈ ਬਿਰਾਜੈ ਜਹਾਂ ਜਹਾਂ ਜਾਈਅਤੁ ਹੈ ॥
38.t: poorab palaauoo(n) kaam roop aau kamaauoo(n) sarab Thaur mai biraajai jahaa(n) jahaa(n) jaieeat hai ||
38.e: At all the places including Palayu in the East, Kamrup and Kumayun, wherever we go, Thou art there.

38.g: ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪੀ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਤੇ ਅਤਾਪੀ ਨਾਥ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਤਿਹਾਰੀ ਕੋ ਨ ਪਾਰ ਪਾਈਅਤੁ ਹੈ ॥੧੪॥੨੬੬॥
38.t: pooran prataapee ja(n)tr ma(n)tr te ataapee naath keerat tihaaree ko na paar paieeat hai ||14||266||
38.e: Thou art perfectly Glorious, without any impact of Yantras and mantras, O Lord! The limits of Thy Praise cannot be known.14.266.

38.g: ਤ੍ਵ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥ ਪਾਧੜੀ ਛੰਦ ॥
38.t: tavai prasaadh || paadhaRee chha(n)dh ||
38.e: BY THY GRACE PAADHARI STANZA

38.g: ਅਦ੍ਵੈ ਅਨਾਸ ਆਸਨ ਅਡੋਲ ॥
38.t: adhavai anaas aasan addol ||
38.e: He is Non-dual, Indestructible, and hath Steady Seat.!

38.g: ਅਦ੍ਵੈ ਅਨੰਤ ਉਪਮਾ ਅਤੋਲ ॥
38.t: adhavai ana(n)t upamaa atol ||
38.e: He is Non-dual, Endless and of Immeasurable (Unweighable) Praise

38.g: ਅਛੈ ਸਰੂਪ ਅਬ੍ਯਕਤ ਨਾਥ ॥
38.t: achhai saroop abayakat naath ||
38.e: He is Unassailable Entity and Unmanifested Lord,!

38.g: ਆਜਾਨ ਬਾਹੁ ਸਰਬਾ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਥ ॥੧॥੨੬੭॥
38.t: aajaan baahu sarabaa pramaath ||1||267||
38.e: He is the Motivator of gods and destroyer of all. 1. 267;

38.g: ਜਹ ਤਹ ਮਹੀਪ ਬਨ ਤਿਨ ਪ੍ਰਫੁਲ ॥
38.t: jeh teh maheep ban tin praful ||
38.e: He is the Sovereign here, there, everywhere; He blossoms in forests and blades of grass.!

38.g: ਸੋਭਾ ਬਸੰਤ ਜਹ ਤਹ ਪੱ੍ਰਡੁਲ ॥
38.t: sobhaa basa(n)t jeh teh pa'raddul ||
38.e: Like the Splendour of the spring He is scattered here and there

38.g: ਬਨ ਤਨ ਦੁਰੰਤ ਖਗ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਮਹਾਨ ॥
38.t: ban tan dhura(n)t khag mirag mahaan ||
38.e: He, the Infinite and Supreme Lord is within the forest, blade of grass, bird and deer. !

38.g: ਜਹ ਤਹ ਪ੍ਰਫੱੁਲ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸੁਜਾਨ ॥੨॥੨੬੮॥
38.t: jeh teh prafa'ul su(n)dhar sujaan ||2||268||
38.e: He blossoms here, there and everywhere, the Beautiful and All-Knowing. 2. 268

38.g: ਫੁਲਤੰ ਪ੍ਰਫੁੱਲ ਲਹਿ ਲਹਿਤ ਮੌਰ ॥
38.t: fulata(n) prafu'l leh lahit mauar ||
38.e: The peacocks are delighted to see the blossoming flowers. !

38.g: ਸਿਰ ਢੁਰਹਿ ਜਾਨ ਮਨ ਮਥਹਿ ਚੌਰ ॥
38.t: sir ddureh jaan man matheh chauar ||
38.e: With bowed heads they are accepting the impact of Cupid

38.g: ਕੁਦਰਤ ਕਮਾਲ ਰਾਜ਼ਕ ਰਹੀਮ ॥
38.t: kudharat kamaal raazak raheem ||
38.e: O Sustainer and Merciful Lord! Thy Nature is Marvellous, !

38.g: ਕਰੁਣਾ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਕਾਮਲ ਕਰੀਮ ॥੩॥੨੬੯॥
38.t: karunaa nidhaan kaamal kareem ||3||269||
38.e: O the Treasure of Mercy, Perfect and Gracious Lord! 3. 269

38.g: ਜਂਹ ਤਂਹ ਬਿਲੋਕ ਤਂਹ ਤਂਹ ਪ੍ਰਸੋਹ ॥
38.t: ja(n)h ta(n)h bilok ta(n)h ta(n)h prasoh ||
38.e: Wherever I see, I feel Thy Touch there, O Motivator of gods.!

38.g: ਆਜਾਨੁ ਬਾਹੁ ਅਮਿਤੋਜ ਮੋਹ ॥
38.t: aajaan baahu amitoj moh ||
38.e: Thy Unlimited Glory is bewitching the mind

38.g: ਰੋਸੰ ਬਿਰਹਤ ਕਰਣਾ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
38.t: rosa(n) birahat karanaa nidhaan ||
38.e: Thou art devoid of anger, O Treasure of Mercy! Thou blossomest here, there and everywhere, !

38.g: ਜਂਹ ਤਂਹ ਪ੍ਰਫੁੱਲ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸੁਜਾਨ ॥੪॥੨੭੦॥
38.t: ja(n)h ta(n)h prafu'l su(n)dhar sujaan ||4||270||
38.e: O Beautiful and All-Knowing Lord! 4. 270

38.g: ਬਨ ਤਿਨ ਮਹੀਪ ਜਲ ਥਲ ਮਹਾਨ ॥
38.t: ban tin maheep jal thal mahaan ||
38.e: Thou art the king of forests and blades of grass, O Supreme Lorrd of waters and land! !

38.g: ਜਂਹ ਤਂਹ ਪ੍ਰਸੋਹ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
38.t: ja(n)h ta(n)h prasoh karunaa nidhaan ||
38.e: O the Treasure of Mercy, I feel Thy touch everywhere

38.g: ਜਗਮਗਤ ਤੇਜ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪ ॥
38.t: jagamagat tej pooran prataap ||
38.e: The Light is glittering, O perfectly Glorious Lord!!

38.g: ਅੰਬਰ ਜਿਮੀਨ ਜਿਹ ਜਪਤ ਜਾਪ ॥੫॥੨੭੧॥
38.t: a(n)bar jimeen jeh japat jaap ||5||271||
38.e: The Heaven and Earth are repeating Thy Name. 5. 271

38.g: ਸਾਤੋ ਅਕਾਸ ਸਾਤੋ ਪਤਾਰ ॥
38.t: saato akaas saato pataar ||
38.e: In all the seven Heavens and seven nether-worlds !

38.g: ਬਿਥਰਿਓ ਅਦਿਸਟ ਜਿਹ ਕਰਮ ਜਾਰਿ ॥ ਉਸਤਤ ਸੰਪੂਰਣੰ ॥
38.t: bithario adhisaT jeh karam jaar || usatat sa(n)poorana(n) ||
38.e: His net of karmas (actions) is invisibly spread. Praise is complete.

39.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
39.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
39.e: The Lord is One and He can be attained through the grace of the true Guru.

39.g: ਅਥ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਲਿਖ੍ਯਤੇ ॥
39.t: ath bachitr naaTak gra(n)th likhayate ||
39.e: Now the Granth (Book) entitled ‘BACHITTAR NATAK’ is composed.

39.g: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਮੁਖਬਾਕ ਪਾਤਸ਼ਾਹੀ ੧੦ ॥
39.t: sree mukhabaak paatashaahee 10 ||
39.e: From the Holy Mouth of the Tenth King (Guru)

39.g: ਤ੍ਵ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥ ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
39.t: tavai prasaadh || dhoharaa ||
39.e: BY THY GRACE.  DOHRA

39.g: ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਖੜਗ ਕੋ ਕਰੋਂ ਸੁ ਹਿਤੁ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
39.t: namasakaar sree khaRag ko karo(n) su hit chit lai ||
39.e: I salute the Glorious SWORD with all my heart’s affection.

39.g: ਪੂਰਨ ਕਰੋਂ ਗਿਰੰਥ ਇਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਮੁਹਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਸਹਾਇ ॥੧॥
39.t: pooran karo(n) gira(n)th ih tum muh karahu sahai ||1||
39.e: I shall complete this Granth only if Thou Helpest me. I.

39.g: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਕਾਲ ਜੀ ਕੀ ਉਸਤਤਿ ॥
39.t: sree kaal jee kee usatat ||
39.e: The Eulogy of the Revered Death (KAL).

39.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਭੰਗੀ ਛੰਦ ॥
39.t: tirabha(n)gee chha(n)dh ||
39.e: TRIBHANGI STANZA

39.g: ਖਗ ਖੰਡ ਬਿਹੰਡੰ ਖਲ ਦਲ ਖੰਡੰ ਅਤਿ ਰਣ ਮੰਡੰ ਬਰ ਬੰਡੰ ॥
39.t: khag kha(n)dd biha(n)dda(n) khal dhal kha(n)dda(n) at ran ma(n)dda(n) bar ba(n)dda(n) ||
39.e: The sword chops well, chops the forces of fools and this mighty one bedecks and glorifies the battlefield.

39.g: ਭੁਜ ਦੰਡ ਅਖੰਡੰ ਤੇਜ ਪ੍ਰਚੰਡੰ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਮੰਡੰ ਭਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੰ ॥
39.t: bhuj dha(n)dd akha(n)dda(n) tej pracha(n)dda(n) jot ama(n)dda(n) bhaan prabha(n) ||
39.e: It is the unbreakable staff of the arm, it has the powerful luster and its light even bedims the radiance of the sum.

39.g: ਸੁਖ ਸੰਤਾ ਕਰਣੰ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦਰਣੰ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਹਰਣੰ ਅਸਿ ਸਰਣੰ ॥
39.t: sukh sa(n)taa karana(n) dhuramat dharana(n) kilabikh harana(n) as sarana(n) ||
39.e: It brings happiness to the saints, mashing the vicious ones, it is the destroyer of sins and I and under its refuge.

39.g: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਜਗ ਕਾਰਣ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਬਾਰਣ ਮਮ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰਣ ਜੈ ਤੇਗੰ ॥੨॥
39.t: jai jai jag kaaran sirasaT ubaaran mam pratipaaran jai tega(n) ||2||
39.e: Hail, hail to the cause of the world, saviour of the universe, it is my preserver, I hail its victory. 2.

39.g: ਭੁਜੰਗ ਪ੍ਰਯਾਤ ਛੰਦ ॥
39.t: bhuja(n)g prayaat chha(n)dh ||
39.e: BHUJANG PRAYAAT STANZA

39.g: ਸਦਾ ਏਕ ਜੋਤ੍ਯੰ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸਰੂਪੰ ॥
39.t: sadhaa ek jotaya(n) ajoonee saroopa(n) ||
39.e: He, who is ever light-incarnate and birthless entity,

39.g: ਮਹਾ ਦੇਵ ਦੇਵੰ ਮਹਾ ਭੂਪ ਭੂਪੰ ॥
39.t: mahaa dhev dheva(n) mahaa bhoop bhoopa(n) ||
39.e: Who is the god of chief gods, the king of chief kings

39.g: ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਨਿਤ੍ਯੰ ਨਿਰੂਪੰ ਨ੍ਰਿਬਾਣੰ ॥
39.t: nira(n)kaar nitaya(n) niroopa(n) nirabaana(n) ||
39.e: Who is Formless, Eternal, Amorphous and Ultimate Bliss

39.g: ਕਲੰ ਕਾਰਣੇਯੰ ਨਮੋ ਖੜਗ ਪਾਣੰ ॥੩॥
39.t: kala(n) kaaraneya(n) namo khaRag paana(n) ||3||
39.e: Who is the Cause of all the Powers, I salute the wielder of the Sword. 3

39.g: ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਨ੍ਰਿਬਿਕਾਰ ਨਿਤ੍ਯੰ ਨਿਰਾਲੰ ॥
39.t: nira(n)kaar nirabikaar nitaya(n) niraala(n) ||
39.e: He is Formless, Flawless, eternal and Non-aligned

39.g: ਨ ਬ੍ਰਿਧੰ ਬਿਸੇਖੰ ਨ ਤਰੁਨੰ ਨ ਬਾਲੰ ॥
39.t: n biradha(n) bisekha(n) na taruna(n) na baala(n) ||
39.e: He is neither distinctively old, nor young nor immature;

39.g: ਨ ਰੰਕੰ ਨ ਰਾਯੰ ਨ ਰੂਪੰ ਨ ਰੇਖੰ ॥
39.t: n ra(n)ka(n) na raaya(n) na roopa(n) na rekha(n) ||
39.e: He is neither poor  nor rich;  He is Formless and Markless

39.g: ਨ ਰੰਗੰ ਨ ਰਾਗੰ ਅਪਾਰੰ ਅਭੇਖੰ ॥੪॥
39.t: n ra(n)ga(n) na raaga(n) apaara(n) abhekha(n) ||4||
39.e: He is Colourless, Non-attached, Limitless and Guiseless. 4;

39.g: ਨ ਰੂਪੰ ਨ ਰੇਖੰ ਨ ਰੰਗੰ ਨ ਰਾਗੰ ॥
39.t: n roopa(n) na rekha(n) na ra(n)ga(n) na raaga(n) ||
39.e: He is Formless, Signless, Colourless and Non-attached;

39.g: ਨ ਨਾਮੰ ਨ ਠਾਮੰ ਮਹਾ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਾਗੰ ॥
39.t: n naama(n) na Thaama(n) mahaa jot jaaga(n) ||
39.e: He is Nameless, Placeless; and a Radiating Great Effulgence

39.g: ਨ ਦ੍ਵੈਖੰ ਨ ਭੇਖੰ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਨਿਤ੍ਯੰ ॥
39.t: n dhavaikha(n) na bhekha(n) nira(n)kaar nitaya(n) ||
39.e: He is Blemishless, Guiseless, Formless and Eternal

39.g: ਮਹਾ ਜੋਗ ਜੋਗੰ ਸੁ ਪਰਮੰ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਯੰ ॥੫॥
39.t: mahaa jog joga(n) su parama(n) pavitaya(n) ||5||
39.e: He is a Superb Practising Yogi and a Supremely Holy Entity. 5

40.g: ਅਜੇਯੰ ਅਭੇਯੰ ਅਨਾਮੰ ਅਠਾਮੰ ॥
40.t: ajeya(n) abheya(n) anaama(n) aThaama(n) ||
40.e: He is unconquerable, Indistinguishable, Nameless and Placeless

40.g: ਮਹਾ ਜੋਗ ਜੋਗੰ ਮਹਾ ਕਾਮ ਕਾਮੰ ॥
40.t: mahaa jog joga(n) mahaa kaam kaama(n) ||
40.e: He is a Superb Practicing Yogi, He is the Supreme Ravisher

40.g: ਅਲੇਖੰ ਅਭੇਖੰ ਅਨੀਲੰ ਅਨਾਦੰ ॥
40.t: alekha(n) abhekha(n) aneela(n) anaadha(n) ||
40.e: He is Accountless, Garbless, Stainless and without Beginning

40.g: ਪਰੇਯੰ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰੰ ਸਦਾ ਨ੍ਰਿਬਿਖਾਦੰ ॥੬॥
40.t: pareya(n) pavitra(n) sadhaa nirabikhaadha(n) ||6||
40.e: He is in the Yond, Immaculate and ever without Contention. 6

40.g: ਸੁ ਆਦੰ ਅਨਾਦੰ ਅਨੀਲੰ ਅਨੰਤੰ ॥
40.t: s aadha(n) anaadha(n) aneela(n) ana(n)ta(n) ||
40.e: He is the Primal, Orignless, Stainless and Endless

40.g: ਅਦ੍ਵੈਖੰ ਅਭੇਖੰ ਮਹੇਸੰ ਮਹੰਤੰ ॥
40.t: adhavaikha(n) abhekha(n) mahesa(n) maha(n)ta(n) ||
40.e: He is Blemishless, Guiseless, Master of the earth and the destroyer of Pride

40.g: ਨ ਰੋਖੰ ਨ ਸੋਖੰ ਨ ਦ੍ਰੋਹੰ ਨ ਮੋਹੰ ॥
40.t: n rokha(n) na sokha(n) na dhroha(n) na moha(n) ||
40.e: He is Ireless, Ever fresh, Deceitless and Non-attached

40.g: ਨ ਕਾਮੰ ਨ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੰ ਅਜੋਨੀ ਅਜੋਹੰ ॥੭॥
40.t: n kaama(n) na krodha(n) ajonee ajoha(n) ||7||
40.e: He is Lustless, Angerless, Birthless and Sightless. 7

40.g: ਪਰੇਅੰ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰੰ ਪੁਨੀਤੰ ਪੁਰਾਣੰ ॥
40.t: parea(n) pavitra(n) puneeta(n) puraana(n) ||
40.e: He is in the Yond, Immaculate, Most Holy and Ancient

40.g: ਅਜੇਅੰ ਅਭੇਅੰ ਭਵਿਖ੍ਯੰ ਭਵਾਣੰ ॥
40.t: ajea(n) abhea(n) bhavikhaya(n) bhavaana(n) ||
40.e: He is Unconquerable, Indistinguishable, Will be in future and is always Present

40.g: ਨ ਰੋਗੰ ਨ ਸੋਗੰ ਸੁ ਨਿਤ੍ਯੰ ਨਵੀਨੰ ॥
40.t: n roga(n) na soga(n) su nitaya(n) naveena(n) ||
40.e: He is without ailment and sorrow and is ever new

40.g: ਅਜਾਯੰ ਸਹਾਯੰ ਪਰਮੰ ਪ੍ਰਬੀਨੰ ॥੮॥
40.t: ajaaya(n) sahaaya(n) parama(n) prabeena(n) ||8||
40.e: He is Birthless, He is the Supporter and is Supremely dexterous. 8

40.g: ਸੁ ਭੂਤੰ ਭਵਿਖ੍ਯੰ ਭਵਾਨੰ ਭਵੇਯੰ ॥
40.t: s bhoota(n) bhavikhaya(n) bhavaana(n) bhaveya(n) ||
40.e: He Pervades in the Past, Future and Present

40.g: ਨਮੋ ਨਿ੍ਰਿਬਕਾਰੰ ਨਮੋ ਨ੍ਰਿਜੁਰੇਅੰ ॥
40.t: namo nribakaara(n) namo nirajurea(n) ||
40.e: I Salute Him, Who is without vices and without ailments

40.g: ਨਮੋ ਦੇਵ ਦੇਵੰ ਨਮੋ ਰਾਜ ਰਾਜੰ ॥
40.t: namo dhev dheva(n) namo raaj raaja(n) ||
40.e: I Salute Him, Who is the god of gods and king of kings

40.g: ਨਿਰਾਲੰਬ ਨਿਤ੍ਯੰ ਸੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਧਿਰਾਜੰ ॥੯॥
40.t: niraala(n)b nitaya(n) su raajaa dhiraaja(n) ||9||
40.e: He is Supportless, Eternal and Greatest of Emperors. 9

40.g: ਅਲੇਖੰ ਅਭੇਖੰ ਅਭੂਤੰ ਅਦ੍ਵੈਖੰ ॥
40.t: alekha(n) abhekha(n) abhoota(n) adhavaikha(n) ||
40.e: He is Accountless, Guiseless, Elementless and Blemishless

40.g: ਨ ਰਾਗੰ ਨ ਰੰਗੰ ਨ ਰੂਪੰ ਨ ਰੇਖੰ ॥
40.t: n raaga(n) na ra(n)ga(n) na roopa(n) na rekha(n) ||
40.e: He is without attachment, colour, form and mark

40.g: ਮਹਾ ਦੇਵ ਦੇਵੰ ਮਹਾ ਜੋਗ ਜੋਗੰ ॥
40.t: mahaa dhev dheva(n) mahaa jog joga(n) ||
40.e: He is the Greatest of gods and the Supreme Yogi

40.g: ਮਹਾ ਕਾਮ ਕਾਮੰ ਮਹਾ ਭੋਗ ਭੋਗੰ ॥੧੦॥
40.t: mahaa kaam kaama(n) mahaa bhog bhoga(n) ||10||
40.e: He is the Greatest of the rapturous and the greatest of the Ravishing. 10

40.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਰਾਜਸੰ ਤਾਮਸੰ ਸਾਤਕੇਅੰ ॥
40.t: kahoo(n) raajasa(n) taamasa(n) saatakea(n) ||
40.e: Somewhere He bears the quality of rajas (activity), somewhere tamas (morbidity) and somewhere sattva (rhythm)

40.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਨਾਰ ਕੋ ਰੂਪ ਧਾਰੇ ਨਰੇਅੰ ॥
40.t: kahoo(n) naar ko roop dhaare narea(n) ||
40.e: Somewhere He takes the form of a woman and somewhere man

40.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਦੇਵੀਅੰ ਦੇਵਤੰ ਦਈਤ ਰੂਪੰ ॥
40.t: kahoo(n) dheveea(n) dhevata(n) dhieet roopa(n) ||
40.e: Somewhere He manifests Himself as a goddess, god and demon

40.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਰੂਪੰ ਅਨੇਕ ਧਾਰੇ ਅਨੂਪੰ ॥੧੧॥
40.t: kahoo(n) roopa(n) anek dhaare anoopa(n) ||11||
40.e: Somewhere He appears in several unique forms. 11

40.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਫੂਲ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਕੈ ਭਲੇ ਰਾਜ ਫੂਲੇ ॥
40.t: kahoo(n) fool havai kai bhale raaj foole ||
40.e: Somewhere He, taking the form of a flower, is rightly puffed up

40.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਭਵਰ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਕੈ ਭਲੀ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਭੂਲੇ ॥
40.t: kahoo(n) bhavar havai kai bhalee bhaa(n)t bhoole ||
40.e: Somewhere becoming a black bee, seems inebriated (for the flower)

40.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਪਉਨ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਕੈ ਬਹੇ ਬੇਗਿ ਐਸੇ ॥
40.t: kahoo(n) paun havai kai bahe beg aaise ||
40.e: Somewhere becoming the wind, moves with such speed,

40.g: ਕਹੇ ਮੋ ਨ ਆਵੇ ਕਥੋਂ ਤਾਹਿ ਕੈਸੇ ॥੧੨॥
40.t: kahe mo na aave katho(n) taeh kaise ||12||
40.e: Which is indescribable, how can I elucidate it?. 12

40.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਨਾਦ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਕੈ ਭਲੀ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਬਾਜੇ ॥
40.t: kahoo(n) naadh havai kai bhalee bhaa(n)t baaje ||
40.e: Somewhere He become a musical instrument, which is played appropriately

40.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਪਾਰਧੀ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਕੈ ਧਰੇ ਬਾਨ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
40.t: kahoo(n) paaradhee havai kai dhare baan raaje ||
40.e: Somewhere He becomes a hunter who looks glorious with His arrow (in His bow)

40.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਕੈ ਭਲੀ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਮੋਹੇ ॥
40.t: kahoo(n) mirag havai kai bhalee bhaa(n)t mohe ||
40.e: Somewhere He becomes a deer and allures exquisitely

40.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਕਾਮੁਕੀ ਜਿਉ ਧਰੇ ਰੂਪ ਸੋਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
40.t: kahoo(n) kaamukee jiau dhare roop sohe ||13||
40.e: Somewhere He manifests Himself as Cupid’s wife, with impressive beauty. 13

40.g: ਨਹੀਂ ਜਾਨਿ ਜਾਈ ਕਛੂ ਰੂਪ ਰੇਖੰ ॥
40.t: nahee(n) jaan jaiee kachhoo roop rekha(n) ||
40.e: His Form and Mark cannot be comprehended

40.g: ਕਹਾਂ ਬਾਸ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਫਿਰੈ ਕਉਨ ਭੇਖੰ ॥
40.t: kahaa(n) baas taa ko firai kaun bhekha(n) ||
40.e: Where doth He live and what guise doth He adopt?

40.g: ਕਹਾ ਨਾਮ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਕਹਾ ਕੈ ਕਹਾਵੈ ॥
40.t: kahaa naam taa ko kahaa kai kahaavai ||
40.e: What is His Name and how he is called?

40.g: ਕਹਾ ਮੈ ਬਖਾਨੋ ਕਹੇ ਮੋ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥੧੪॥
40.t: kahaa mai bakhaano kahe mo na aavai ||14||
40.e: How can I describle? He is Indescribable. 14

40.g: ਨ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਕੋਈ ਤਾਤ ਮਾਤੰ ਨ ਭਾਯੰ ॥
40.t: n taa ko koiee taat maata(n) na bhaaya(n) ||
40.e: He hath no father, mother and brother

40.g: ਨ ਪੁਤ੍ਰੰ ਨ ਪੌਤ੍ਰੰ ਨ ਦਾਯਾ ਨ ਦਾਯੰ ॥
40.t: n putra(n) na pauatra(n) na dhaayaa na dhaaya(n) ||
40.e: He hath no son, no grandson and no male and female nurses

40.g: ਨ ਨੇਹੰ ਨ ਗੇਹੰ ਨ ਸੈਨੰ ਨ ਸਾਥੰ ॥
40.t: n neha(n) na geha(n) na saina(n) na saatha(n) ||
40.e: He hath no attachment, no home, no army and no companion

40.g: ਮਹਾ ਰਾਜ ਰਾਜੰ ਮਹਾ ਨਾਥ ਨਾਥੰ ॥੧੫॥
40.t: mahaa raaj raaja(n) mahaa naath naatha(n) ||15||
40.e: He is the Great King of kings and Great Lord of lords. 15

40.g: ਪਰਮੰ ਪੁਰਾਨੰ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰੰ ਪਰੇਯੰ ॥
40.t: parama(n) puraana(n) pavitra(n) pareya(n) ||
40.e: He is Supreme, Ancient, Immaculate and in the Yond

40.g: ਅਨਾਦੰ ਅਨੀਲੰ ਅਸੰਭੰ ਅਜੇਯੰ ॥
40.t: anaadha(n) aneela(n) asa(n)bha(n) ajeya(n) ||
40.e: He is beginningless  Stainless, Non-existent and Unconquerable

40.g: ਅਭੇਦੰ ਅਛੇਦੰ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰੰ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਥੰ ॥
40.t: abhedha(n) achhedha(n) pavitra(n) pramaatha(n) ||
40.e: He is Indistinguishable, Indestructible, Holy and Paramount

40.g: ਮਹਾ ਦੀਨ ਦੀਨੰ ਮਹਾ ਨਾਥ ਨਾਥੰ ॥੧੬॥
40.t: mahaa dheen dheena(n) mahaa naath naatha(n) ||16||
40.e: He is the Most Humble of the meek and Great Lord of lords. 16

40.g: ਅਦਾਗੰ ਅਦੱਗੰ ਅਲੇਖੰ ਅਭੇਖੰ ॥
40.t: adhaaga(n) adha'ga(n) alekha(n) abhekha(n) ||
40.e: He is Stainless, Imperishable, Accountless and Guiseless

40.g: ਅਨੰਤੰ ਅਨੀਲੰ ਅਰੂਪੰ ਅਦ੍ਵੈਖੰ ॥
40.t: ana(n)ta(n) aneela(n) aroopa(n) adhavaikha(n) ||
40.e: He is Limitless, Blemishless, Formless and Maliceless

40.g: ਮਹਾ ਤੇਜ ਤੇਜੰ ਮਹਾ ਜ੍ਵਾਲ ਜ੍ਵਾਲੰ ॥
40.t: mahaa tej teja(n) mahaa javaiaal javaiaala(n) ||
40.e: He is the Most Effulgent of all lights and Supreme Conflagration of all fires

40.g: ਮਹਾ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੰ ਮਹਾ ਕਾਲ ਕਾਲੰ ॥੧੭॥
40.t: mahaa ma(n)tr ma(n)tra(n) mahaa kaal kaala(n) ||17||
40.e: He is the Supreme Spell of all incantations and Supreme embodiment of Death over all such powers. 17

41.e: He holds the bow in His left hand and the terrible sword (in the right)
He is the Supreme Effulgence of all lights and sits in His Great Glory

41.g: ਮਹਾ ਦਾੜ੍ਹ ਦਾੜ੍ਹੰ ਸੁ ਸੋਹੰ ਅਪਾਰੰ ॥
41.t: mahaa dhaaRh dhaaRha(n) su soha(n) apaara(n) ||
41.e: He, of Infinite Splendour, is the masher of of the boar-incarnation with great grinder tooth
He crushed and devoured thousands of the creatures of the world. 18
The tabor (in the hand of Great Death (KAL) resounds and the black and white canopy swings
Loud laughter emanates from his mouth and the weapons (in his hands) glisten

41.g: ਮਹਾ ਘੋਰ ਸਬਦੰ ਬਜੇ ਸੰਖ ਐਸੇ ॥
41.t: mahaa ghor sabadha(n) baje sa(n)kh aaise ||
41.e: His conch produces such a terrible sound

41.g: ਪ੍ਰਲੈ ਕਾਲ ਕੇ ਕਾਲ ਕੀ ਜ੍ਵਾਲ ਜੈਸੇ ॥੧੯॥
41.t: pralai kaal ke kaal kee javaiaal jaise ||19||
41.e: That appears like the blazing fire of the Death on doomsday. 19
RASAAVAL STANZA
Many gongs resound and hearing their sound,!
The clouds feel ashamed!
Such a sound is produced that it appears!
Like the sound of the surging waves of the sea! 20
The small bells of the feet jingle,!
And the anklets rattle!
Such sounds are peaceful sounds !
Against the great resounding (of gongs)! 21
The rosary of heads glorified his neck, !
Seeing which the god Shiva feels abashed!
Such a beautiful image appears magnificent !
And it is greatly holy! 22
He produces the very loud roar, !
Hearing which the messengers (of Yama) tremble!
The blood oozes (from his rosary of skulls) glorifying his neck !
And it is fascinating his great honour! 23
BHUJANG PRAYAAT STANZA!
Thou hast created the Svetaja, Jeraju and Uddahhujja division of creation. !
Like this Thou hast created the Andaja division and also the regions and universes!
Thou hast also created the directions, the indivcations, the earth and the sky. !
Thou hast also related the four Vedas, the Quran and the Puranas! 24

41.g: ਰਚੇ ਰੈਣ ਦਿਵਸੰ ਥਪੇ ਸੂਰ ਚੰਦੰ ॥
41.t: rache rain dhivasa(n) thape soor cha(n)dha(n) ||
41.e: Thou hast created night and day and established the sun and moon. !

41.g: ਠਟੇ ਦਈਵ ਦਾਨੋ ਰਚੇ ਬੀਰ ਬ੍ਰਿੰਦੰ ॥
41.t: ThaTe dhieev dhaano rache beer bira(n)dha(n) ||
41.e: Thou hast created gods and demons of the mighty Death hath subdued all!

41.g: ਕਰੀ ਲੋਹ ਕਲਮੰ ਲਿਖਿਓ ਲੇਖ ਮਾਥੰ ॥
41.t: karee loh kalama(n) likhio lekh maatha(n) ||
41.e: Thou hast created the pen to write on the tablet and hast recorded the writ on the forehead. !

41.g: ਸਬੈ ਜੇਰ ਕੀਨੇ ਬਲੀ ਕਾਲ ਹਾਥੰ ॥੨੫॥
41.t: sabai jer keene balee kaal haatha(n) ||25||
41.e: The hand of the mighty Death hath subdued all! 25
He hath effaced many and then made (created) others.!
He destroys the created ones and then creates after effacing!

41.g: ਕ੍ਰਿਯਾ ਕਾਲ ਜੂ ਕੀ ਕਿਨੂ ਨ ਪਛਾਨੀ ॥
41.t: kirayaa kaal joo kee kinoo na pachhaanee ||
41.e: None could comprehend the working of Death (KAL).!

41.g: ਘਨਿਯੋ ਪੈ ਬਿਹੈਹੈ ਘਨਿਯੋ ਪੈ ਬਿਹਾਨੀ ॥੨੬॥
41.t: ghaniyo pai bihaihai ghaniyo pai bihaanee ||26||
41.e: Many have experienced it and many will experience it! 26

41.g: ਕਿਤੇ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਸੇ ਕੀਟ ਕੋਟੈ ਬਨਾਏ ॥
41.t: kite kirasan se keeT koTai banaae ||
41.e: Somewhere He hath created millions of the servants like Krishna.!

41.g: ਕਿਤੇ ਰਾਮ ਸੇ ਮੇਟਿ ਡਾਰੇ ਉਪਾਏ ॥
41.t: kite raam se meT ddaare upaae ||
41.e: Somewhere He hath effaced and then created (many) like Rama!
Many Muhammads had been on the earth. !
They were born and then died in their own times! 27
All the Prophets and saints of the past were conquered by Death (KAL),!

41.g: ਤਿਤਿਓ ਕਾਲ ਜੀਤਾ ਨ ਤੇ ਕਾਲ ਜੀਤੇ ॥
41.t: titio kaal jeetaa na te kaal jeete ||
41.e: But none could conquer it (him)!

41.g: ਜਿਤੇ ਰਾਮ ਸੇ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਹੁਇ ਬਿਸਨ ਆਏ ॥
41.t: jite raam se kirasan hui bisan aae ||
41.e: All the incarnations of Vishnu like Rama and Krishan were destroyed by KAL,!

41.g: ਤਿਤਿਓ ਕਾਲ ਖਾਪਿਓ ਨ ਤੇ ਕਾਲ ਘਾਏ ॥੨੮॥
41.t: titio kaal khaapio na te kaal ghaae ||28||
41.e: But they could not destroy him! 28

41.g: ਜਿਤੇ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਸੇ ਚੰਦ੍ਰ ਸੇ ਹੋਤ ਆਏ ॥
41.t: jite i(n)dhr se cha(n)dhr se hot aae ||
41.e: All the indras and Chandras (moons) who came into being were destroyed by KAL,!

41.g: ਤਿਤਿਓ ਕਾਲ ਖਾਪਾ ਨ ਤੇ ਕਾਲ ਘਾਏ ॥
41.t: titio kaal khaapaa na te kaal ghaae ||
41.e: But they could not destroy him!

42.e: All those Prophets, saints and hermits, who came into being,!

42.g: ਸਭੈ ਕਾਲ ਕੇ ਅੰਤ ਦਾੜਾ ਤਲੈ ਹੈਂ ॥੨੯॥
42.t: sabhai kaal ke a(n)t dhaaRaa talai hai(n) ||29||
42.e: Were all ultimately crushed under the grinder tooth of KAL! 29
All the glorious kings like Mandhata were all bound down !

42.g: ਸਭੈ ਬਾਂਧ ਕੈ ਕਾਲ ਜੇਲੈ ਚਲਾਏ ॥
42.t: sabhai baa(n)dh kai kaal jelai chalaae ||
42.e: And thrown in the noose of KAL!

42.g: ਜਿਨੈ ਨਾਮ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਉਚਾਰੋ ਉਬਾਰੇ ॥
42.t: jinai naam taa ko uchaaro ubaare ||
42.e: Those who have remembered the Name of the Lord, have been saved, !

42.g: ਬਿਨਾ ਸਾਮ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਲਖੇ ਕੋਟ ਮਾਰੇ ॥੩੦॥
42.t: binaa saam taa kee lakhe koT maare ||30||
42.e: Without coming under His refuge, millions are considered as having been killed by KAL! 30
RASAAVAL STANZA BY THY GRACE
The sword of KAL glistens
Which is Non-elemental and terrible.
While moving  his anklets rattle
And the small bells jingle.31.
He hath four winsome arms and on his head
His long hair have been bound in a lovely knot.
The mace with him appears splendid
Which fascinate the honour of Yama.32.
His tongue red like fire seems magnificent
And his grinder teeth are very frightening.
His conches and drums resound
Like the thundering sound of the sea. 33.
His dark form looks elegant
And is the abode of Great Glory.
On his face there are lovely delineations
Which are superbly holy. 34.
BHUJANG PRAYAAT STANZA

42.g: ਸਿਰੰ ਸੇਤ ਛਤ੍ਰੰ ਸੁ ਸੁਭ੍ਰੰ ਬਿਰਾਜੰ ॥
42.t: sira(n) set chhatra(n) su subhra(n) biraaja(n) ||
42.e: On his head there swings the beautiful  lustrous and white canopy

42.g: ਲਖੇ ਛੈਲ ਛਾਯਾ ਕਰੇ ਤੇਜ ਲਾਜੰ ॥
42.t: lakhe chhail chhaayaa kare tej laaja(n) ||
42.e: Seeing whose shadow and considering it winsome , the light feels abashed.
The fleshy and red eyes of the God seem magnificent
Before whose light millions of suns appear irritated. 35.
Somewhere He appears impressive in the semblance of a Great King

42.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਦੇਵ ਕੰਨਿਆਨ ਕੇ ਮਾਨ ਮੋਹੰ ॥
42.t: kahoo(n) dhev ka(n)niaan ke maan moha(n) ||
42.e: Somewhere He allures the minds of apsaras or the daughters of gods.

42.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਬੀਰ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਕੈ ਧਰੇ ਬਾਨ ਪਾਨੰ ॥
42.t: kahoo(n) beer havai kai dhare baan paana(n) ||
42.e: Somewhere as a warrior He holds the bow in his hand

42.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਭੂਪ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਕੈ ਬਜਾਏ ਨਿਸਾਨੰ ॥੩੬॥
42.t: kahoo(n) bhoop havai kai bajaae nisaana(n) ||36||
42.e: Somewhere as a king he causes the resounding of his trumpets.36.
RASAAVAL STANZA
He seems bedecked beautifully
Wielding his bow and arrows.
He holds the sword
Like a great warrior. 37.
He is forcefully engaged in war
Fighting frightening battles.
He is the treasure of mercy
And ever kind.38.
He is always the same (Kinds Lord)
And the monarch of all.
He is Unconquerable and birthless
And helps those who come under His refuge.39.
The sword shines in His hand
And He is a Great Donor for the people.
I salute the Supreme KAL
Who is unique in the present and shall be unique in future. 40.
He is the effacer of the pride of the demon Madhu
And the destroyer of the demon Sumbh.
He hath white canopy over His head
And the weapons glisten in His hands.41.
Hearing His loud voice
The great monarchs are frightened.
He wears elegantly the garments of directions
And listening to His voice the sorrows run away. 42.
Hearing His call
The infinite happiness is attained.
He is Shyam in the form of clouds
And appears beautiful and impressive.43.
He hath four beautiful arms
And is wearing crown on the head.
The mace  conch and disc glisten
And seem frightful and resplendent. 44.
NARAAJ STANZA
The unique beauty appears graceful
And on seeing it the Cupid seems ashamed.
In the worlds it has supernatural radiance
Seeting whichall the people are fascinated. 45.
The moon is bearning on his head
Seeing which the god Shiva feels shy.

43.e: The ornaments of Nagas bedeck his neck.
Which have the power of destruction for the tyrants. 46.
He  who wields the sword in his hand
He is the remover of millions of sins.
He hath caught hold of the big mace
And hath fitted the arrow in his stretched bow.47.
There is sound of the blowing conch
And jingling of many small bells.
O Lord  I have come under Thy Refuge
Protect my honour.48.
Thou appearest impressive in various forms
And gods and are the treasure of the Grace alone.
Thou art the worshipping temple of the demons
And gods and are the treasure of the Grace alone . 49.
He remain uniform from the beginning to end
And hath adopted various forms.
The sword appears impressive in his hand
Seeing which the sins run away.50.
His body is bedecked with ornaments
Which allures both body and mind.
The arrow is fitted in the bow
Which causes many enemies to flee away.51.
There is the jingling sound of the small bells
And a new sound emanates from the anklets.
There is light like the blazing fire and lightning
Which is highly holy and pure.52.
TOTAK STANZA BY THY GRACE
Various kinds of pure tunes emanate from the anklets.
The face appears like the in blaze of lightning the dark clouds.
His gait is like that of an elephant

43.g: ਬਨ ਮੈ ਮਨੋ ਬਾਘ ਬਚਾ ਬਬਕੰ ॥੫੩॥
43.t: ban mai mano baagh bachaa babaka(n) ||53||
43.e: Intoxicated with wine. His loud thunder appears like the roar of a cub in the forest.53
Thou art in the world in the past
Future and present. Thou art the ONLY ONE Saviour in the Iron age.
Thou art ever new continuously at all places.

43.g: ਮ੍ਰਿਦੁ ਮੰਗਲ ਰੂਪ ਤੁਯੰ ਸੁ ਭਯੰ ॥੫੪॥
43.t: miradh ma(n)gal roop tuya(n) su bhaya(n) ||54||
43.e: Thou appearest impressive and sweet in Thy Blissful form.54.

43.g: ਦਿੜ ਦਾੜ੍ਹ ਕਰਾਲ ਦ੍ਵੈ ਸੇਤ ਉਧੰ ॥
43.t: dhiR dhaaRh karaal dhavai set udha(n) ||
43.e: Thou hast two grinder teeth. Terrible  white and high
Seeing which the tyrants run away from the battlefield.
Thou art inebriated  holding the terrible sword in Thy hand
. Both the gods and demons sing the eulogy of His victory.55.
When the united sound of the girdle bells and the anklets emantes
Then all the mountains become restless like mercury and the earth trembles.
When the constant jingling loud sound is heard
Then all the movable and immovable objects become restless.56.
Thy weapons are used in all the fourteen worlds alongwith Thy Command  the empty ones.
With which Thou causest deficiency in the augmented once and fill to the brim
All the creatures of the world on land and in water
Who is the amongst them  who hath the audacity to refuse Thy Command? 57.

43.g: ਘਟ ਭਾਦਵ ਮਾਸ ਕੀ ਜਾਣ ਸੁਭੰ ॥
43.t: ghaT bhaadhav maas kee jaan subha(n) ||
43.e: Just as the dark cloud seem impressive in the month of Bhadon

44.g: ਤਨ ਸਾਵਰੇ ਰਾਵਰੇਅੰ ਹੁਲਸੰ ॥
44.t: tan saavare raavarea(n) hulasa(n) ||
44.e: In the same manner Thy dark body hath its glow.

44.g: ਰਦ ਪੰਗਤ ਦਾਮਨੀਅੰ ਦਮਕੰ ॥
44.t: radh pa(n)gat dhaamaneea(n) dhamaka(n) ||
44.e: The chain of Thy teeth glitters like lightning

44.g: ਘਟ ਘੁੰਘਰ ਘੰਟ ਸੁਰੰ ਘਮਕੰ ॥੫੮॥
44.t: ghaT ghu(n)ghar gha(n)T sura(n) ghamaka(n) ||58||
44.e: The melody of the small bells and gongs is like the thunder of the clouds. 58.

44.g: ਭੁਜੰਗ ਪ੍ਰਯਾਤ ਛੰਦ ॥
44.t: bhuja(n)g prayaat chha(n)dh ||
44.e: BHUJANG PRAYAAT STANZA

44.g: ਘਟਾ ਸਾਵਣੰ ਜਾਣ ਸਿਆਮੰ ਸੁਹਾਯੰ ॥
44.t: ghaTaa saavana(n) jaan siaama(n) suhaaya(n) ||
44.e: Thy beauty appears elegant like the dark clouds of the month of Sawan

44.g: ਮਣੀ ਨੀਲ ਨਗਯੰ ਲਖੰ ਸੀਸ ਨ੍ਯਾਯੰ ॥
44.t: manee neel nagaya(n) lakha(n) sees nayaaya(n) ||
44.e: Comprehending Thy beautiful form the mountain of blue gems hath bent its head.

44.g: ਮਹਾ ਸੁੰਦ੍ਰ ਸਿਆਮੰ ਮਹਾਂ ਅਭਿਰਾਮੰ ॥
44.t: mahaa su(n)dhr siaama(n) mahaa(n) abhiraama(n) ||
44.e: The most beautiful black colour highly fascinates the mind

44.g: ਮਹਾਂ ਰੂਪ ਰੂਪੰ ਮਹਾਂ ਕਾਮ ਕਾਮੰ ॥੫੯॥
44.t: mahaa(n) roop roopa(n) mahaa(n) kaam kaama(n) ||59||
44.e: Thou art the most beautiful of the beautiful once and the most passionate of he passionate once.59.

44.g: ਫਿਰੈ ਚਕ੍ਰ ਚਉਦਹੂੰ ਪੁਰੀਅੰ ਮਧਿਆਣੰ ॥
44.t: firai chakr chaudhahoo(n) pureea(n) madhiaana(n) ||
44.e: The Order of KAL is prevalent in all the fourteen worlds.

44.g: ਇਸੋ ਕੌਨ ਬੀਯੰ ਫਿਰੈ ਆਇਸਾਣੰ ॥
44.t: eiso kauan beeya(n) firai aaisaana(n) ||
44.e: Who is the other one who hath the audacity to refuse His Order?

44.g: ਕਹੋ ਕੁੰਟ ਕੌਨੇ ਬਿਖੈ ਭਾਜ ਬਾਚੇ ॥
44.t: kaho ku(n)T kauane bikhai bhaaj baache ||
44.e: Tell me ,  in which direction you can flee and remain safe?

44.g: ਸਭੰ ਸੀਸ ਕੇ ਸੰਗ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਕਾਲ ਨਾਚੈ ॥੬੦॥
44.t: sabha(n) sees ke sa(n)g sree kaal naachai ||60||
44.e: Since the KAL dances over the heads of all.60.

44.g: ਕਰੇ ਕੋਟ ਕੋਊ ਧਰੈ ਕੋਟਿ ਓਟੰ ॥
44.t: kare koT kouoo dharai koT oTa(n) ||
44.e: Through one may erect millions of forts and may remain under their protection

44.g: ਬਚੈਗੋ ਨ ਕਿਉਹੂੰ ਕਰੈ ਕਾਲ ਚੋਟੰ ॥
44.t: bachaigo na kiauhoo(n) karai kaal choTa(n) ||
44.e: Even then  in the case of a blow of KAL  he will not be saved in any way.

44.g: ਲਿਖੰ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਕੇਤੇ ਪੜ੍ਹੰ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਕੋਟੰ ॥
44.t: likha(n) ja(n)tr kete paRha(n) ma(n)tr koTa(n) ||
44.e: Though one may write many Yantras and recite millions of mantras

44.g: ਬਿਨਾ ਸਰਨ ਤਾਂ ਕੀ ਨਹੀ ਔਰ ਓਟੰ ॥੬੧॥
44.t: binaa saran taa(n) kee nahee aauar oTa(n) ||61||
44.e: Even then he cannot be saved. No other shelter can save one without His refuge.61.

44.g: ਲਿਖੰ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਥਾਕੇ ਪੜ੍ਹੰ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਹਾਰੇ ॥
44.t: likha(n) ja(n)tr thaake paRha(n) ma(n)tr haare ||
44.e: The writers of Yantras have grown weary and the reciters of mantras have accepted defeat.

44.g: ਕਰੇ ਕਾਲ ਤੇ ਅੰਤ ਲੈ ਕੈ ਬਿਚਾਰੇ ॥
44.t: kare kaal te a(n)t lai kai bichaare ||
44.e: But ultimately  they all have been destroyed by KAL.

44.g: ਕਿਤਿਓ ਤੰਤ੍ਰ ਸਾਧੇ ਜੁ ਜਨਮੰ ਬਿਤਾਇਓ ॥
44.t: kitio ta(n)tr saadhe ju janama(n) bitaio ||
44.e: Many Tantras have been tamed and in such endeavours one hath wasted his birth.

44.g: ਭਏ ਫੋਕਟੰ ਕਾਜ ਏਕੈ ਨ ਆਇਓ ॥੬੨॥
44.t: bhe fokaTa(n) kaaj ekai na aaio ||62||
44.e: All have become useless and none hath proved useful.62.

44.g: ਕਿਤੇ ਨਾਸ ਮੂੰਦੇ ਭਏ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਚਾਰੀ ॥
44.t: kite naas moo(n)dhe bhe brahamachaaree ||
44.e: Many have become Brahmacharis and have closed their nostrils (in their process of contemplation).

44.g: ਕਿਤੇ ਕੰਠ ਕੰਠੀ ਜਟਾ ਸੀਸ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
44.t: kite ka(n)Th ka(n)Thee jaTaa sees dhaaree ||
44.e: Many have worn Kanthi (necklace) on their necks and have matted hair on their heads.

44.g: ਕਿਤੇ ਚੀਰ ਕਾਨੰ ਜੁਗੀਸੰ ਕਹਾਯੰ ॥
44.t: kite cheer kaana(n) jugeesa(n) kahaaya(n) ||
44.e: Many have got their ears perforated and caused others to call them great Yogis.

44.g: ਸਭੇ ਫੋਕਟੰ ਧਰਮ ਕਾਮੰ ਨ ਆਯੰ ॥੬੩॥
44.t: sabhe fokaTa(n) dharam kaama(n) na aaya(n) ||63||
44.e: All such religious observances were useless and none of them became useful.63.

44.g: ਮਧੁ ਕੀਟਭੰ ਰਾਛਸੇਸੰ ਬਲੀਅੰ ॥
44.t: madh keeTabha(n) raachhasesa(n) baleea(n) ||
44.e: There had been mighty demon-kings like Madhu and Kaitabh

44.g: ਸਮੇ ਆਪਨੀ ਕਾਲ ਤੇਊ ਦਲੀਅੰ ॥
44.t: same aapanee kaal teuoo dhaleea(n) ||
44.e: The KAL crushed them on their turn.

44.g: ਭਏ ਸੁੰਭ ਨੈਸੁੰਭ ਸ੍ਰੋਣੰਤ ਬੀਜੰ ॥
44.t: bhe su(n)bh naisu(n)bh srona(n)t beeja(n) ||
44.e: Then there were Sumbah

44.g: ਤੇਊ ਕਾਲ ਕੀਨੇ ਪੁਰੇਜੰ ਪੁਰੇਜੰ ॥੬੪॥
44.t: teuoo kaal keene pureja(n) pureja(n) ||64||
44.e: Nisumbh and Sranavat Beef. They were also chopped into bits by KAL.64.

44.g: ਬਲੀ ਪ੍ਰਿਥੀਅੰ ਮਾਨਧਾਤਾ ਮਹੀਪੰ ॥
44.t: balee piratheea(n) maanadhaataa maheepa(n) ||
44.e: The mighty king Prithu and the great sovereign like Mandhata

44.g: ਜਿਨੈ ਰਥ ਚੱਕ੍ਰ ਕੀਏ ਸਾਤ ਦੀਪੰ ॥
44.t: jinai rath cha'kr ke'ee saat dheepa(n) ||
44.e: Who had demarcated seven continents with his chariot-wheel.

44.g: ਭੁਜੰ ਭੀਮ ਭਰਥੰ ਜਗੰ ਜੀਤਿ ਡੰਡ੍ਯੰ ॥
44.t: bhuja(n) bheem bharatha(n) jaga(n) jeet dda(n)ddaya(n) ||
44.e: The king Bhim and the Bharat, who had conquered and brought the world under their control with the strength of arms

44.g: ਤਿਨੈ ਅੰਤ ਕੇ ਅੰਤ ਕੌ ਕਾਲ ਖੰਡ੍ਯੰ ॥੬੫॥
44.t: tinai a(n)t ke a(n)t kau kaal kha(n)ddaya(n) ||65||
44.e: . They were all destroyed by KAL  when they were nearing their end.65.

44.g: ਜਿਨੈ ਦੀਪ ਦੀਪੰ ਦੁਹਾਈ ਫਿਰਾਈ ॥
44.t: jinai dheep dheepa(n) dhuhaiee firaiee ||
44.e: He  who hath created the frightening dominance of His Name.

44.g: ਭੁਜਾ ਦੰਡ ਦੈ ਛੋਣਿ ਛੱਤ੍ਰੰ ਛਿਨਾਈ ॥
44.t: bhujaa dha(n)dd dhai chhon chha'tra(n) chhinaiee ||
44.e: He  who had snatched the earth from the Kshatriyas with the strength of staff-like arms.

44.g: ਕਰੇ ਜੱਗ ਕੋਟੰ ਜਸੰ ਅਨੇਕ ਲੀਤੇ ॥
44.t: kare ja'g koTa(n) jasa(n) anek leete ||
44.e: He  who had performed millions of Yajnas (sacrifices) and erned multi-faceted approbation.

44.g: ਵਹੈ ਬੀਰ ਬੰਕੇ ਬਲੀ ਕਾਲ ਜੀਤੇ ॥੬੬॥
44.t: vahai beer ba(n)ke balee kaal jeete ||66||
44.e: Even that winsome warrior (Parasuram) hath been conquered by KAL.66.

44.g: ਕਈ ਕੋਟ ਲੀਨੇ ਜਿਨੈ ਦੁਰਗ ਢਾਹੇ ॥
44.t: kiee koT leene jinai dhurag ddaahe ||
44.e: Those who had conquered millions of forts and razed them.

44.g: ਕਿਤੇ ਸੂਰਬੀਰਾਨ ਕੇ ਸੈਨ ਗਾਹੇ ॥
44.t: kite soorabeeraan ke sain gaahe ||
44.e: Those who had treaded the forces of innumerable warriors.

44.g: ਕਈ ਜੰਗ ਕੀਨੇ ਸੁ ਸਾਕੇ ਪਵਾਰੇ ॥
44.t: kiee ja(n)g keene su saake pavaare ||
44.e: Those who had indulged in many wars  events and disputes

44.g: ਵਹੈ ਦੀਨ ਦੇਖੇ ਗਿਰੇ ਕਾਲ ਮਾਰੇ ॥੬੭॥
44.t: vahai dheen dhekhe gire kaal maare ||67||
44.e: I have seen them subdued and killed by KAL.67

44.g: ਜਿਨੈ ਪਾਤਸਾਹੀ ਕਰੀ ਕੋਟਿ ਜੁਗ੍ਯੰ ॥
44.t: jinai paatasaahee karee koT jugaya(n) ||
44.e: Those who had ruled for millions of ages

44.g: ਰਸੰ ਆਨ ਰੱਸੰ ਭਲੀ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਭੁਗ੍ਯੰ ॥
44.t: rasa(n) aan ra'sa(n) bhalee bhaa(n)t bhugaya(n) ||
44.e: And had enjoyed nicely the pleasures and vicious tastes.

44.g: ਵਹੈ ਅੰਤ ਕੋ ਪਾਵ ਨਾਗੇ ਪਧਾਰੇ ॥
44.t: vahai a(n)t ko paav naage padhaare ||
44.e: They had ultimately gone with naked feet. I have seen them having been subdued

44.g: ਗਿਰੇ ਦੀਨ ਦੇਖੇ ਹਠੀ ਕਾਲ ਮਾਰੇ ॥੬੮॥
44.t: gire dheen dhekhe haThee kaal maare ||68||
44.e: Fallen and killed by the persistent KAL.68.

44.g: ਜਿਨੈ ਖੰਡੀਅੰ ਦੰਡ ਧਾਰੰ ਅਪਾਰੰ ॥
44.t: jinai kha(n)ddeea(n) dha(n)dd dhaara(n) apaara(n) ||
44.e: He  who had destroyed many kings

44.g: ਕਰੇ ਚੰਦ੍ਰਮਾ ਸੂਰ ਚੇਰੇ ਦੁਆਰੰ ॥
44.t: kare cha(n)dhramaa soor chere dhuaara(n) ||
44.e: He  who had enslaved the moon and the sun in his house.

44.g: ਜਿਨੈ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਸੇ ਜੀਤ ਕੈ ਛੋਡ ਡਾਰੇ ॥
44.t: jinai i(n)dhr se jeet kai chhodd ddaare ||
44.e: He (as Ravana)  had conquered the god Indra in war

44.g: ਵਹੈ ਦੀਨ ਦੇਖੇ ਗਿਰੇ ਕਾਲ ਮਾਰੇ ॥੬੯॥
44.t: vahai dheen dhekhe gire kaal maare ||69||
44.e: And later released him. I have seen (him and Meghnad) being subdued  fallen and killed by KAL.69.

45.e: RASAAVAL STANZA
All the Ramas who incarnated,
Ultimately passed away.
All the Krishnas, who had incarnated,
Have all passed away.70.
All the gods who will come into being in future,
They will all ultimately expire.
All the Buddhas, who came into being,
Expired ultimately.71.
All the god-kings, who came into being,
Ultimately passed away.
All the demon-kings, who came into being,
They were all destroyed by KAL.72.
The incarnation Narsingh
Was also killed by KAL.
The incarnation with grinder teeth (i.e. Boar)
Was killed by mighty KAL.73.
Vaman, the Brahmin incarnation,
Was killed by KAL.
The Fish incarnation of spatious mouth,
Was entrapped by KAL.74.
All those who had come into being,
They were all conquered by KAL.
Those who will go under His Refuge,
They will all be saved by him.75.
BHUJANG PRAYAAT STANZA

45.g: ਬਿਨਾ ਸਰਨਿ ਤਾਕੀ ਨ ਅਉਰੈ ਉਪਾਯੰ ॥
45.t: binaa saran taakee na aaurai upaaya(n) ||
45.e: Without coming under His Refuge, there is no other measure for protection,

45.g: ਕਹਾ ਦੇਵ ਦਈਤੰ ਕਹਾ ਰੰਕ ਰਾਯੰ ॥
45.t: kahaa dhev dhieeta(n) kahaa ra(n)k raaya(n) ||
45.e: May be a god, demon, pauper or a king.
May be the Sovereign and may be the courtiers,

45.g: ਬਿਨਾ ਸਰਨ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਨ ਕੋਟੈ ਉਪਾਯੰ ॥੭੬॥
45.t: binaa saran taa kee na koTai upaaya(n) ||76||
45.e: Without coming under His shelter, millions of measures for protection will be useless. 76.

45.g: ਜਿਤੇ ਜੀਵ ਜੰਤੰ ਸੁ ਦੁਨੀਅੰ ਉਪਾਯੰ ॥
45.t: jite jeev ja(n)ta(n) su dhuneea(n) upaaya(n) ||
45.e: All the creatures created by Him in the world

45.g: ਸਭੈ ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲੰ ਬਲੀ ਕਾਲ ਘਾਯੰ ॥
45.t: sabhai a(n)t kaala(n) balee kaal ghaaya(n) ||
45.e: Will ultimately be killed by the mighty KAL.

45.g: ਬਿਨਾ ਸਰਨ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਨਹੀ ਔਰ ਓਟੰ ॥
45.t: binaa saran taa kee nahee aauar oTa(n) ||
45.e: There is no other protection without coming under His shelter,

45.g: ਲਿਖੇ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਕੇਤੇ ਪੜ੍ਹੇ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਕੋਟੰ ॥੭੭॥
45.t: likhe ja(n)tr kete paRhe ma(n)tr koTa(n) ||77||
45.e: Even though many Yantras be written and millions of Mantras be recited.77.
NARAAJ STANZA
All the kings and pupers who have come into being,
Are sure to be killed by KAL.
All the Lokpals, who have come into being,
Will ultimately be mashed by KAL.78.
Those who meditate on the Supreme KAL,
The wielder of the sword, they firmly adopt innumerable measures for protection.
Those who remember KAL,
They conquer the world and depart.79.
That Supreme KAL is Supremely Pure,
Whose image is supernatural and winsome.
He is bedecked with supernatural beauty,
All the sins flee on hearing His Name.80.
He, who hath wide and red eyes,
And who is the destroyer of innumerable sins.
The glitter of his face is more beautiful than that of the moon
And who hath caused many sinners to ferry across.81.
RASAAVAL STANZA
All the Lokpals
Are subservient to KAL.
All the suns and moons and
Even Indra and Vaman (are subservient to KAL.82.
BHUJANG PRAYAAT STANZA
All the fourteen worlds are under the Command of KAL.

45.g: ਸਭੈ ਨਾਥ ਨਾਥੇ ਭ੍ਰਮੰ ਭਉਂਹ ਬਕ੍ਰੰ ॥
45.t: sabhai naath naathe bhrama(n) bhau(n)h bakra(n) ||
45.e: He hath stringed all the Naths by turning about the slanting evebrows.

45.g: ਕਹਾ ਰਾਮ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨੰ ਕਹਾ ਚੰਦ ਸੂਰੰ ॥
45.t: kahaa raam kirasana(n) kahaa cha(n)dh soora(n) ||
45.e: May be Rama and Krishna, may be the moon and sun,

45.g: ਸਭੈ ਹਾਥ ਬਾਧੇ ਖਰੇ ਕਾਲ ਹਜੂਰੰ ॥੮੩॥
45.t: sabhai haath baadhe khare kaal hajoora(n) ||83||
45.e: All are standing with folded hands in the presence of KAL.83.
SWAYYA.

45.g: ਕਾਲ ਹੀ ਪਾਇ ਭਯੋ ਭਗਵਾਨ ਸੁ ਜਾਗਤ ਯਾ ਜਗ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਕਲਾ ਹੈ ॥
45.t: kaal hee pai bhayo bhagavaan su jaagat yaa jag jaa kee kalaa hai ||
45.e: At the instance of KAL, Vishnu appeared, whose power is manifested through the world.

45.g: ਕਾਲ ਹੀ ਪਾਇ ਭਯੋ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਸਿਵ ਕਾਲ ਹੀ ਪਾਇ ਭਯੋ ਜੁਗੀਆ ਹੈ ॥
45.t: kaal hee pai bhayo brahamaa siv kaal hee pai bhayo jugeeaa hai ||
45.e: At the instance of KAL, Brahma appeared and also at the instance of KAL the Yogi Shiva appeared.

45.g: ਕਾਲ ਹੀ ਪਾਇ ਸੁਰਾਸੁਰ ਗੰਧ੍ਰਬ ਜੱਛ ਭੁਜੰਗ ਦਿਸਾ ਬਿਦਿਸਾ ਹੈ ॥
45.t: kaal hee pai suraasur ga(n)dhrab ja'chh bhuja(n)g dhisaa bidhisaa hai ||
45.e: At the instance of KAL, the gods, demons, Gandharvas, Yakshas, Bhujang, directions and indications have appeared.

45.g: ਔਰ ਸੁਕਾਲ ਸਭੈ ਬਸ ਕਾਲ ਕੇ ਏਕ ਹੀ ਕਾਲ ਅਕਾਲ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ॥੮੪॥
45.t: aauar sukaal sabhai bas kaal ke ek hee kaal akaal sadhaa hai ||84||
45.e: All the other prevalent object are within KAL, only One supreme KAL is ever Timeless and eternal.84.
BHUJANG PRAYAAT STANZA
Salutation to the God of gods and salutation to the wielder of sword,
Who is ever monomorphic and ever without vices.
Salutation to Him, who manifests the qualities of activity (rajas), rhythm (sattava) and morbidity (tamas).
Salutation to Him who is without vices and who is without ailments. 85.
RASAAVAL STANZA

46.e: Salutation to Him, who wields the bow in his hands
Salutation to Him, who is Fearless.
Salutation to Him, who is God of gods. Salutation to Him,
Who shall ever be within the world.86.
BHUJANG PRAYYAT STANZA
Salutation to him, who wields spear, double-edged sword, sword and dagger,
Who is ever monomorphic and ever without vices.

46.g: ਨਮੋ ਬਾਣ ਪਾਣੰ ਨਮੋ ਦੰਡ ਧਾਰਿਯੰ ॥
46.t: namo baan paana(n) namo dha(n)dd dhaariya(n) ||
46.e: Salutation to Him, who is the wielder of bow in His hands and who also carries the staff,
Who hath spread His Light in all the fourteen worlds.87.
I salute the arrow and the gun, I salute the lustrous sword,
Which Is impenetratable and indestructible.
I salute the great mace and lance,

46.g: ਜਿਨੈ ਤੱੁਲੀਯੰ ਬੀਰ ਬੀਯੋ ਨ ਬੀਯੰ ॥੮੮॥
46.t: jinai ta'uleeya(n) beer beeyo na beeya(n) ||88||
46.e: Which have no equal or second in bravery.88.
RASAAVAL STANZA
Salutation to Him, Who holds the disc in His hand,
He hath manifested Himself without elements.
Salutation to Him, who hath sharp grinder teeth,
Which are thick and strong.89.
Salutation to Him, who hath the arrows and the cannon,
Who hath destroyed the enemies.
Salutation to Him, Who holds the straight sword and the bayonet,
Who hath reporimanded the tyrants.90.
I salute all the weapons of various names.
I salute all the weapons of various names.
I salute all kinds of armour
I salute all kinds of armour.91.
SWAYYA.

46.g: ਮੇਰੁ ਕਰੋ ਤ੍ਰਿਣ ਤੇ ਮੁਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਗਰੀਬ ਨਿਵਾਜ ਨ ਦੂਸਰ ਤੋ ਸੋ ॥
46.t: mer karo tiran te muh jaeh gareeb nivaaj na dhoosar to so ||
46.e: There is no other support for the poor except Thee, who hath made me a mountain from a straw.

46.g: ਭੂਲ ਛਿਮੋ ਹਮਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਪਨ ਭੂਲਨਹਾਰ ਕਹੂੰ ਕੋਊ ਮੋ ਸੋ ॥
46.t: bhool chhimo hamaree prabh aapan bhoolanahaar kahoo(n) kouoo mo so ||
46.e: O Lord! Forgive me for my mistakes, because who is there so much blunderhead like me?

46.g: ਸੇਵ ਕਰੀ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਦੇਖੀਅਤ ਦ੍ਰਬ ਭਰੋ ਸੋ ॥
46.t: sev karee tumaree tin ke sabh hee gireh dhekheeat dhrab bharo so ||
46.e: Those who have served Thee, there seems wealth and self-confidence in all there homes.

46.g: ਯਾ ਕਲ ਮੈਂ ਸਭ ਕਾਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਨ ਕੇ ਭਾਰੀ ਭੁਜਾਨ ਕੋ ਭਾਰੀ ਭਰੋਸੋ ॥੯੨॥
46.t: yaa kal mai(n) sabh kaal kirapaan ke bhaaree bhujaan ko bhaaree bharoso ||92||
46.e: In this Iron age, the supreme trust is only for KAL, Who is the Sword-incarnate and hath mighty arms.92.

46.g: ਸੁੰਭ ਨਿਸੁੰਭ ਸੇ ਕੋਟ ਨਿਸਾਚਰ ਜਾਹਿ ਛਿਨੇਕ ਬਿਖੈ ਹਨ ਡਾਰੇ ॥
46.t: su(n)bh nisu(n)bh se koT nisaachar jaeh chhinek bikhai han ddaare ||
46.e: He, who hath destroyed millions of demons like Sumbh and Nisumbh in and instant.

46.g: ਧੂਮਰਲੋਚਨ ਚੰਡ ਔ ਮੁੰਡ ਸੇ ਮਾਹਖ ਸੇ ਪਲ ਬੀਚ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
46.t: dhoomaralochan cha(n)dd aau mu(n)dd se maahakh se pal beech nivaare ||
46.e: Who hath annihilated in and instant the demons like Dhumarlochan, Chand, Mund and Mahishasura.

46.g: ਚਾਮਰ ਸੇ ਰਣ ਚਿੱਛਰ ਸੇ ਰਕਤਿੱਛਰ ਸੇ ਝਟ ਦੈ ਝਝਕਾਰੇ ॥
46.t: chaamar se ran chi'chhar se rakati'chhar se jhaT dhai jhajhakaare ||
46.e: Who hath immediately thrashed and thrown down far away the demons like Chamar, Ranchichchhar and Rakat Beej.

46.g: ਐਸੋ ਸੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਪਾਇ ਕਹਾ ਪਰਵਾਹ ਰਹੀ ਇਹ ਦਾਸ ਤਿਹਾਰੇ ॥੯੩॥
46.t: aaiso su saahib pai kahaa paravaeh rahee ieh dhaas tihaare ||93||
46.e: On realizing the Lord like Thee, this servant of yours doth not care for anyone else.93.

46.g: ਮੁੰਡਹੁ ਸੇ ਮਧੁ ਕੀਟਭ ਸੇ ਮੁਰ ਸੇ ਅਘ ਸੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਦਲੇ ਹੈ ॥
46.t: mu(n)ddahu se madh keeTabh se mur se agh se jin koT dhale hai ||
46.e: He, Who hath mashed millions of demons like Mundakasura, Madhu, Kaitabh, Murs and Aghasura.

46.g: ਓਟ ਕਰੀ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਨ ਜਿਨੈ ਰਣ ਚੋਟ ਪਰੀ ਪਗ ਦ੍ਵੈ ਨ ਟਲੇ ਹੈਂ ॥
46.t: oT karee kabahoo(n) na jinai ran choT paree pag dhavai na Tale hai(n) ||
46.e: And such heroes who never asked anyone for support in the battlefield and had never turned back even two feet.

46.g: ਸਿੰਧੁ ਬਿਖੈ ਜੇ ਨ ਬੂਡੇ ਨਿਸਾਚਰ ਪਾਵਕ ਬਾਣ ਬਹੇ ਨ ਜਲੇ ਹੈਂ ॥
46.t: si(n)dh bikhai je na boodde nisaachar paavak baan bahe na jale hai(n) ||
46.e: And such demons, who could not be drowned even in the sea and there was no impact on them of the fireshafts.

46.g: ਤੇ ਅਸਿ ਤੋਰ ਬਿਲੋਕ ਅਲੋਕ ਸੁ ਲਾਜ ਕੋ ਛਾਡਿ ਕੈ ਭਾਜਿ ਚਲੇ ਹੈਂ ॥੯੪॥
46.t: te as tor bilok alok su laaj ko chhaadd kai bhaaj chale hai(n) ||94||
46.e: On seeing Thy Sword and forsaking their shyness, they are fleeing away.94.

46.g: ਰਾਵਣ ਸੇ ਮਹਰਾਵਣ ਸੇ ਘਟਕਾਨਹੁ ਸੇ ਪਲ ਬੀਚ ਪਛਾਰੇ ॥
46.t: raavan se maharaavan se ghaTakaanahu se pal beech pachhaare ||
46.e: Thou hast destroyed in and instant the warriors like Ravana, Kumbhkarna and Ghatksura.

46.g: ਬਾਰਿਦਨਾਦ ਅਕੰਪਨ ਸੇ ਜਗ ਜੰਗ ਜੁਰੇ ਜਿਨ ਸਿਉ ਜਮ ਹਾਰੇ ॥
46.t: baaridhanaadh aka(n)pan se jag ja(n)g jure jin siau jam haare ||
46.e: And like Meghnad, who could defeat even Yama in the war..

46.g: ਕੁੰਭ ਅਕੁੰਭ ਸੇ ਜੀਤ ਸਭੈ ਜਗ ਸਾਤ ਹੂੰ ਸਿੰਧ ਹਥੀਆਰ ਪਖਾਰੇ ॥
46.t: ku(n)bh aku(n)bh se jeet sabhai jag saat hoo(n) si(n)dh hatheeaar pakhaare ||
46.e: And the demons like Kumbh and Akumbh, who conquering all, washed away the blood from their weapons in seven seas, etc.

46.g: ਜੇ ਜੇ ਹੁਤੇ ਅਕਟੇ ਬਿਕਟੇ ਸੁ ਕਟੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਾਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਨ ਕੇ ਮਾਰੇ ॥੯੫॥
46.t: je je hute akaTe bikaTe su kaTe kar kaal kirapaan ke maare ||95||
46.e: All of them died with the terrible sword of the mighty KAL.95.

46.g: ਜੋ ਕਹੂੰ ਕਾਲ ਤੇ ਭਾਜ ਕੇ ਬਾਚੀਅਤ ਤੋ ਕਿਹ ਕੁੰਟ ਕਹੋ ਭਜਿ ਜਈਐ ॥
46.t: jo kahoo(n) kaal te bhaaj ke baacheeat to keh ku(n)T kaho bhaj jieeaai ||
46.e: If one tries to flee and escape from KAL, then tell in which direction shall he flee?

46.g: ਆਗੇ ਹੂੰ ਕਾਲ ਧਰੇ ਅਸਿ ਗਾਜਤ ਛਾਜਤ ਹੈ ਜਿਹ ਤੇ ਨਸਿ ਅਈਐ ॥
46.t: aage hoo(n) kaal dhare as gaajat chhaajat hai jeh te nas ieeaai ||
46.e: Wherever one may go, even there he will perceive the well-seated thundering sword of KAL.

46.g: ਐਸੋ ਨ ਕੈ ਗਯੋ ਕੋਈ ਸੁ ਦਾਵ ਰੇ ਜਾਹਿ ਉਪਾਵ ਸੋ ਘਾਵ ਬਚਈਐ ॥
46.t: aaiso na kai gayo koiee su dhaav re jaeh upaav so ghaav bachieeaai ||
46.e: None hath been able to tell uptil now the measure, which, may be adopted to save himself from the blow of KAL.

46.g: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਨ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਮੁੜ ਕਹੂੰ ਹਸਿ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਨ ਕਿਉ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਜਈਯੈ ॥੯੬॥
46.t: jaa te na chhuTeeaai muR kahoo(n) has taa kee na kiau saranaagat jieeyai ||96||
46.e: O foolish mind! The one from whom Thou cannot escape in any manner, why doth thee not go under His Refuge.96.

46.g: ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਔ ਬਿਸਨ ਜਪੇ ਤੁਹਿ ਕੋਟਿਕ ਰਾਮ ਰਹੀਮ ਭਲੀ ਬਿਧਿ ਧਿਆਯੋ ॥
46.t: kirasan aau bisan jape tuh koTik raam raheem bhalee bidh dhiaayo ||
46.e: Thou hast meditated on millions of Krishnas, Vishnus, Ramas and Rahims.

47.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਜਪਿਓ ਅਰੁ ਸੰਭੁ ਥਪਿਓ ਤਿਹ ਤੇ ਤੁਹਿ ਕੋ ਕਿਨਹੂੰ ਨ ਬਚਾਯੋ ॥
47.t: braham japio ar sa(n)bh thapio teh te tuh ko kinahoo(n) na bachaayo ||
47.e: Thou hast recited the name of Brahma and established Shivalingam, even then none could save thee.

47.g: ਕੋਟ ਕਰੀ ਤਪਸਾ ਦਿਨ ਕੋਟਿਕ ਕਾਹੰੂ ਨ ਕੌਡੀ ਕੋ ਕਾਮ ਕਢਾਯੋ ॥
47.t: koT karee tapasaa dhin koTik kaaha(n)oo na kauaddee ko kaam kaddaayo ||
47.e: Thou hast observed millions of austerities for millions of days, but thou couldst not be recompensed even for the value of a couldst not be recompensed even for the value of a cowrie.

47.g: ਕਾਮਕੁ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਕਸੀਰੇ ਕੇ ਕਾਮ ਨ ਕਾਲ ਕੋ ਘਾਉ ਕਿਨਹੂੰ ਨ ਬਚਾਯੋ ॥੯੭॥
47.t: kaamak ma(n)tr kaseere ke kaam na kaal ko ghaau kinahoo(n) na bachaayo ||97||
47.e: The Mantra recited for fulfillment of worldly desires doth not even bring the least gain and none of such Mantras can’t save from the blow of KAL.97.

47.g: ਕਾਹੇ ਕੋ ਕੂਰ ਕਰੈ ਤਪਸਾ ਇਨ ਕੀ ਕੋਊ ਕੌਡੀ ਕੇ ਕਾਮ ਨ ਐਹੈ ॥
47.t: kaahe ko koor karai tapasaa in kee kouoo kauaddee ke kaam na aaihai ||
47.e: Why doth thou indulge in false austerities, because they will not bring in gain of even one cowrie.

47.g: ਤੋਹਿ ਬਚਾਇ ਸਕੈ ਕਹੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਕੈ ਆਪਨ ਘਾਵ ਬਚਾਇ ਨ ਐਹੈ ॥
47.t: toh bachai sakai kahu kaise kai aapan ghaav bachai na aaihai ||
47.e: The cannot save themselves form the blow (of KAL), how can they protect thee?

47.g: ਕੋਪ ਕਰਾਲ ਕੀ ਪਾਵਕ ਕੁੰਡ ਮੈ ਆਪ ਟੰਗਿਓ ਤਿਮ ਤੋਹਿ ਟੰਗੈਹੈ ॥
47.t: kop karaal kee paavak ku(n)dd mai aap Ta(n)gio tim toh Ta(n)gaihai ||
47.e: They are all hanging in the blazing fire of anger, therefore they will cause thy hanging similarly.

47.g: ਚੇਤ ਰੇ ਚੇਤ ਅਜੋ ਜੀਅ ਮੈਂ ਜੜ ਕਾਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਾਮ ਨ ਐਹੈ ॥੯੮॥
47.t: chet re chet ajo jeea mai(n) jaR kaal kirapaa bin kaam na aaihai ||98||
47.e: O fool! Ruminate now in thy mind; none will be of any use to thee except the grace of KAL.98.

47.g: ਤਾਹਿ ਪਛਾਨਤ ਹੈ ਨ ਮਹਾ ਪਸੁ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪੁ ਤਿਹੰ ਪੁਰ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
47.t: taeh pachhaanat hai na mahaa pas jaa ko prataap tiha(n) pur maahee ||
