65.t: eite beer ga'je bhe naadh bhaare ||

65.g: ਭਜੇ ਖਾਨ ਖੂਨੀ ਬਿਨਾ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਝਾਰੇ ॥੬॥
65.t: bhaje khaan khoonee binaa sasatr jhaare ||6||
65.e: The heroes form this (my) side thundred and the bloody Khans fled away without using their weapons.6.
NARAAJ STANZA
The shameless Khans fled away and none of them wore the arms.
They left the battlefield though they pretended to be the valiant heroes.7.
They left on galloping horses and could not use the weapons.
They did not shout loudly like valiant heroes and felt Ashamed on seeing ladies.8.
DOHRA

65.g: ਬਰਵਾ ਗਾਉਂ ਉਜਾਰ ਕੈ ਕਰੇ ਮੁਕਾਮ ਭਲਾਨ ॥
65.t: baravaa gaau(n) ujaar kai kare mukaam bhalaan ||
65.e: On the way they plundered the village Barwa and halted at Bhallon.

65.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਲ ਹਮੈ ਨ ਛੁਇ ਸਕੈ ਭਾਜਤ ਭਏ ਨਿਦਾਨ ॥੯॥
65.t: prabh bal hamai na chhui sakai bhaajat bhe nidhaan ||9||
65.e: They could not touch me because of the Grace of the Lord and fled away ultimately.9.

65.g: ਤਬ ਬਲ ਈਹਾ ਨ ਪਰ ਸਕੈ ਬਰਵਾ ਹਨਾ ਰਿਸਾਇ ॥
65.t: tab bal ieehaa na par sakai baravaa hanaa risai ||
65.e: Because of Thy Favour, O Lord! They could not do any harmahere, but filled with great anger, they destroyed the village Barwa.

65.g: ਸਾਲਿਨ ਰਸ ਜਿਮ ਬਾਨੀਯੋ ਰੋਰਨ ਖਾਤ ਬਨਾਇ ॥੧੦॥
65.t: saalin ras jim baaneeyo roran khaat banai ||10||
65.e: Just as a Vishya (Bania), though desirous of tasting meat, cannot actually have its relish, but instead prepares and eats the salted soup of parched wheat. 10.

65.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕ ਗ੍ਰੰਥੇ ਖਾਨਜਾਦੇ ਕੋ ਆਗਮਨ ਤ੍ਰਾਸਿਤ ਉਠ ਜੈਬੋ ਬਰਨਨੰ ਨਾਮ ਦਸਮੋ ਧਿਆਇ ਸਮਾਪਤ ਮਸਤੁ ਸੁਭ ਮਸਤੁ ॥੧੦॥ਅਫਜੂ॥੩੫੪॥
65.t: eit sree bachitr naaTak gra(n)the khaanajaadhe ko aagaman traasit uTh jaibo baranana(n) naam dhasamo dhiaai samaapat masat subh masat ||10||afajoo||354||
65.e: End of the Tenth Chapter of BACHITTAR NATAK entitled ‘Description of the Expedition of Khanzada and his flight out of fear’.10.354.
The Description of the Battle with HUSSAINI:
BHUJANG PRAYAAT STANZA

65.g: ਸਕੈ ਜ੍ਵਾਬੁ ਦੈ ਨ ਹਨੇ ਸੂਰ ਲਜੰ ॥
65.t: sakai javaiaab dhai na hane soor laja(n) ||
65.e: The Khanzada fled to his father and being ashmed of his conduct, he could not speak.

66.g: ਸੂਰ ਲੈ ਕੈ ਸਿਲਾ ਸਾਜ ਸਜਿਯੰ ॥੧॥
66.t: soor lai kai silaa saaj sajiya(n) ||1||
66.e: Then Hussian thundered striking his arms and prepared for attack with all his brave warriors.1.

66.g: ਪ੍ਰਥਮ ਕੂਟਿ ਕੈ ਲੂਟ ਲੀਨੇ ਅਵਾਨੰ ॥
66.t: pratham kooT kai looT leene avaana(n) ||
66.e: Hussain assembled all his forces and advanced. At first he plundered the houses of the hill-people.

66.g: ਕਰੇ ਬੰਦਿ ਕੈ ਰਾਜ ਪੁਤ੍ਰਾਨ ਚੇਰੰ ॥੨॥
66.t: kare ba(n)dh kai raaj putraan chera(n) ||2||
66.e: Then he conquered the Raja of Dadhwal and brought him under submission. The sons of the Raja were made slaves.2.

66.g: ਪੁਨਰਿ ਦੂਨਿ ਕੋ ਲੂਟ ਲੀਨੋ ਸੁਧਾਰੰ ॥
66.t: punar dhoon ko looT leeno sudhaara(n) ||

66.g: ਕੋਈ ਸਾਮੁਹੇ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਸਕਿਯੋ ਨ ਗਵਾਰੰ ॥
66.t: koiee saamuhe havai sakiyo na gavaara(n) ||
66.e: Then he plundered the Doon thoroughly, none could face the barbarian.

66.g: ਲੀਯੋ ਛੀਨ ਅੰਨੰ ਦਲੰ ਬਾਂਟਿ ਦੀਯੰ ॥
66.t: leeyo chheen a(n)na(n) dhala(n) baa(n)T dheeya(n) ||

66.e: He took away forcibly the foodgrains and distributed them (amongst the soldiers), the big fool thus committed a very bad act.3.
DOHRA

66.g: ਕਿਤਕ ਦਿਵਸ ਬੀਤਤ ਭਏ ਕਰਤ ਉਸੈ ਉਤਪਾਤ ॥
66.t: kitak dhivas beetat bhe karat usai utapaat ||

66.g: ਗੁਆਲੇਰੀਅਨ ਕੀ ਪਰਤ ਭੀ ਆਨ ਮਿਲਨ ਕੀ ਬਾਤ ॥੪॥
66.t: guaalereean kee parat bhee aan milan kee baat ||4||
66.e: Some days passed in such acts, the turn of meeting the Raja of Guler came.4.

66.g: ਜੌ ਦਿਨ ਦੁਇਕ ਨ ਵੇ ਮਿਲਤ ਤਬ ਆਵਤ ਅਰਰਾਇ ॥
66.t: jau dhin dhuik na ve milat tab aavat ararai ||

66.g: ਕਾਲਿ ਤਿਨੂ ਕੇ ਘਰ ਬਿਖੈ ਡਾਰੀ ਕਲਹ ਬਨਾਇ ॥੫॥
66.t: kaal tinoo ke ghar bikhai ddaaree kaleh banai ||5||
66.e: If he had met (Hussain) for two days more, the enemy would have come here (towards me), but the Providence had thrown a device of discord towards his house.5.
CHAUPAI
The Raja of Guler came to meet Hussain and with him came Ram Singh.
They met Hussain after the four quarters of the days had passed. The slave Hussian become blind in vanity.6.
DOHRA

66.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਰਵਿ ਕੇ ਤੇਜ ਤੇ ਰੇਤ ਅਧਿਕ ਤਪਤਾਇ ॥
66.t: jaise rav ke tej te ret adhik tapatai ||

66.g: ਰਵਿ ਬਲਿ ਛੁਦ੍ਰ ਨ ਜਾਨਈ ਆਪਨ ਹੀ ਗਰਬਾਇ ॥੭॥
66.t: rav bal chhudhr na jaaniee aapan hee garabai ||7||
66.e: Just as the sand becomes heated by the heat of the sun, the wretched sand doth not know the might of the sun and become proud of itself.7.
CHAUPAI

66.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਫੂਲ ਗੁਲਾਮ ਜਾਤ ਭਯੋ ॥
66.t: taise hee fool gulaam jaat bhayo ||

66.g: ਤਿਨੈ ਨ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟ ਤਰੇ ਆਨਤ ਭਯੋ ॥
66.t: tinai na dhirasaT tare aanat bhayo ||
66.e: Slimilarly the slave Hussain was puffed up with ego, he did not care to notice them.

66.g: ਜਾਨਾ ਆਨ ਨ ਮੋ ਸਰ ਮਹਿ ਮਹਿ ॥੮॥
66.t: jaanaa aan na mo sar meh meh ||8||
66.e: With the Rajas of Kahlur and Katoch on his side, he considered himself peerless. 8.

66.g: ਤਿਨ ਜੋ ਧਨ ਆਨੋ ਸੋ ਸਾਥਾ ॥
66.t: tin jo dhan aano so saathaa ||

66.e: (The Raja of Guler and Ram Singh) offered money to Hussain, which they had brought with them.

66.g: ਤੇ ਧਨਿ ਲੈ ਨਿਜਿ ਧਾਮ ਸਿਧਾਨੇ ॥੯॥
66.t: te dhan lai nij dhaam sidhaane ||9||
66.e: A dispute arose in giving and taking, therefore the Rajas returned to their places with the money.9.

66.g: ਭਲਾ ਬੁਰਾ ਕਛੁ ਲਖਤ ਨ ਭਯੋ ॥
66.t: bhalaa buraa kachh lakhat na bhayo ||
66.e: Then Hussain was enraged and lost the power of discriminating between good and bad.
He made no other consideration and ordered the beating drum against the Raja of Guler.10.

66.g: ਦਾਵ ਘਾਵ ਤਿਨ ਨੈਕੁ ਨ ਕਰਾ ॥
66.t: dhaav ghaav tin naik na karaa ||

66.e: He did not think of any tactical consideration. The hare surrounded the lion for frightening him.

66.g: ਖਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਤਿਨ ਜਾਨ ਨ ਦੀਯੋ ॥੧੧॥
66.t: khaan paan tin jaan na dheeyo ||11||
66.e: He besieged him for fifteen pahars (about 45 hours) and did not allow the items of food and drink to reach the state.11.
Being without food and drink, the warriors were filled with ire, the Raja sent the messengers for the Purpose of making peace.

66.g: ਫੂਲਿ ਗਯੋ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਮਾਨੀ ॥੧੨॥
66.t: fool gayo tin kee nahee(n) maanee ||12||
66.e: Seeing the Pathan forces around him, the slave Hussain lost his balance and did not consider the request of the Raja.12.

66.g: ਦਸ ਸਹੰਸ੍ਰ ਅਬ ਹੀ ਕੈ ਦੈਹੂ ॥
66.t: dhas saha(n)sr ab hee kai dhaihoo ||

66.g: ਨਾ ਤਰ ਮੀਚ ਮੂੰਡ ਪਰ ਲੈਹੂ ॥
66.t: naa tar meech moo(n)dd par laihoo ||
66.e: He said, “Either give me ten thousand rupees immediately or take death on your head.”
I had sent Sangatia Singh there for making peace (among the chief), he brought Gopal on oath of God.13.

66.g: ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਉਨ ਕੀ ਬਨੀ ॥
66.t: tin kai sa(n)g na un kee banee ||

66.g: ਤਬ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਚਿਤ ਮੋ ਇਹ ਗਨੀ ॥
66.t: tab kirapaal chit mo ieh ganee ||
66.e: But he could not reconcile with them  then Kirpal thought within his mind:

66.g: ਐਸਿ ਘਾਤਿ ਫਿਰ ਹਾਥ ਨ ਐਹੈ ॥
66.t: aais ghaat fir haath na aaihai ||

66.e: That such an opportunity will not be available again, because the circle of time deceives everybody.14.
He decided to catch hold of Gopal immediately, either to imprision him or kill him.

66.g: ਤਨਕ ਭਨਕ ਜਬ ਤਿਨ ਸੁਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
66.t: tanak bhanak jab tin sun paiee ||

66.e: When Gopal got scent of the conspiracy, he escaped to his people (forces).15.
MADHUBHAAR STANZA
When Gopal was gone, Kirpal was filled with anger.
Himmat and Hussain rushed for fighting in the field.16.
With great pride, more warriors followed.
The drums and trumpets resounded.17.
On the other side, the trumpets also resounded and the horses danced in the battlefield.
The warriors enthusiastically strike their weapons, creating clattering sound.18.
The fearless warriors blow their horns and shout loudly.
The swords are struck and the warriors are lying on the ground.19.

67.e: The guns, arrows, lances and axes create noises.
The warriors shout.20.
The heroes who stand firmly in the field, thunder.
The fighters move in the field like leopards.21.
The horses neigh and the trumpets resound.
The warriors strike their weapons enthusiastically and also endure the blows.22.
The warriors falling as martyrs appear like the carefree intoxicated persons lying down of the ground.
Their disheveled hair appear like the matted hair (of hermits).23.
The huge elephants are decorated and the warrior-chiefs descending from them and holding their bows, thunder in the field.24.
TRIBHANGI STANZA

67.g: ਕੁਪਿਯੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੰ ਸੱਜਿ ਮਰਾਲੰ ਬਾਹ ਬਿਸਾਲੰ ਧਰਿ ਢਾਲੰ ॥
67.t: kupiyo kirapaala(n) sa'j maraala(n) baeh bisaala(n) dhar ddaala(n) ||
67.e: Kirpal Chand, in great ire, decorated his horse and he, the lond-armed warrior held his shield.

67.g: ਧਾਏ ਸਭ ਸੂਰੰ ਰੂਪ ਕਰੂਰੰ ਚਮਕਤ ਨੂਰੰ ਮੁਖ ਲਾਲੰ ॥
67.t: dhaae sabh soora(n) roop karoora(n) chamakat noora(n) mukh laala(n) ||
67.e: All the dreadful-looking warriors, with red and radiant faces were moving.

67.g: ਲੈ ਲੈ ਸੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਨੰ ਬਾਣ ਕਮਾਣੰ ਸਜੇ ਜੁਆਨੰ ਤਨ ਤੱਤੰ ॥
67.t: lai lai su kirapaana(n) baan kamaana(n) saje juaana(n) tan ta'ta(n) ||
67.e: Holding their swords and decorated with bow and arrows, the youthful warriors, full of heat

67.g: ਰਣਿ ਰੰਗ ਕਲੋਲੰ ਮਾਰਹੀ ਬੋਲੰ ਜਨ ਗਜ ਡੋਲੰ ਬਨ ਮਤੰ ॥੨੫॥
67.t: ran ra(n)g kalola(n) maarahee bola(n) jan gaj ddola(n) ban mata(n) ||25||
67.e: Are engaged in frolics in the battlefield and shouting “kill, kill” appear like intoxicated elephants in the forest.25.
BHUYANG STAZA
Then the Raja of Kangra (Kirpal Chand Katoch) was filled with anger.

67.g: ਮੁਖੰ ਰਕਤ ਨੈਨੰ ਤਜੇ ਸਰਬ ਸੋਚੰ ॥
67.t: mukha(n) rakat naina(n) taje sarab socha(n) ||
67.e: His face and eyes became red with rage and he freed himself from all other thoughts.
From another side, the Khans entered with arrows in their hands.
It seemed that the leopards were roaming in search of flesh. ||26||
The kettledrums, the arrows and swords in action create their particular sounds.
The hands move towards the wounded waist.
The trumpets resound in the field and the minstrels sing their heroic ballads.

67.g: ਫਿਰੈ ਰੁੰਡ ਮੁੰਡੰ ਤਨੰ ਤੱਛ ਤੀਰੰ ॥੨੭॥
67.t: firai ru(n)dd mu(n)dda(n) tana(n) ta'chh teera(n) ||27||
67.e: The bodies are pierced by arrows and the headless trunks are moving in the field. ||27||
The blows of maces on helmets create knocking sounds.

67.g: ਰੁਲੇ ਲੱੁਥ ਜੁੱਥੰ ਗਿਰੇ ਬੀਰ ਮਾਰੇ ॥
67.t: rule la'uth ju'tha(n) gire beer maare ||
67.e: The bodies of killed warriors are rolling in dust.
The swords are inflicting wounds on the bodies of heroes

67.g: ਫਿਰੈ ਰੰੁਡ ਮੁੰਡੰ ਤਨੰ ਤੱਛ ਤੀਰੰ ॥੨੮॥
67.t: firai ra(n)udd mu(n)dda(n) tana(n) ta'chh teera(n) ||28||
67.e: The bodies pierced by arrows and headless trunks are moving in the field ||28||
The arms are engaged in continuously shooting arrows.
The striking swords are creating grave clattering sounds.

67.g: ਛਕੇ ਛੋਭ ਛਤ੍ਰ ਤਜੈ ਬਾਣ ਰਾਜੀ ॥
67.t: chhake chhobh chhatr tajai baan raajee ||
67.e: The warriors, in great fury, are showering volleys of arrows.

67.g: ਬਹੇ ਜਾਹਿ ਖਾਲੀ ਫਿਰੈ ਛੂਛ ਤਾਜੀ ॥੨੯॥
67.t: bahe jaeh khaalee firai chhoochh taajee ||29||
67.e: Because of the shower of arrows, horses are roaming without riders. ||29||

67.g: ਜੁਟੇ ਆਪ ਮੈ ਬੀਰ ਬੀਰੰ ਜੁਝਾਰੇ ॥
67.t: juTe aap mai beer beera(n) jujhaare ||
67.e: The brave warriors are fighting with each other.
They appear like the elephants with tusks fighting amongst themselves,
Or the tiger confronting the tiger.
In a similar manner, Gopal Chand Guleria is fighting with Kirpal Chand (the ally of Hussaini) ||30||

67.g: ਹਰੀ ਸਿੰਘ ਧਾਯੋ ਤਹਾਂ ਏਕ ਬੀਰੰ ॥
67.t: haree si(n)gh dhaayo tahaa(n) ek beera(n) ||
67.e: Then another warrior Hari Singh rushed into the field.

67.g: ਸਹੇ ਦੇਹ ਆਪੰ ਭਲੀ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਤੀਰੰ ॥
67.t: sahe dheh aapa(n) bhalee bhaa(n)t teera(n) ||
67.e: He received many arrows in his body.

68.g: ਮਹਾਂ ਕੋਪ ਕੈ ਬੀਰ ਬ੍ਰਿੰਦੰ ਸੰਘਾਰੇ ॥
68.t: mahaa(n) kop kai beer bira(n)dha(n) sa(n)ghaare ||
68.e: In a great rage, he killed many soldiers.

68.g: ਬਡੋ ਜੁਧ ਕੈ ਦੇਵ ਲੋਕੰ ਪਧਾਰੇ ॥੩੧॥
68.t: baddo judh kai dhev loka(n) padhaare ||31||
68.e: After a great fight he departed for the heavenly abode ||31||
The tenacious Himmat Singh and Kimmat Singh drew out their kirpans.
Jalal Khan joined with a mace.
The determined warriors fought, seemingly intoxicated.

68.g: ਪਰੀ ਕੁੱਟ ਕੱੁਟੰ ਉਠੀ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਝਾਰੰ ॥੩੨॥
68.t: paree ku'T ka'uTa(n) uThee sasatr jhaara(n) ||32||
68.e: There were blows after blows and the sparks fell, when the weapons struck each other ||32||
RASAAVAL STANZA
The Raja of Jaswal rushed forward on the galloping horse.
He surrounded Hussain and struck his sharp lance at him.33.
He (Hussaini) discharged arrow and destroyed much of the army.
He, who is struck by the arrow on his chest, he breathes his last.34.
Whenever one is wounded, he gets highly infuriated.
Then, holding his bow, he kills the warriors with arrows. 35.
The warriors advance from all the four sides and shout “kill, kill”.
They strike their weapons fearlessly, both the sides wish for their victory.36.
The sons of Khans, in great ire and puffed up with great ego,
Shower the rain of arrows  all the warriors are filled with anger.37.
There is spattering of arrows (in worship) and the bows seem engaged in Vedic discussion.
Wherever the warrior wants to strike the blow, he strikes it.38.
The brave fighters are busy in this task  they are engaged in war with all their wepons.
The warriors, with the quality of forbearance, are knocking forcefully and their swords are clattering.39.
The bows crackle and the swords clatter.
The arrows, when discharged, produce knocking sound, and the weapons when struck, produce jingling sound.40.
The warriors are striking their weapons, they do not think of the impending death.
The arrows are being discharged and the swords are being struck. 41.
The stream of bloods is full, the houris (the heavenly damsels) are moving in the sky.
On both sides, the warriors utter dreadful shouts.42.
PAADHARI STANZA
The ghosts are laughing loudly in the battlefield, the elephants are soiling in dust and the horses are roaming without riders.

68.g: ਜੁੱਟੇ ਸੁ ਬੀਰ ਤਹ ਕੜਕ ਜੰਗ ॥
68.t: ju'Te su beer teh kaRak ja(n)g ||

68.e: The warriors are fighting with one another and their weapons are creating knocking sounds. The swords are being struck and the arrows are being showered.43.
The vampires are shouting and the hagh are shrieking. The crows are cawing loudly and the double-edged swords are clattering.
The helmets are being knocked at and the guns are booming. The daggers are clattering and there is violent pushing. 44.
BHUJANG STANZA
Then Hussain himself entered the fray, all the warriors took up bows and arrows.

68.g: ਰੁਪੇ ਖਾਨਿ ਖੂਨੀ ਕਰੈ ਲਾਗ ਜੱੁਧੰ ॥
68.t: rupe khaan khoonee karai laag ja'udha(n) ||

68.g: ਮੁਖੰ ਰਕਤ ਨੈਣੰ ਭਰੇ ਸੂਰ ਕ੍ਰੁੱਧੰ ॥੪੫॥
68.t: mukha(n) rakat naina(n) bhare soor kru'dha(n) ||45||
68.e: The bloody Khans stood firmly and began to fight with faces and eyes red with ire.45.

68.g: ਜਗਿਯੋ ਜੰਗ ਜਾਲਮ ਸੁ ਜੋਧੰ ਜੁਝਾਰੰ ॥
68.t: jagiyo ja(n)g jaalam su jodha(n) jujhaara(n) ||

68.e: The terrible battle of valiant warriors began. The arrows, spears and double-edged swords were used by the heroes.

68.g: ਮਿਲੇ ਬੀਰ ਬੀਰੰ ਮਹਾਂ ਧੀਰ ਬੰਕੇ ॥
68.t: mile beer beera(n) mahaa(n) dheer ba(n)ke ||

68.e: The warriors met being pushed forward and the swords are jingling.46.

68.g: ਉਠੈ ਬਾਹੁ ਆਘਾਤ ਗੱਜੈ ਸੁ ਬੀਰੰ ॥
68.t: auThai baahu aaghaat ga'jai su beera(n) ||
68.e: The drums and the fifes are resounding, the arms rise to strike blows and the brave fighters are roaring.

68.g: ਰੁਲੇ ਤੱਛ ਮੁੱਛੰ ਉਠੀ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਝਾਰੰ ॥੪੭॥
68.t: rule ta'chh mu'chha(n) uThee sasatr jhaara(n) ||47||
68.e: The new trumpets resound in great numbers. The chopped heroes are rolling in dust and the sparks arise with the collision of weapons.47.

68.g: ਟਕਾ ਟੁੱਕ ਟੋਪੰ ਢਕਾ ਢੁੱਕ ਢਾਲੰ ॥
68.t: Takaa Tu'k Topa(n) ddakaa ddu'k ddaala(n) ||

68.e: The helmets and shield have been broken into bits and the great heroes shooting arrows look terrible and not elegant.

69.e: The heroic sprits, ghosts, fiends and goblins are dancing. The vampires, female demons and Shiva also are dancing.48.

69.g: ਛੁਟੀ ਜੋਗ ਤਾਰੀ ਮਹਾਂ ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਜਾਗੇ ॥
69.t: chhuTee jog taaree mahaa(n) rudhr jaage ||

69.g: ਡਗਿਯੋ ਧਿਆਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰ ਸਭੈ ਸਿੱਧ ਭਾਗੇ ॥
69.t: ddagiyo dhiaan brahama(n) sabhai si'dh bhaage ||
69.e: The Supreme Rudra hath awakened on coming out of the Yogic contemplation. The meditation of Brahma hath been interrupted and all the Siddhas (adepts) in great fear have run away from their abodes.
The Kinnaers, Yakshas and Vidyadhars are laughing and the wives of bards are dancing.49.

69.g: ਪਰਿਓ ਘੋਰ ਜੱੁਧੰ ਸੁ ਸੈਨਾ ਪਰਾਨੀ ॥
69.t: pario ghor ja'udha(n) su sainaa paraanee ||

69.g: ਤਹਾਂ ਖਾਂ ਹੁਸੈਨੀ ਮੰਡਿਓ ਬੀਰ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
69.t: tahaa(n) khaa(n) husainee ma(n)ddio beer baanee ||
69.e: The fight was most terrible and the army fled away. ] The great hero Hussain stood firmly in the field.

69.g: ਉਤੈ ਬੀਰ ਧਾਏ ਸੁ ਬੀਰੰ ਜਸ੍ਵਾਰੰ ॥
69.t: autai beer dhaae su beera(n) jasavaiaara(n) ||

69.g: ਸਬੈ ਬਿਉਤ ਡਾਰੇ ਬਗਾ ਸੇ ਅਸ੍ਵਾਰੰ ॥੫੦॥
69.t: sabai biaut ddaare bagaa se asavaiaara(n) ||50||
69.e: The heroes of Jaswal ran towards him. The horsemen were cut in the manner the cloth is cut (by the tailor).50.

69.g: ਤਹਾਂ ਖਾਂ ਹੁਸੈਨੀ ਰਹਿਓ ਏਕ ਠਾਢੰ ॥
69.t: tahaa(n) khaa(n) husainee rahio ek Thaadda(n) ||

69.g: ਮਨੋ ਜੱੁਧ ਖੰਭੰ ਰਣੰ ਭੂਮ ਗਾਡੰ ॥
69.t: mano ja'udh kha(n)bha(n) rana(n) bhoom gaadda(n) ||
69.e: There Hussain stood quite alone like the pole of a flagg fixed in the ground.

69.g: ਜਿਸੈ ਕੋਪ ਕੈ ਕੈ ਹਠੀ ਬਾਣ ਮਾਰਿਓ ॥
69.t: jisai kop kai kai haThee baan maario ||

69.g: ਤਿਸੈ ਛੇਦ ਕੈ ਪੈਲ ਪਾਰੇ ਪਧਾਰਿਓ ॥੫੧॥
69.t: tisai chhedh kai pail paare padhaario ||51||
69.e: Wherever that tenacious warrior shot his arrow, it pierced though the body and went out. 51.

69.g: ਸਹੇ ਬਾਣ ਸੂਰੰ ਸਭੈ ਆਣ ਢੂਕੈ ॥
69.t: sahe baan soora(n) sabhai aan ddookai ||

69.g: ਚਹੂੰ ਓਰ ਤੈ ਮਾਰ ਹੀ ਮਾਰ ਕੂਕੈ ॥
69.t: chahoo(n) or tai maar hee maar kookai ||
69.e: The warriors who were struck by arrows came together against him. From all the four sides, they shouted “kill, kill”.

69.g: ਭਲੀ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਸੋ ਅਸਤ੍ਰ ਅਉ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਝਾਰੇ ॥
69.t: bhalee bhaa(n)t so asatr aau sasatr jhaare ||

69.g: ਗਿਰੇ ਭਿਸਤ ਕੋ ਖਾਂ ਹੁਸੈਨੀ ਸਿਧਾਰੇ ॥੫੨॥
69.t: gire bhisat ko khaa(n) husainee sidhaare ||52||
69.e: They carried and struck their weapons very ably. At last Hussain fell down and left for heaven.52.
DOHRA

69.g: ਜਬੈ ਹੁਸੈਨੀ ਜੂਝਿਓ ਭਯੋ ਸੂਰ ਮਨ ਰੋਸੁ ॥
69.t: jabai husainee joojhio bhayo soor man ros ||
69.e: When Hussain was killed, the warriors were in great fury.

69.g: ਭਾਜਿ ਚਲੇ ਅਵਰੇ ਸਭੈ ਉਠਿਓ ਕਟੋਚਨ ਜੋਸੁ ॥੫੩॥
69.t: bhaaj chale avare sabhai uThio kaTochan jos ||53||
69.e: All the others fled, but the forces of Katoch felt excited. 53.
CHAUPAI
All the soldiers of Katoch with great anger together with Himmat and Kimmat.
Then Hari Singh, who came forward, killed many brave horsemen.54
NARAAJ STANZA
Then the Raja of Katoch became furious and stood firmly in the field.
He used his weapons unerringly shouting death (for the enemy).55.
(From the other side) the Raja of Chandel got enraged and attacked all in a body with indignation.
Those who faced him were killed and those who remained behind, ran away.56.
DOHRA

69.g: ਸਾਤ ਸਵਾਰਨ ਕੈ ਸਹਿਤ ਜੂਝੇ ਸੰਗਤ ਰਾਇ ॥
69.t: saat savaaran kai sahit joojhe sa(n)gat rai ||
69.e: (Sangita Singh) died with his seven companions.

69.g: ਦਰਸੋ ਸੁਨਿ ਜੂਝੈ ਤਿਨੈ ਬਹੁਤ ਜੁਝਤ ਭਯੋ ਆਇ ॥੫੭॥
69.t: dharaso sun joojhai tinai bahut jujhat bhayo aai ||57||
69.e: When Darsho came to know of it, he also came in the field and died. 57.

69.g: ਹਿੰਮਤ ਹੂੰ ਉਤਰਿਯੋ ਤਹਾ ਬੀਰ ਖੇਤ ਮੰਝਾਰ ॥
69.t: hi(n)mat hoo(n) utariyo tahaa beer khet ma(n)jhaar ||
69.e: Then Himmat came in the battlefield.

69.g: ਕੇਤਨ ਕੇ ਤਨਿ ਘਾਇ ਸਹਿ ਕੇਤਨਿ ਕੈ ਤਨਿ ਝਾਰ ॥੫੮॥
69.t: ketan ke tan ghai seh ketan kai tan jhaar ||58||
69.e: He received several wounds and struck his weapons on several others.58.

69.g: ਬਾਜ ਤਹਾਂ ਜੂਝਤ ਭਯੋ ਹਿੰਮਤ ਗਯੋ ਪਰਾਇ ॥
69.t: baaj tahaa(n) joojhat bhayo hi(n)mat gayo parai ||
69.e: His horse was killed there, but Himmat fled.

69.g: ਲੋਥ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਹਿ ਕੀ ਨਮਿਤ ਕੋਪਿ ਪਰੇ ਅਰਰਾਇ ॥੫੯॥
69.t: loth kirapaaleh kee namit kop pare ararai ||59||
69.e: The warriors of Katoch came with great rage in order to take away the dead body of their Raja Kirpal.59.
RASAAVAL STANZA
The warriors are busy in wreaking vengeance, they become martyrs facing the sword.
The warrior Kirpa Ram fought so severely that all the army seems to be running away. 60.
He tramples the big army and strikes his weapon fearlessly.

70.e: After destroying many and receiving approbation, he hath left.61.
The conches and trumpets resound and their sound is heard constantly.
The tabors and drums resound and the warriors are taking out their weapons.62.
There is overcrowding and the kings have fallen as martyrs.
The warriors on whose faces there are winsome whiskers, they are shouting very loudly.63.
From their mouths, they are shouting “kill. Kill”, and roam in the battlefield.
They hold their weapons and cause the horses of both sides to flee.64
DOHRA

70.g: ਰਣ ਜੁਝਤ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਕੇ ਨਾਚਤ ਭਯੋ ਗੁਪਾਲ ॥
70.t: ran jujhat kirapaal ke naachat bhayo gupaal ||
70.e: When Kirpal died in the battlefield, Gopal rejoiced.

70.g: ਸੈਨ ਸਭੈ ਸਿਰਦਾਰ ਦੈ ਭਾਜਤ ਭਈ ਬਿਹਾਲ ॥੬੫॥
70.t: sain sabhai siradhaar dhai bhaajat bhiee bihaal ||65||
70.e: All the army fled in disorder, when their leaders Hussain and Kirpal were killed. 65.

70.g: ਖਾਨ ਹੁਸੈਨ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਕੇ ਹਿੰਮਤ ਰਣ ਜੂਝੰਤ ॥
70.t: khaan husain kirapaal ke hi(n)mat ran joojha(n)t ||
70.e: After the death of Hussain and Kirpal and the fall of Himmat

70.g: ਭਾਜਿ ਚਲੇ ਜੋਧਾ ਸਬੈ ਜਿਮ ਦੇ ਮੁਕਟ ਮਹੰਤ ॥੬੬॥
70.t: bhaaj chale jodhaa sabai jim dhe mukaT maha(n)t ||66||
70.e: All the warriors fled, just as people go away after giving authority to the Mahant.66.
CHAUPAI

70.g: ਇਹ ਬਿਧ ਸਤੁ੍ਰ ਸਬੈ ਚੁਨਿ ਮਾਰੇ ॥
70.t: eeh bidh satur sabai chun maare ||

70.e: In this way, all the enemies were aimed and killed. After that they took care of their dead.
Then on seeing Himmat lying wounded, Ram Singh said to Gopal.67.
“That Himmat, who had been the root-cause of all the quarrels, hath now fallen wounded in our hands.”
When Gopal heard these words, he killed Himmat and did not allow him to get up alive. 68.
The victory was gained and the battle ended. While remembering homes, all went there.
The Lord protected me from the cloud of battle, which rained elsewhere. 69.

70.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕ ਗ੍ਰੰਥੇ ਹੁਸੈਨੀ ਬਧ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਹਿੰਮਤ ਸੰਗਤੀਆ ਬਧ ਬਰਨਨੰ ਨਾਮ ਗਿਆਰਮੋ ਧਿਆਇ ਸਮਾਪਤ ਮਸਤੁ ਸੁਭ ਮਸਤੁ ॥੧੧॥ਅਫਜੂ॥੪੨੩॥
70.t: eit sree bachitr naaTak gra(n)the husainee badh kirapaal hi(n)mat sa(n)gateeaa badh baranana(n) naam giaaramo dhiaai samaapat masat subh masat ||11||afajoo||423||
70.e: End of Eleventh Chapter of BACHITTAR NATAK entitled Description of the Killing of Hussaini and also the Killing of Kirpal, Himmat and Sangatia.11.423
CHAUPAI
In this way, the great battle was fought, when the leader of the Turks (Muslims) was killed.
On this Dilawar become very angry and sent a contingent of horsemen in this direction.1.
From the other side, Jujhar Singh was sent, who drove out the enemy from Bhallan immediately.

70.g: ਇਤਿ ਗਜ ਸਿੰਘ ਪੰਮਾ ਦਲ ਜੋਰਾ ॥
70.t: eit gaj si(n)gh pa(n)maa dhal joraa ||

70.e: On this side Gaj Singh and Pamma (Parmanand) assembled their forces and fell upon them early in the morning.2.

70.g: ਜਿਮ ਰਨ ਖੰਭ ਭੂਮਿ ਰਨਿ ਗਾਡਾ ॥
70.t: jim ran kha(n)bh bhoom ran gaaddaa ||
70.e: On the other side Jujhar Singh stood firmly like a flagpost planted in the battlefield.

70.g: ਗਾਡਾ ਚਲੇ ਨ ਹਾਡਾ ਚਲਿ ਹੈ ॥
70.t: gaaddaa chale na haaddaa chal hai ||

70.g: ਸਾਮੁਹਿ ਸੇਲ ਸਮਰ ਮੋ ਝਲਿ ਹੈ ॥੩॥
70.t: saamuh sel samar mo jhal hai ||3||
70.e: Even the flagpost might be loosened, but the brave Rajput did not waver, he received the blows without flinching.3.
The warriors of both armies moved in detachments, Raja of Chandel on that side and Raja of Jaswar on this side.

71.e: All the warriors were in great rage and the fight began in the battlefield.4.

71.g: ਕੋਪ ਭਰੇ ਦੋਊ ਦਿਸ ਭਟ ਭਾਰੇ ॥
71.t: kop bhare dhouoo dhis bhaT bhaare ||

71.e: The brave heroes of both the armies were in great anger, warriors of Chandel on this side and warriors of Jaswar on the other.
Many drums and trumpets resounded, the terrible Bhairo (the god of war) shouted.5.
RASAAVAL STANZA
Listening to the resounding voice of the drums, the warriors thunder.
They inflict wounds with weapons, their minds filled with great zest.6.
Fearlessly, they cause their horses to run and strike the blows of axes.
Many inflict wounds with their swords and the minds of all are very enthusiastic.7.
From their mouths, they shout “kill, kill”, without any doubts.
The chopped warriors are rolling in dust and wish to go to heaven.8.
DOHRA

71.g: ਨੈਕ ਨ ਰਨ ਤੇ ਮੁਰਿ ਚਲੈਂ ਕਰੈ ਨਿਡਰ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਘਾਇ ॥
71.t: naik na ran te mur chalai(n) karai niddar havai ghai ||
71.e: They do not retrace their steps from the battlefield and inflict wounds fearlessly.

71.g: ਗਿਰ ਗਿਰ ਪਰੈ ਪਵੰਗ ਤੇ ਬਰੇਂ ਬਰੰਗਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੯॥
71.t: gir gir parai pava(n)g te bare(n) bara(n)gan jai ||9||
71.e: Those who fall from their horses, the heavenly damsels go to wed them.9.
CHAUPAI
In this way, the battle continued on both sides (with great vigour). Chandan Rai was killed.
Then Jujhar Singh continued the fight quite alone. He was surrounded from all sides.10.
DOHRA

71.g: ਧਸਿਯੋ ਕਟਕ ਮੈ ਝਟਕ ਦੈ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਸੰਕ ਬਿਚਾਰ ॥
71.t: dhasiyo kaTak mai jhaTak dhai kachhoo na sa(n)k bichaar ||
71.e: He rushed into the army of the enemy without any hesitation.

71.g: ਗਾਹਤ ਭਯੋ ਸੁਭਟਨ ਬਡੇ ਬਾਹਤਿ ਭਯੋ ਹਥਿਆਰ ॥੧੧॥
71.t: gaahat bhayo subhaTan badde baahat bhayo hathiaar ||11||
71.e: And killed many soldiers, wielding his weapons very skillfully.11.
CHAUPAI

71.g: ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਘਣੇ ਘਰਨ ਕੋ ਗਾਰਾ ॥
71.t: eeh bidh ghane gharan ko gaaraa ||
71.e: In this way, he destroyed many homes.
He used various types of weapons.
He aimed and killed the brave horsemen.
But at last he left for the heavenly abode himself. ||12||

71.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕ ਗ੍ਰੰਥੇ ਜੁਝਾਰ ਸਿੰਘ ਜੁਧ ਬਰਨਨੰ ਨਾਮ ਦ੍ਵਾਦਸਮੋ ਧਿਆਇ ਸਮਾਪਤ ਮਸਤੁ ਸੁਭ ਮਸਤੁ ॥੧੨॥ਅਫਜੂ॥੪੩੫॥
71.t: eit sree bachitr naaTak gra(n)the jujhaar si(n)gh judh baranana(n) naam dhavaiaadhasamo dhiaai samaapat masat subh masat ||12||afajoo||435||
71.e: End of the Twelfth Chapter of BACHITTAR NATAK entitled Description of the battle with Jujhar Singh. True, all is true. ||12|| Continues ||435||
The arrival of Shahzada (the prince) in Madra Desha (Punjab):
CHAUPAI

71.g: ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਸੋ ਬਧ ਭਯੋ ਜੁਝਾਰਾ ॥
71.t: eeh bidh so badh bhayo jujhaaraa ||

71.e: In this way, when Jujhar Singh was killed, the soldiers returned to their homes.
Then Aurangzeb became very angry and sent his son to Madr Desha (Punjab).1.
On his arrival, all were frightened and hid themselves in big hills.

71.g: ਕਾਲ ਕਰਮ ਕੋ ਮਰਮ ਨ ਪਾਯੋ ॥੨॥
71.t: kaal karam ko maram na paayo ||2||
71.e: The people tried to frighten me also, because they did not understand the ways of Almighty.2.
Some people left us and took refuge in the big hills.
The cowards were so much frightened that they did not consider their safety with me.3.
The son of Aurangzeb grew very angry and sent a subordinate in this direction.

71.g: ਹਮ ਤੇ ਭਾਜਿ ਬਿਮੁਖ ਜੇ ਗਏ ॥
71.t: ham te bhaaj bimukh je ge ||

71.e: Those who had left me in distrust, their homes were demolished by him.4.

71.g: ਜੇ ਅਪਨੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਫਿਰਹੈਂ ॥
71.t: je apane gur te mukh firahai(n) ||

71.g: ਈਹਾਂ ਊਹਾਂ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਗਿਰਿਹੈਂ ॥
71.t: e'eehaa(n) uoohaa(n) tin ke gireh girihai(n) ||
71.e: Those who turn away their faces from the Guru, their houses are demolished in this and the next world.

71.g: ਇਹਾਂ ਉਪਹਾਸ ਨ ਸੁਰ ਪੁਰ ਬਾਸਾ ॥
71.t: eihaa(n) upahaas na sur pur baasaa ||

71.e: They are ridiculed here and also do not get an abode in heaven. They also remain disappointed in all things.5.

71.g: ਦੂਖ ਭੂਖ ਤਿਨ ਕੋ ਰਹੈ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
71.t: dhookh bhookh tin ko rahai laagee ||

71.g: ਸੰਤ ਸੇਵ ਤੇ ਜੋ ਹੈ ਤਿਆਗੀ ॥
71.t: sa(n)t sev te jo hai tiaagee ||
71.e: They are always inflicted by hunger and sorrow, those, who have forsaken the service of the saints.

71.g: ਜਗਤ ਬਿਖੈ ਕੋਈ ਕਾਮ ਨ ਸਰਹੀਂ ॥
71.t: jagat bikhai koiee kaam na sarahee(n) ||

71.e: None of their wishes are fulfilled in the world and in the end, they abide in the fire of the abyss of hell.6.
They are always ridiculed in the world and in the end, they abide in the fire of the abyss of hell.

71.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਗ ਤੇ ਜੇ ਬੇਮੁਖ ਸਿਧਾਰੇ ॥
71.t: gur pag te je bemukh sidhaare ||

71.g: ਈਹਾਂ ਊਹਾ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਮੁਖ ਕਾਰੇ ॥੭॥
71.t: e'eehaa(n) uoohaa tin ke mukh kaare ||7||
71.e: Those, who turn away their face from the feet of the Guru, their faces are blackened in this and the next world.7.

71.g: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਪਉਤ੍ਰ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਨਹੀਂ ਫਰੈਂ ॥
71.t: putr pautr tin ke nahee(n) farai(n) ||

71.g: ਦੁਖ ਦੈ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਕੋ ਮਰੈਂ ॥
71.t: dhukh dhai maat pitaa ko marai(n) ||
71.e: Their sons and grandsons do not prosper and they die, creating great agony for their parents.

71.g: ਗੁਰ ਦੋਖੀ ਸਗ ਕੀ ਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
71.t: gur dhokhee sag kee mrit paavai ||

71.e: The one, who hath malice of the Guru in his heart, dies the death of ad dog. He repents, when he is thrown in the abyss of hell.8.
The successors of both, Baba (Nanak) and Badur were created by God Himself.

72.e: Recognise the former as the spiritual king and the later as temporal king.9.

72.g: ਜੋ ਬਾਬੇ ਕੋ ਦਾਮ ਨ ਦੈਹੈਂ ॥
72.t: jo baabe ko dhaam na dhaihai(n) ||

72.g: ਤਿਨ ਤੇ ਗਹਿ ਬਾਬਰ ਕੇ ਲੈਹੈਂ ॥
72.t: tin te geh baabar ke laihai(n) ||
72.e: Those who do not deliver the Guru’s money, the successors of Babur shall seize and take away forcibly from them.

72.g: ਦੈ ਦੈ ਤਿਨ ਕੌ ਬਡੀ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
72.t: dhai dhai tin kau baddee sajai ||

72.e: They will be greatly punished and their houses will he plundered.10.
Those impertinent persons will be without money, they will beg for it from the Sikhs.

72.g: ਜੇ ਜੇ ਸਿਖ ਤਿਨੈ ਧਨ ਦੈਹੈਂ ॥
72.t: je je sikh tinai dhan dhaihai(n) ||

72.e: And those Sikhs, who will give them money, their houses will be plundered by the Malechhas (barbarians).11.

72.g: ਜਬ ਹੁਇ ਹੈ ਤਿਨ ਦਰਬ ਬਿਨਾਸਾ ॥
72.t: jab hui hai tin dharab binaasaa ||

72.g: ਤਬ ਧਰਿਹੈ ਨਿਜ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਆਸਾ ॥
72.t: tab dharihai nij gur kee aasaa ||
72.e: When their wealth will be destroyed, then they will keep hopes on their Guru.

72.g: ਜਬ ਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੋ ਐਹੈਂ ॥
72.t: jab te gur dharasan ko aaihai(n) ||

72.g: ਤਬ ਤਿਨ ਕੋ ਗੁਰ ਮੁਖ ਨ ਲਗੈਹੈਂ ॥੧੨॥
72.t: tab tin ko gur mukh na lagaihai(n) ||12||
72.e: They will all come then to have a sight of the Guru, but the Guru will not receive them.12.

72.g: ਸਰਿਹੈ ਕੋਈ ਨ ਤਿਨ ਕੋ ਕਾਮੰ ॥
72.t: sarihai koiee na tin ko kaama(n) ||
72.e: Then without seeking the permission of the Guru, they will return to their homes, therefore none of their work will be fruitful.

72.g: ਗੁਰ ਦਰ ਢੋਈ ਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੁਰ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
72.t: gur dhar ddoiee na prabh pur vaasaa ||

72.e: He, who doth not get the refuge at the house of the Guru, he doth not get an abode in the Court of the Lord. He remains disappointed at both the places, in this world as well as the next world.13.

72.g: ਜੇ ਜੇ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨਨ ਰਤ ਹ੍ਵੈਹੈਂ ॥
72.t: je je gur charanan rat havaihai(n) ||

72.g: ਤਿਨ ਕੋ ਕਸਟ ਨ ਦੇਖਨ ਪੈਹੈਂ ॥
72.t: tin ko kasaT na dhekhan paihai(n) ||
72.e: Those, who are the devotees of Guru’s feet, the sufferings cannot touch them.

72.g: ਰਿਧ ਸਿਧ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮਾਹੀਂ ॥
72.t: ridh sidh tin ke gireh maahee(n) ||

72.g: ਪਾਪ ਤਾਪ ਛ੍ਵੈ ਸਕੈ ਨ ਛਾਹੀਂ ॥੧੪॥
72.t: paap taap chhavai sakai na chhaahee(n) ||14||
72.e: The wealth and prosperity always abide in their house and the sins and ailments cannot even come near their shadow.14.

72.g: ਅਸਟ ਸਿਧ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਹੈ ਘਰਿ ਮਾਹਾਂ ॥
72.t: asaT sidh havai hai ghar maahaa(n) ||
72.e: The malechha (barbarian) cannot touch their shadow, the eight miraculous powers in their house.

72.g: ਨਵੋ ਨਿਧਿ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਘਰਿ ਐਹੈਂ ॥੧੫॥
72.t: navo nidh tin ke ghar aaihai(n) ||15||
72.e: Even if they endeavour to reap gain by way of fun, the nine treasures come to their abode by themselves.15.
Mirza Beg was the name of the officer, who demolished the houses of the apostates.

72.g: ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਬਾਰ ਨ ਬਾਂਕਨ ਪਾਏ ॥੧੬॥
72.t: tin ke baar na baa(n)kan paae ||16||
72.e: Those who remained faithful, were protected by the Guru, not even a little harm was done to them.16.
There the son of Aurangzeb grew most angry, he sent four other officers.

72.g: ਜੇ ਬੇਮੁਖ ਤਾਂ ਤੇ ਬਚਿ ਆਏ ॥
72.t: je bemukh taa(n) te bach aae ||

72.g: ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਪੁਨਿ ਇਨੈ ਗਿਰਾਏ ॥੧੭॥
72.t: tin ke gireh pun inai giraae ||17||
72.e: Those apostates who had escaped (the punishment) earlier, there hoses were demolished by the officers. 17.

72.g: ਜੇ ਤਜਿ ਭਜੇ ਹੁਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਆਨਾ ॥
72.t: je taj bhaje hute gur aanaa ||

72.e: Those who had fled form Anandpur forsaking the refuge of the Guru and considered are officers as their Guru.
Who have put the urine on their heads and shaved them, it appears that they Guru, these officers enquired about their address from others.18.

72.g: ਜੇ ਜੇ ਭਾਜ ਹੁਤੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਆਇਸੁ ॥
72.t: je je bhaaj hute bin aais ||

72.e: Those who had fled from Anandpur without the permission of their Guru, these officers enquired about their address from others.
They have got their heads shaved and caused them to move throughout the city. It appears that they have been sent to collect the offerings by the officers.19.
The boys who are following them and jeering them, appear like their disciples and servants.
The nose-bags containing turd of the horses, tied on their faces make them appear to have received for eating the sweetmeat from their homes.20.
The marks of the wounds on their foreheads, cussed by the beating with shoes, look like the frontal marks put by the officers (as Guru).

73.e: The wounds on heads caused by the brick-hittings, appear like the previous offering given to them.21.
DOHRA

73.g: ਕਬਹੂੰ ਰਣ ਜੂਝਿਓ ਨਹੀ ਕਛੁ ਦੈ ਜਸੁ ਨਹਿ ਲੀਨ ॥
73.t: kabahoo(n) ran joojhio nahee kachh dhai jas neh leen ||
73.e: Those who have never participated in the war in the battlefield and also have not earned approbation by offering bride.

73.g: ਗਾਂਵ ਬਸਤ ਜਾਨਿਯੋ ਨਹੀ ਜਮ ਸੋ ਕਿਨ ਕਹਿ ਦੀਨ ॥੨੨॥
73.t: gaa(n)v basat jaaniyo nahee jam so kin keh dheen ||22||
73.e: Who are not known by anybody as the residents of the village, it is, indeed, wonderful as to who hath given their address to Yama (the god of death)?22.
CHAPAI
In this way, the apostates received foul treatment. All the saints saw this spectacle.
No harm was done to them, the Lord saved them Himself.23.
CHAARNI. DOHRA

73.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਸਾਜਨ ਰਾਖਸੀ ਦੁਸਮਨ ਕਵਨ ਬਿਚਾਰ ॥
73.t: jis no saajan raakhasee dhusaman kavan bichaar ||
73.e: To whomsoever the Lord protects, the enemy can do nothing to him.

73.g: ਛ੍ਵੈ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਤਿਹ ਛਾਹਿ ਕੌ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਜਾਇ ਗਵਾਰ ॥੨੪॥
73.t: chhavai na sakai teh chhaeh kau nihafal jai gavaar ||24||
73.e: None can touch his shadow, the fool makes useless effort.24.

73.g: ਜੋ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਰਣੀ ਪਰੇ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਕਵਨ ਬਿਚਾਰ ॥
73.t: jo saadhoo saranee pare tin ke kavan bichaar ||
73.e: Those who have taken refuge with the saints, what can be said about them?

73.g: ਦੰਤ ਜੀਭ ਜਿਮ ਰਾਖਿ ਹੈ ਦੁਸਟ ਅਰਿਸਟ ਸੰਘਾਰ ॥੨੫॥
73.t: dha(n)t jeebh jim raakh hai dhusaT arisaT sa(n)ghaar ||25||
73.e: God saves from the inimical and wicked persons by destroying them, just as the tongue is protected within the teeth.25.

73.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕ ਗ੍ਰੰਥੇ ਸ਼ਾਹਜ਼ਾਦੇ ਵ ਅਹਿਦੀਆ ਗਮਨ ਬਰਨਨੰ ਨਾਮ ਤ੍ਰੌਦਸਮੋ ਧਿਆਇ ਸਮਾਪਤ ਮਸਤੁ ਸੁਭ ਮਸਤੁ ॥੧੩॥ਅਫਜੂ॥੪੬੦॥
73.t: eit sree bachitr naaTak gra(n)the shaahazaadhe v ahidheeaa gaman baranana(n) naam trauadhasamo dhiaai samaapat masat subh masat ||13||afajoo||460||
73.e: End of the Thirteenth Chapter of BACHITTAR NATAK entitled ‘Description of the Arrival of Shahzada (the Prince) and the Officers’.13.460
CHAUPAI

73.g: ਦੁਖੁ ਦੈ ਕੈ ਦੋਖੀ ਸਭ ਮਾਰੇ ॥
73.t: dhukh dhai kai dhokhee sabh maare ||
73.e: At all times, the Lord protected all the saints and hath killed all the malicious persons, subjecting them to great agony.
He hath exhibited His marvelous State to saints and hath saved them from all sufferings.1.
He hath saved His saints from all sufferings. He hath destroyed all the malevolent persons like the thorns.
Considering me as His Servant, He hath helped me, and hath protected me with His own hands.2.

73.g: ਅਬ ਜੋ ਜੋ ਮੈਂ ਲਖੇ ਤਮਾਸਾ ॥
73.t: ab jo jo mai(n) lakhe tamaasaa ||

73.e: All hose spectacles which have been visualized by me, I dedicate all of them to Thee.
If Thou castest Thy Merciful glance at me, then Thy Servant shall utter all.3.

73.g: ਜਿਹ ਜਿਹ ਬਿਧ ਮੈ ਲਖੇ ਤਮਾਸਾ ॥
73.t: jeh jeh bidh mai lakhe tamaasaa ||

73.e: The kinds of spectacles that I have seen, I want to enlighten (the world) about them.
All the past lives that have peeped into, I shall speak about them with Thy Power.4.
He, my Lord is Father and Destroyer of all, the goddess Kalika is my mother.

73.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਮੋ ਕੋ ਸੁਭ ਕ੍ਰਿਆ ਪੜ੍ਹਾਈ ॥੫॥
73.t: jin mo ko subh kriaa paRhaiee ||5||
73.e: The mind is my Guru and the discriminating intellect, the Guru’s wife is my mother, who hath taught me all about good deeds.5.
When I (as mind) reflected on the kindness of the discriminating intellect, the Guru\'s mind uttered his refined statement.

73.g: ਤੇ ਤੇ ਅਬ ਚਹੀਅਤ ਹੈ ਕਹੇ ॥੬॥
73.t: te te ab chaheeat hai kahe ||6||
73.e: All the wonderful things that were comprehended by the ancient sages, I want to speak about all of them.6.
Then my Lord, Destroyer of all, was filled with kindness and considering me as His servant, He was gracefully pleased.

73.g: ਸੋ ਸੋ ਸਭ ਸਿਮਰਣ ਕਰ ਦਯੋ ॥੭॥
73.t: so so sabh simaran kar dhayo ||7||
73.e: The births of all the incarnations in the previous ages, He hath caused me to remember all of them.7.

73.g: ਮੋ ਕੌ ਇਤੀ ਹੁਤੀ ਕਹ ਸੁੱਧੰ ॥
73.t: mo kau itee hutee keh su'dha(n) ||

73.g: ਜਸ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਈ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਬੁੱਧੰ ॥
73.t: jas prabh dhiee kirapaa kar bu'dha(n) ||
73.e: How could I have all this information? The Lord mercifully gave such intellect.

73.g: ਲੋਹ ਰਛ ਹਮ ਕੋ ਸਬ ਕਾਲਾ ॥੮॥
73.t: loh rachh ham ko sab kaalaa ||8||
73.e: My Lord, the Destroyer of all, then became Benevolent, At all times, I gave the Protection of at that steel-incarnated Lord.8.
At all times, Lord, Destroyer of all, protects me. That All-Pervading Lord is my Protector like Steel.
Comprehending Thy Kindness, I have become fearless and in my pride, I consider myself as the king of all. 9.

73.g: ਜਿਹ ਜਿਹ ਬਿਧ ਜਨਮਨ ਸੁਧਿ ਆਈ ॥
73.t: jeh jeh bidh janaman sudh aaiee ||

73.e: The way in which I came to know about the births of incarnations, in the same manner, I have rendered them in books.
The way, in which I came to know about Satyuga, I have narrated it in the first poem of the miraculous feats of the goddess.10.

73.g: ਨਖ ਸਿਖ ਤੇ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਭਾਖ ਸੁਨਾਯੋ ॥
73.t: nakh sikh te kram bhaakh sunaayo ||
73.e: The miraculous feats of goddess Chandi have been composed earlier, I have compsed (the same) in strict order from top to toe.
In the beginning I composed a comprehensive discourse, but now I want again to compose an Eulogy.11.

73.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕ ਗ੍ਰੰਥੇ ਸਰਬ ਕਾਲ ਕੀ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਬਰਨਨੰ ਨਾਮ ਚੌਦਸਮੋ ਧਿਆਇ ਸਮਾਪਤ ਮਸਤੁ ਸੁਭ ਮਸਤੁ ॥੧੪॥ਅਫਜੂ॥੪੭੧॥
73.t: eit sree bachitr naaTak gra(n)the sarab kaal kee benatee baranana(n) naam chauadhasamo dhiaai samaapat masat subh masat ||14||afajoo||471||
73.e: End of Fourteenth Chapter of BACHITTAR NATAK entitled ‘Description of the Supplication to the Lord, Destroyer of All’||14||Continues||471||

74.g: ਚੰਡੀ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ॥
74.t: cha(n)ddee charitr ||
74.e: NAME OF THE BANI.

74.g: ੴ ਵਾਹਿਗੁਰੂ ਜੀ ਕੀ ਫਤਹ ॥
74.t: ikOankaar vaahiguroo jee kee fateh ||
74.e: The Lord is one and the Victory is of the Lord.

74.g: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਭਗਉਤੀ ਜੀ ਸਹਾਇ ॥
74.t: sree bhagautee jee sahai ||

74.g: ਅਥ ਚੰਡੀ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਉਕਤਿ ਬਿਲਾਸ ਲਿਖ੍ਯਤੇ ॥
74.t: ath cha(n)ddee charitr ukat bilaas likhayate ||
74.e: New begin the extraordinary feats from the Life of Chandi:

74.t: paatisaahee 10 ||

74.g: ਸ੍ਵੈਯਾ ॥
74.t: savaiyaa ||
74.e: SWAYYA

74.g: ਆਦਿ ਅਪਾਰ ਅਲੇਖ ਅਨੰਤ ਅਕਾਲ ਅਭੇਖ ਅਲੱਖ ਅਨਾਸਾ ॥
74.t: aadh apaar alekh ana(n)t akaal abhekh ala'kh anaasaa ||
74.e: The Lord is Primal, Infinite, Account less, Boundless, Deathless, Garbless, Incomprehensible and Eternal.

74.g: ਕੈ ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤ ਦਏ ਸ੍ਰੁਤਿ ਚਾਰ ਰਜੋ ਤਮ ਸੱਤ ਤਿਹੂ ਪੁਰ ਬਾਸਾ ॥
74.t: kai siv sakat dhe srut chaar rajo tam sa't tihoo pur baasaa ||
74.e: He created Shiva-Shakti, four Vedas and three modes of maya and pervades in three worlds.

74.g: ਦਿਉਸ ਨਿਸਾ ਸਸਿ ਸੂਰ ਕੈ ਦੀਪ ਸੁ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਰਚੀ ਪੰਚ ਤੱਤ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸਾ ॥
74.t: dhiaus nisaa sas soor kai dheep su sirasaT rachee pa(n)ch ta't prakaasaa ||
74.e: He created day and night, the lamps of sun and moon and the whole world with five elements.

74.g: ਬੈਰ ਬਢਾਇ ਲਰਾਇ ਸੁਰਾਸੁਰ ਆਪਹਿ ਦੇਖਤ ਬੈਠ ਤਮਾਸਾ ॥੧॥
74.t: bair baddai larai suraasur aapeh dhekhat baiTh tamaasaa ||1||
74.e: He extended enmity and fight between the gods and demons and Himself seated (on His Throne) scans it.1.

74.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
74.t: dhoharaa ||
74.e: DOHRA

74.g: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਸਿੰਧ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਜੋ ਕਛੁ ਮੋ ਪਰਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
74.t: kirapaa si(n)dh tumaree kirapaa jo kachh mo par hoi ||
74.e: O Ocean of Mercy, if Thy Grace is bestowed upon me:

74.g: ਰਚੋ ਚੰਡਕਾ ਕੀ ਕਥਾ ਬਾਣੀ ਸੁਭ ਸਭ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
74.t: racho cha(n)ddakaa kee kathaa baanee subh sabh hoi ||2||
74.e: I may compose the story of Chandika and my poetry be all good.2.

74.g: ਜੋਤ ਜਗਮਗੈ ਜਗਤਿ ਮੈ ਚੰਡ ਚਮੁੰਡ ਪ੍ਰਚੰਡ ॥
74.t: jot jagamagai jagat mai cha(n)dd chamu(n)dd pracha(n)dd ||
74.e: Thy light is shining in the world, O Powerful Chand-Chamunda!

74.g: ਭੁਜ ਦੰਡਨ ਦੰਡਨਿ ਅਸੁਰ ਮੰਡਨ ਭੁਇ ਨਵ ਖੰਡ ॥੩॥
74.t: bhuj dha(n)ddan dha(n)ddan asur ma(n)ddan bhui nav kha(n)dd ||3||
74.e: Thou art the Punisher of the demons with Thy strong arms and art the Creator of the nine regions.3.

74.g: ਸ੍ਵੈਯਾ ॥
74.t: savaiyaa ||
74.e: SWAYYA

74.g: ਤਾਰਨ ਲੋਕ ਉਧਾਰਨ ਭੂਮਹਿ ਦੈਤ ਸੰਘਾਰਨ ਚੰਡ ਤੁਹੀ ਹੈ ॥
74.t: taaran lok udhaaran bhoomeh dhait sa(n)ghaaran cha(n)dd tuhee hai ||
74.e: Thou art the same Chandika, who ferries across the people. Thou art the redeemer of the earth and destroyer of the demons.

74.g: ਕਾਰਨ ਈਸ ਕਲਾ ਕਮਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਅਦ੍ਰਸੁਤਾ ਜਹ ਦੇਖੇ ਉਹੀ ਹੈ ॥
74.t: kaaran iees kalaa kamalaa har adhrasutaa jeh dhekhe uhee hai ||
74.e: Thou art the cause of the Shakti of Shiva, Lakshmi of Vishnu and Parvati, the daughter of Himavan, wherever we see, Thou art there.

74.g: ਤਾਮਸਤਾ ਮਮਤਾ ਨਮਤਾ ਕਵਿਤਾ ਕਵਿ ਕੇ ਮਨ ਮੱਧਿ ਗੁਹੀ ਹੈ ॥
74.t: taamasataa mamataa namataa kavitaa kav ke man ma'dh guhee hai ||
74.e: Thou art Tams, the quality of morbidity, mineness and modesty. Thou art poetry, latent in the mind of the poet.

74.g: ਕੀਨੋ ਹੈ ਕੰਚਨ ਲੋਹ ਜਗਤ੍ਰ ਮੈ ਪਾਰਸ ਮੂਰਤ ਜਾਇ ਛੁਹੀ ਹੈ ॥੪॥
74.t: keeno hai ka(n)chan loh jagatr mai paaras moorat jai chhuhee hai ||4||
74.e: Thou art the philosopher’s stone in the world, which transforms the iron into gold that it touches.4.

74.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
74.t: dhoharaa ||
74.e: DOHRA

74.g: ਪ੍ਰਮੁਦ ਕਰਨ ਸਭ ਭੈ ਹਰਨ ਨਾਮ ਚੰਡਕਾ ਜਾਸ ॥
74.t: pramudh karan sabh bhai haran naam cha(n)ddakaa jaas ||
74.e: She whose name is Chandika, delights and removes fear of all.

74.g: ਰਚੋ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਤੁਅ ਕਰੋ ਸਬੁੱਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸ ॥੫॥
74.t: racho charitr bachitr tua karo sabu'dh prakaas ||5||
74.e: Illumine me with good intellect, so that I may compose Thy wonderful deeds.5.

74.g: ਪੁਨਹਾ ॥
74.t: punahaa ||
74.e: PUNHA

74.g: ਆਇਸ ਅਬ ਜੋ ਹੋਇ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਤਉ ਮੈ ਰਚੌ ॥
74.t: aais ab jo hoi gra(n)th tau mai rachau ||
74.e: If I am permitted now, I shall compose my Granth (scripture).

74.g: ਰਤਨ ਪ੍ਰਮੁਦ ਕਰ ਬਚਨ ਚੀਨ ਤਾ ਮੈ ਗਚੌ ॥
74.t: ratan pramudh kar bachan cheen taa mai gachau ||
74.e: I shall find and set the delight-giving gem-like words.

74.g: ਭਾਖਾ ਸੁਭ ਸਭ ਕਰਹੋਂ ਧਰਿਹੋਂ ਕ੍ਰਿੱਤ ਮੈ ॥
74.t: bhaakhaa subh sabh karaho(n) dhariho(n) kira't mai ||
74.e: In this composition, I shall use the beautiful language

74.g: ਅਦਭੁਤ ਕਥਾ ਅਪਾਰ ਸਮਝ ਕਰਿ ਚਿੱਤ ਮੈ ॥੬॥
74.t: adhabhut kathaa apaar samajh kar chi't mai ||6||
74.e: And whatever I have thought in my mind, I shall narrate that wonderful story.6.

75.g: ਸ੍ਵੈਯਾ ॥
75.t: savaiyaa ||
75.e: SWAYYA

75.g: ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਕੇ ਹੁਇ ਕੈ ਉਦਾਸ ਅਵਾਸ ਕੋ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਬਸਿਓ ਬਨਰਾਈ ॥
75.t: traas kuTa(n)b ke hui kai udhaas avaas ko tiaag basio banaraiee ||
75.e: Dejected on account of the tragic happening in the family, he deserted his home and came to live in the forest.

75.g: ਨਾਮ ਸੁਰੱਥ ਮੁਨੀਸਰ ਬੇਖ ਸਮੇਤ ਸਮਾਦ ਸਮਾਧ ਲਗਾਈ ॥
75.t: naam sura'th muneesar bekh samet samaadh samaadh lagaiee ||
75.e: His name was Surath and adopting the garb of sages, he engaged himself in contemplation.

75.g: ਚੰਡ ਅਖੰਡ ਖੰਡੇ ਕਰ ਕੋਪ ਭਈ ਸੁਰ ਰੱਛਨ ਕੋ ਸਮੁਹਾਈ ॥
75.t: cha(n)dd akha(n)dd kha(n)dde kar kop bhiee sur ra'chhan ko samuhaiee ||
75.e: The goddess Chandika of perfect brilliance is there before all, She is the destroyer of demons and Protector of gods.

75.g: ਬੂਝਹੁ ਜਾਇ ਤਿਨੈ ਤੁਮ ਸਾਧ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਕਥਾ ਕਿਹ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਸੁਨਾਈ ॥੭॥
75.t: boojhahu jai tinai tum saadh agaadh kathaa keh bhaa(n)t sunaiee ||7||
75.e: The sage Surath asked his companion sage, “O hermit, help us comprehend now, what Chandi's marvelous story is about?”7.

75.g: ਤੋਟਕ ਛੰਦ ॥
75.t: toTak chha(n)dh ||
75.e: TOTAK STANZA

75.g: ਮੁਨੀਸੁਰੋ ਵਾਚ ॥
75.t: muneesuro vaach ||
75.e: The Great Sage said:

75.g: ਹਰਿ ਸੋਇ ਰਹੈ ਸਜ ਸੈਨ ਤਹਾ ॥
75.t: har soi rahai saj sain tahaa ||

75.g: ਜਲ ਜਾਲ ਕਰਾਲ ਬਿਸਾਲ ਜਹਾ ॥
75.t: jal jaal karaal bisaal jahaa ||
75.e: The Lord was sleeping on an adorned bed, within the terrible and vast expanse of water.

75.g: ਭਯੋ ਨਾਭ ਸਰੋਜ ਤੇ ਬਿਸੁ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
75.t: bhayo naabh saroj te bis karataa ||

75.g: ਸ੍ਰੁਤ ਮੈਲ ਤੇ ਦੈਤ ਰਚੇ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥੮॥
75.t: srut mail te dhait rache jugataa ||8||
75.e: From His navel-lotus Brahma was born, with some device, the demons were created from the dross of His ear.8.

75.g: ਮਧਿਕੈਟਭ ਨਾਮ ਧਰੇ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ॥
75.t: madhikaiTabh naam dhare tin ke ||

75.g: ਅਤਿ ਦੀਰਘ ਦੇਹ ਭਏ ਜਿਨ ਕੇ ॥
75.t: at dheeragh dheh bhe jin ke ||
75.e: They were named as Madhu and Kaitabh, their bodies were enormously great.

75.g: ਤਿਨ ਦੇਖ ਲੁਕੇਸ ਡਰਿਓ ਹੀਅ ਮੈ ॥
75.t: tin dhekh lukes ddario heea mai ||

75.g: ਜਗਮਾਤ ਕੋ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਰਯੋ ਜੀਅ ਮੈ ॥੯॥
75.t: jagamaat ko dhiaan dharayo jeea mai ||9||
75.e: Seeing them, Brahma became fearful, He contemplated in his mind on the universal mother.9.

75.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
75.t: dhoharaa ||
75.e: DOHRA

75.g: ਛੁਟੀ ਚੰਡ ਜਾਗੇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਰਿਓ ਜੁੱਧ ਕੋ ਸਾਜ ॥
75.t: chhuTee cha(n)dd jaage braham kario ju'dh ko saaj ||
75.e: When the Lord Vishnu awoke from sleep, he made preparations for war.

75.g: ਦੈਤ ਸਭੈ ਘਟਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਜਿਉ ਬਢੈ ਦੇਵਤਨ ਰਾਜ ॥੧੦॥
75.t: dhait sabhai ghaT jaeh jiau baddai dhevatan raaj ||10||
75.e: So that the demons may decrease in number and the rule of gods be increased.10.

75.g: ਸ੍ਵੈਯਾ ॥
75.t: savaiyaa ||
75.e: SWAYYA

75.g: ਜੁੱਧ ਕਰਿਓ ਤਿਨ ਸੋਂ ਭਗਵੰਤ ਨ ਮਾਰ ਸਕੈ ਅਤਿ ਦੈਤ ਬਲੀ ਹੈ ॥
75.t: ju'dh kario tin so(n) bhagava(n)t na maar sakai at dhait balee hai ||
75.e: The Lord waged the war against the demons, but He could not kill them because they were very brave.

75.g: ਸਾਲ ਭਏ ਤਿਨ ਪੰਚ ਹਜਾਰ ਦੁਹੂੰ ਲਰਤੇ ਨਹਿ ਬਾਂਹ ਟਲੀ ਹੈ ॥
75.t: saal bhe tin pa(n)ch hajaar dhuhoo(n) larate neh baa(n)h Talee hai ||
75.e: It took five thousand years in fighting, but they were not tired.

75.g: ਦੈਤਨ ਰੀਝ ਕਹਿਓ ਬਰ ਮਾਂਗ ਕਹਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਸੀਸਨ ਦੇਹ ਭਲੀ ਹੈ ॥
75.t: dhaitan reejh kahio bar maa(n)g kahio har seesan dheh bhalee hai ||
75.e: Having been pleased with the power of the Lord, the demons asked the Lord to request for a boon, the Lord asked them to surrender their bodies.

75.g: ਧਾਰਿ ਉਰੂ ਪਰਿ ਚਕ੍ਰ ਸੋਂ ਕਾਟ ਕੈ ਜੋਤਿ ਲੈ ਆਪਨੈ ਅੰਗ ਮਲੀ ਹੈ ॥੧੧॥
75.t: dhaar uroo par chakr so(n) kaaT kai jot lai aapanai a(n)g malee hai ||11||
75.e: Putting them in his lap, the Lord cut off their heads and assimilated their strength within Himself.11.

75.g: ਸੋਰਠਾ ॥
75.t: soraThaa ||
75.e: SORATHA

75.g: ਦੇਵਨ ਥਾਪਿਓ ਰਾਜ ਮਧੁਕੈਟਭ ਕੋ ਮਾਰਿ ਕੈ ॥
75.t: dhevan thaapio raaj madhukaiTabh ko maar kai ||
75.e: The Lord established the rule of gods after killing Madhu and Kaitabh.

75.g: ਦੀਨੋ ਸਕਲ ਸਮਾਜ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਗਾਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਭਏ ॥੧੨॥
75.t: dheeno sakal samaaj baiku(n)Th gaamee har bhe ||12||
75.e: He gave all the paraphernalia to them and Himself went to Heaven.12.

75.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਮਾਰਕੰਡੇ ਪੁਰਾਨੇ ਚੰਡੀ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਉਕਤਿ ਬਿਲਾਸ ਮਧਕੈਟਭ ਬਧਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਥਮ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥
75.t: eit sree maaraka(n)dde puraane cha(n)ddee charitr ukat bilaas madhakaiTabh badheh pratham dhiaai ||1||
75.e: End of the First Chapter of ‘The Killing of Madhu and Kaitabh’ as described in CHANDI CHARITRA UKATI of Markandeya Purana.1.

76.g: ਪੁਨਹਾ ॥
76.t: punahaa ||
76.e: PUNHA

76.g: ਬਹੁਰਿ ਭਇਓ ਮਹਖਾਸੁਰ ਤਿਨ ਤੋ ਕਿਆ ਕੀਆ ॥
76.t: bahur bhio mahakhaasur tin to kiaa keeaa ||
76.e: Then there appeared Mahishasura and whatever he did is as follows:

76.g: ਭੁਜਾ ਜੋਰ ਕਰਿ ਜੁੱਧ ਜੀਤ ਸਭ ਜਗੁ ਲੀਆ ॥
76.t: bhujaa jor kar ju'dh jeet sabh jag leeaa ||
76.e: With his armed strength, he conquered the whole world.

76.g: ਸੁਰ ਸਮੂਹ ਸੰਘਾਰੇ ਰਣਹਿ ਪਚਾਰ ਕੈ ॥
76.t: sur samooh sa(n)ghaare raneh pachaar kai ||
76.e: He challenged all the gods in the battlefield.

76.g: ਟੂਕ ਟੂਕ ਕਰ ਡਾਰੇ ਆਯੁਧ ਧਾਰ ਕੈ ॥੧੩॥
76.t: Took Took kar ddaare aayudh dhaar kai ||13||
76.e: And with his weapons he chopped them all.13.

76.g: ਸ੍ਵੈਯਾ ॥
76.t: savaiyaa ||
76.e: SWAYYA

76.g: ਜੱੁਧ ਕਰਯੋ ਮਹਿਖਾਸੁਰ ਦਾਨਵ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਭੈ ਸੁਰ ਸੈਨ ਗਿਰਾਇਓ ॥
76.t: ja'udh karayo mahikhaasur dhaanav maar sabhai sur sain giraio ||
76.e: The demons-king Mahishasura waged the war and killed all the forces of gods.

76.g: ਕੈ ਕੈ ਦੁ ਟੂਕ ਦਏ ਅਰ ਖੇਤ ਮਹਾਂ ਬਰ ਬੰਡ ਮਹਾ ਰਨ ਪਾਇਓ ॥
76.t: kai kai dh Took dhe ar khet mahaa(n) bar ba(n)dd mahaa ran paio ||
76.e: He cut the mighty warriors into halves and threw them in the field, he waged such a terrible and fierce war.

76.g: ਸ੍ਰਉਣਤ ਰੰਗ ਸਨਿਓ ਨਿਸਰਿਓ ਜਸੁ ਇਆ ਛਬਿ ਕੋ ਮਨ ਮੈ ਇਹ ਆਇਓ ॥
76.t: sraunat ra(n)g sanio nisario jas iaa chhab ko man mai ieh aaio ||
76.e: Seeing him besmeared with the blood, it seems thus in the mind of the poet:

76.g: ਮਾਰਿ ਕੈ ਛਤ੍ਰਨਿ ਕੁੰਡ ਕੈ ਛੇਤ੍ਰ ਮੈ ਮਾਨਹੁ ਪੈਠਿ ਕੈ ਰਾਮ ਜੂ ਨ੍ਹਾਇਓ ॥੧੪॥
76.t: maar kai chhatran ku(n)dd kai chhetr mai maanahu paiTh kai raam joo nhaio ||14||
76.e: As if killing the Kashatriyas, Parshuram has bathed himself in their blood.14.

76.g: ਸ੍ਵੈਯਾ॥ ਲੈ ਮਹਖਾਸੁਰ ਅਸਤ੍ਰ ਸੁ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਭੈ ਕਲਵਤ੍ਰ ਜਿਉ ਚੀਰ ਕੈ ਡਾਰੇ ॥
76.t: savaiyaa|| lai mahakhaasur asatr su sasatr sabhai kalavatr jiau cheer kai ddaare ||
76.e: With his arms and weapons, Mahishasura sawed and threw the warriors as in a saw.

76.g: ਲੁੱਥ ਪੈ ਲੁੱਥ ਰਹੀ ਗੁੱਥ ਜੁੱਥ ਗਿਰੇ ਗਿਰ ਸੇ ਰਥ ਸੇਂਧਵ ਭਾਰੇ ॥
76.t: lu'th pai lu'th rahee gu'th ju'th gire gir se rath se(n)dhav bhaare ||
76.e: The corpse fell off the corpse and the big horses have fallen in flocks like mountains.

76.g: ਗੂਦ ਸਨੇ ਸਿਤ ਲੋਹੂ ਮੈ ਲਾਲ ਕਰਾਲ ਪਰੇ ਰਨ ਮੈ ਗਜ ਕਾਰੇ ॥
76.t: goodh sane sit lohoo mai laal karaal pare ran mai gaj kaare ||
76.e: The black elephants have fallen in the field alongwith white fat and red blood.

76.g: ਜਿਉ ਦਰਜੀ ਜਮ ਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕੇ ਸੀਤ ਮੈ ਬਾਗੇ ਅਨੇਕ ਕਤਾ ਕਰਿ ਡਾਰੇ ॥੧੫॥
76.t: jiau dharajee jam mirat ke seet mai baage anek kataa kar ddaare ||15||
76.e: They all are lying dead as if the tailor, cutting the clothes makes their heaps.15.

76.g: ਸ੍ਵੈਯਾ ॥ ਲੈ ਸੁਰ ਸੰਗ ਸਬੈ ਸੁਰਪਾਲ ਸੁ ਕੋਪ ਕੇ ਸਤ੍ਰ ਕੀ ਸੈਨ ਪੈ ਧਾਏ ॥
76.t: savaiyaa || lai sur sa(n)g sabai surapaal su kop ke satr kee sain pai dhaae ||
76.e: Indra taking all gods with him, invaded the forces of the enemy.

76.g: ਦੈ ਮੁਖ ਢਾਰ ਲੀਏ ਕਰਵਾਰ ਹਕਾਰ ਪਚਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰ ਲਗਾਏ ॥
76.t: dhai mukh ddaar le'ee karavaar hakaar pachaar prahaar lagaae ||
76.e: Covering the face with shield and holding the sword in hand, they attacked with loud shouts.

76.g: ਸ੍ਰਉਨ ਮੈ ਦੇਤ ਸੁਰੰਗ ਭਏ ਕਵਿ ਨੇ ਮਨ ਭਾਉ ਇਹੈ ਛਬਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
76.t: sraun mai dhet sura(n)g bhe kav ne man bhaau ihai chhab paae ||
76.e: The demons are dyed with blood and it seems to the poet

76.g: ਰਾਮ ਮਨੋ ਰਨ ਜੀਤ ਕੈ ਭਾਲਕ ਦੈ ਸਿਰਪਾਉ ਸਭੈ ਪਹਰਾਏ ॥੧੬॥
76.t: raam mano ran jeet kai bhaalak dhai sirapaau sabhai paharaae ||16||
76.e: As if Rama after conquering the war is bestowing (the red coloured) robes of honour to all bears.16.

76.g: ਘਾਇਲ ਘੂਮਤ ਹੈ ਰਨ ਮੈ ਇਕ ਲੋਟਤ ਹੈ ਧਰਨੀ ਬਿਲਲਾਤੇ ॥
76.t: ghail ghoomat hai ran mai ik loTat hai dharanee bilalaate ||
76.e: Many wounded warriors are rolling in the battlefield and many of them are writhing and crying on the ground.

76.g: ਦਉਰਤ ਬੀਚ ਕਬੰਧ ਫਿਰੈ ਜਿਹ ਦੇਖਤ ਕਾਇਰ ਹੈਂ ਡਰਪਾਤੇ ॥
76.t: dhaurat beech kaba(n)dh firai jeh dhekhat kair hai(n) ddarapaate ||
76.e: The trunks are also twirling there, seeing which the cowards are frightened.

76.g: ਇਯੋ ਮਹਿਖਾਸੁਰ ਜੁੱਧੁ ਕੀਯੋ ਤਬ ਜੰਬੁਕ ਗਿਰਝ ਭਏ ਰੰਗ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
76.t: eiyo mahikhaasur ju'dh keeyo tab ja(n)buk girajh bhe ra(n)g raate ||
76.e: Mahishasura waged such a war that the jackals and vultures were highly pleased.

76.g: ਸ੍ਰੌਨ ਪ੍ਰਵਾਹ ਮੈ ਪਾਇ ਪਸਾਰ ਕੇ ਸੋਏ ਹੈਂ ਸੂਰ ਮਨੋ ਮਦ ਮਾਤੇ ॥੧੭॥
76.t: srauan pravaeh mai pai pasaar ke soe hai(n) soor mano madh maate ||17||
76.e: And the heroes, being intoxicated, are lying prostrate in the stream of blood.17.

76.g: ਸ੍ਵੈਯਾ ॥ ਜੁੱਧ ਕੀਓ ਮਹਖਾਸੁਰ ਦਾਨਵ ਦੇਖਤ ਭਾਨ ਚਲੈ ਨਹੀਂ ਪੰਥਾ ॥
76.t: savaiyaa || ju'dh keeo mahakhaasur dhaanav dhekhat bhaan chalai nahee(n) pa(n)thaa ||
76.e: Seeing the fighting in the war of the demon Mahishasura, the sun is not moving on its orbit.

76.g: ਸ੍ਰੌਨ ਸਮੂਹ ਚਲਿਓ ਲਖਿ ਕੈ ਚਤੁਰਾਨਨ ਭੂਲਿ ਗਏ ਸਭ ਗ੍ਰੰਥਾ ॥
76.t: srauan samooh chalio lakh kai chaturaanan bhool ge sabh gra(n)thaa ||
76.e: Brahma has also forgotten his texts on beholding the stream of blood.

76.g: ਮਾਸ ਨਿਹਾਰ ਕੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਝ ਰੜੈਂ ਚਟਸਾਰ ਪੜੈਂ ਜਿਮੁ ਬਾਰਕ ਸੰਥਾ ॥
76.t: maas nihaar kai girajh raRai(n) chaTasaar paRai(n) jim baarak sa(n)thaa ||
76.e: Seeing the flesh, the vultures are seated in such a way, as if the children are learning their lessons in school.

76.g: ਸਾਰਸੁਤੀ ਤਟ ਲੈ ਭਟ ਲੋਥ ਸ੍ਰਿੰਗਾਲ ਕਿ ਸਿੱਧ ਬਨਾਵਤ ਕੰਥਾ ॥੧੮॥
76.t: saarasutee taT lai bhaT loth sira(n)gaal k si'dh banaavat ka(n)thaa ||18||
76.e: The jackals are pulling the corpses in the field in such a way as if the Yogis, sitting on the banks of Sarswati are mending their patched quilts.18.

77.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
77.t: dhoharaa ||
77.e: DOHRA

77.g: ਅਗਨਤ ਮਾਰੇ ਗਨੈ ਕੋ ਭਜੈ ਜੁ ਸੁਰ ਕਰਿ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ॥
77.t: aganat maare ganai ko bhajai ju sur kar traas ||
77.e: Innumerable gods were killed and innumerable ran away in fear.

77.g: ਧਾਰਿ ਧਿਆਨ ਮਨ ਸਿਵਾ ਕੋ ਤਕੀ ਪੁਰੀ ਕੈਲਾਸ ॥੧੯॥
77.t: dhaar dhiaan man sivaa ko takee puree kailaas ||19||
77.e: All (the remaining) gods, meditating on Shiva, went towards Kailash mountain.19.

77.g: ਦੇਵਨ ਕੇ ਧਨ ਧਾਮ ਸਭ ਦੈਤਨ ਲੀਓ ਛਿਨਾਇ ॥
77.t: dhevan ke dhan dhaam sabh dhaitan leeo chhinai ||
77.e: The demons seized all the abodes and wealth of gods.

77.g: ਦਏ ਕਾਢ ਸੁਰ ਧਾਮ ਤੇ ਬਸੇ ਸਿਵ ਪੁਰੀ ਜਾਇ ॥੨੦॥
77.t: dhe kaadd sur dhaam te base siv puree jai ||20||
77.e: They drove them out of the city of gods, the gods then came to live in the city of Shiva.20.

77.g: ਕਿਤਕਿ ਦਿਵਸ ਬੀਤੇ ਤਹਾਂ ਨਾਵਨ ਨਿਕਸੀ ਦੇਵ ॥
77.t: kitak dhivas beete tahaa(n) naavan nikasee dhev ||
77.e: After several days had passed by, the goddess came to bathe there

77.g: ਬਿਧ ਪੂਰਬ ਸਭ ਦੇਵਤਨ ਕਰੀ ਦੇਵ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ॥੨੧॥
77.t: bidh poorab sabh dhevatan karee dhev kee sev ||21||
77.e: All the gods, according to the prescribed method, made obeisance to her.21.

77.g: ਰੇਖਤਾ ॥
77.t: rekhataa ||
77.e: REKHTA

77.g: ਕਰੀ ਹੈ ਹਕੀਕਤ ਮਲੂਮ ਖੁਦ ਦੇਵੀ ਸੇਤੀ ਲੀਆ ਮਹਖਾਸੁਰ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਛੀਨ ਧਾਮ ਹੈ ॥
77.t: karee hai hakeekat maloom khudh dhevee setee leeaa mahakhaasur hamaaraa chheen dhaam hai ||
77.e: The gods told the goddess the truth, stating that the demon-king Mahikhasur had seized all their homes.

77.g: ਕੀਜੈ ਸੋਈ ਬਾਤ ਮਾਤ ਤੁਮ ਕਉ ਸੁਹਾਤ ਸਭ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਦੀਮ ਤਕ ਆਏ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਾਮ ਹੈ ॥
77.t: keejai soiee baat maat tum kau suhaat sabh sevak kadheem tak aae teree saam hai ||
77.e: They said, “O mother, Thou mayest do whatever pleasest Thee, we have all come to seek Thy refuge.

77.g: ਦੀਜੈ ਬਾਜ ਦੇਸ ਹਮੈ ਮੇਟੀਐ ਕਲੇਸ ਲੇਸ ਕੀਜੀਐ ਅਭੇਸ ਉਨੈ ਬਡੋ ਯਹ ਕਾਮ ਹੈ ॥
77.t: dheejai baaj dhes hamai meTeeaai kales les keejeeaai abhes unai baddo yeh kaam hai ||
77.e: “Please get us back our abodes, remove our suffering and make those demons garbles and wealthless. This is a very great task which can only be accomplished by Thee.

77.g: ਕੂਕਰ ਕੋ ਮਾਰਤ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਨਾਮ ਲੈ ਕੈ ਤਾਹਿ ਮਾਰਤ ਹੈ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਲੈ ਕੈ ਖਾਵੰਦ ਕੋ ਨਾਮ ਹੈ ॥੨੨॥
77.t: kookar ko maarat na kouoo naam lai kai taeh maarat hai taa ko lai kai khaava(n)dh ko naam hai ||22||
77.e: “No one beats or talks ill to the dog, only his master is rebuked and censured.”22.

77.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
77.t: dhoharaa ||
77.e: DOHRA

77.g: ਸੁਨਤ ਬਚਨ ਏ ਚੰਡਕਾ ਮਨ ਮੈਂ ਉਠੀ ਰਿਸਾਇ ॥
77.t: sunat bachan e cha(n)ddakaa man mai(n) uThee risai ||
77.e: Hearing These words, Chandika was filled with great rage in her mind.

77.g: ਸਭ ਦੈਤਨ ਕੋ ਛੈ ਕਰਉ ਬਸਉ ਸਿਵਪੁਰੀ ਜਾਇ ॥੨੩॥
77.t: sabh dhaitan ko chhai karau basau sivapuree jai ||23||
77.e: She said, “I shall destroy all the demons, go and abide in the city of Shiva.23.

77.g: ਦੈਤਨ ਕੇ ਬਧ ਕੋ ਜਬੈ ਚੰਡੀ ਕੀਓ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸ ॥
77.t: dhaitan ke badh ko jabai cha(n)ddee keeo prakaas ||
77.e: When the idea of destroying the demons was given by Chandi

77.g: ਸਿੰਘ ਸੰਖ ਅਉ ਅਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਭ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਆਇਗੇ ਪਾਸ ॥੨੪॥
77.t: si(n)gh sa(n)kh aau asatr sabh sasatr aaige paas ||24||
77.e: The lion, conch and all other weapons and arms came themselves to her.24.

77.g: ਦੈਤ ਸੰਘਾਰਨ ਕੇ ਨਮਿਤ ਕਾਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਇਹ ਲੀਨ ॥
77.t: dhait sa(n)ghaaran ke namit kaal janam ieh leen ||
77.e: It seemed that Death itself had taken the birth to destroy the demons.

77.g: ਸਿੰਘ ਚੰਡ ਬਾਹਨ ਭਇਓ ਸਤ੍ਰਨ ਕਉ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੀਨ ॥੨੫॥
77.t: si(n)gh cha(n)dd baahan bhio satran kau dhukh dheen ||25||
77.e: The lion, who causes great suffering to the enemies, became the vehicle of the goddess Chandi.25.

77.g: ਸ੍ਵੈਯਾ ॥
77.t: savaiyaa ||
77.e: SWAYYA

77.g: ਦਾਰੁਨ ਦੀਰਘੁ ਦਿਗਜ ਸੇ ਬਲਿ ਸਿੰਘਹਿ ਕੇ ਬਲ ਸਿੰਘ ਧਰੇ ਹੈ ॥
77.t: dhaarun dheeragh dhigaj se bal si(n)gheh ke bal si(n)gh dhare hai ||
77.e: The terrible form of the lion is like an elephant, he is mighty like a big lion.

77.g: ਰੋਮ ਮਨੋ ਸਰ ਕਾਲਹਿ ਕੇ ਜਨ ਪਾਹਨ ਪੀਤ ਪੈ ਬ੍ਰਿਛ ਹਰੇ ਹੈ ॥
77.t: rom mano sar kaaleh ke jan paahan peet pai birachh hare hai ||
77.e: The hair of the lion are like arrows and appear as trees growing on a yellow mountain.

77.g: ਮੇਰ ਕੇ ਮਧਿ ਮਨੋ ਜਮਨਾ ਲਰਿ ਕੇਤਕੀ ਪੁੰਜ ਪੈ ਭ੍ਰਿੰਗ ਢਰੇ ਹੈ ॥
77.t: mer ke madh mano jamanaa lar ketakee pu(n)j pai bhira(n)g ddare hai ||
77.e: The back-line of the lion looks like the current of Yamuna on the mountain, and the black hair on his body appear like the black bees on the flower of Ketki.

77.g: ਮਾਨੋ ਮਹਾ ਪ੍ਰਿਥ ਲੈ ਕੇ ਕਮਾਨ ਸੁ ਭੂਧਰ ਭੂਮ ਤੇ ਨਿਆਰੇ ਕਰੇ ਹੈ ॥੨੬॥
77.t: maano mahaa pirath lai ke kamaan su bhoodhar bhoom te niaare kare hai ||26||
77.e: Various sinewy limbs seem like the action of king Prithy of segregating the mountains from the earth by raising his bow and shootin with all his might.26.

77.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
77.t: dhoharaa ||
77.e: DOHRA

77.g: ਘੰਟਾ ਗਦਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਸੂਲ ਅਸਿ ਸੰਖ ਸਰਾਸਨ ਬਾਨ ॥
77.t: gha(n)Taa gadhaa tirasool as sa(n)kh saraasan baan ||
77.e: The gong, mace trident, sword, conch, bow and arrows

77.g: ਚਕ੍ਰ ਬਕ੍ਰ ਕਰ ਮੈ ਲੀਏ ਜਨੁ ਗ੍ਰੀਖਮ ਰਿਤੁ ਭਾਨੁ ॥੨੭॥
77.t: chakr bakr kar mai le'ee jan greekham rit bhaan ||27||
77.e: Alongwith the terrible disc-the godess took all these weapons in her hands  they have created the atmosphere like summer’s sun.27.

77.g: ਚੰਡ ਕੋਪ ਕਰਿ ਚੰਡਿਕ ਾ ਏ ਆਯੁਧ ਕਰਿ ਲੀਨ ॥
77.t: cha(n)dd kop kar cha(n)ddik aa e aayudh kar leen ||
77.e: In fierce rage, Chandika took the weapons in her hands

77.g: ਨਿਕਟਿ ਬਿਕਟਿ ਪੁਰ ਦੈਤ ਕੇ ਘੰਟਾ ਕੀ ਧੁਨਿ ਕੀਨ ॥੨੮॥
77.t: nikaT bikaT pur dhait ke gha(n)Taa kee dhun keen ||28||
77.e: And near the city of demons, raised the horrible sound of her gong.28.

77.g: ਸੁਨਿ ਘੰਟਾ ਕੇਹਰਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਅਸੁਰਨ ਅਸਿ ਰਨ ਲੀਨ ॥
77.t: sun gha(n)Taa kehar sabadh asuran as ran leen ||
77.e: Hearing the loud voice of the gong, and the lion-demons holding their swords entered the battlefield.

77.g: ਚੜੇ ਕੋਪ ਕੈ ਜੂਥ ਹੁਇ ਜਤਨ ਜੁਧ ਕੋ ਕੀਨ ॥੨੯॥
77.t: chaRe kop kai jooth hui jatan judh ko keen ||29||
77.e: They came furiously in great numbers and began to wage the war.29.

77.g: ਪੈਤਾਲੀਸ ਪਦਮ ਅਸੁਰ ਸਜ੍ਯੋ ਕਟਕ ਚਤੁਰੰਗਿ ॥
77.t: paitaalees padham asur sajayo kaTak chatura(n)g ||
77.e: Forty-five padam army of the demons adorned with their four divisions.

77.g: ਕਛੁ ਬਾਏ ਕਛੁ ਦਾਹਨੈ ਕਛੁ ਭਟ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਕੇ ਸੰਗਿ ॥੩੦॥
77.t: kachh baae kachh dhaahanai kachh bhaT nirap ke sa(n)g ||30||
77.e: Some on the left and some on the right and some warriors with the king.30.

77.g: ਭਏ ਇਕਠੇ ਦਲ ਪਦਮ ਦਸ ਪੰਦ੍ਰਹ ਅਰੁ ਬੀਸ ॥
77.t: bhe ikaThe dhal padham dhas pa(n)dhreh ar bees ||
77.e: All the army of forty-five padam was divided into ten, fifteen and twenty.

77.g: ਪੰਦ੍ਰਹ ਕੀਨੇ ਦਾਹਨੇ ਦਸ ਬਾਏ ਸੰਗਿ ਬੀਸ ॥੩੧॥
77.t: pa(n)dhreh keene dhaahane dhas baae sa(n)g bees ||31||
77.e: Fifteen on the right, ten of the left, followed by twenty with the king.31.

77.g: ਸ੍ਵੈਯਾ ॥
77.t: savaiyaa ||
77.e: SWAYYA

77.g: ਦਉਰ ਸਬੈ ਇਕ ਬਾਰ ਹੀ ਦੈਤ ਸੁ ਆਏ ਹੈ ਚੰਡ ਕੇ ਸਾਮੁਹੇ ਕਾਰੇ ॥
77.t: dhaur sabai ik baar hee dhait su aae hai cha(n)dd ke saamuhe kaare ||
77.e: All those black demons ran and stood before Chandika.

77.g: ਲੈ ਕਰਿ ਬਾਨ ਕਮਾਨਨ ਤਾਨਿ ਘਨੇ ਅਰੁ ਕੋਪ ਸੋ ਸਿੰਘ ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰੇ ॥
77.t: lai kar baan kamaanan taan ghane ar kop so si(n)gh prahaare ||
77.e: Taking arrows with extended bows, many enemies in great fury attacked the lion.

77.g: ਚੰਡ ਸੰਭਾਰਿ ਤਬੈ ਕਰਵਾਰ ਹਕਾਰ ਕੈ ਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਮੂਹ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
77.t: cha(n)dd sa(n)bhaar tabai karavaar hakaar kai satr samooh nivaare ||
77.e: Protecting herself from all attacks, and challenging all the enemies, Chandika dispelled them.

77.g: ਖਾਡਵ ਜਾਰਨ ਕੋ ਅਗਨੀ ਤਿਹ ਪਾਰਥ ਨੈ ਜਨੁ ਮੇਘ ਬਿਡਾਰੇ ॥੩੨॥
77.t: khaaddav jaaran ko aganee teh paarath nai jan megh biddaare ||32||
77.e: Just as Arjuna had dispelled the clouds, which came to protect the Khandav forest from being burnt by fire.32.

77.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
77.t: dhoharaa ||
77.e: DOHRA

77.g: ਦੈਤ ਕੋਪ ਇਕ ਸਾਮੁਹੇ ਗਇਓ ਤੁਰੰਗਮ ਡਾਰਿ ॥
77.t: dhait kop ik saamuhe gio tura(n)gam ddaar ||
77.e: One of the demons went on a galloping horse with rage

77.g: ਸਨਮੁਖ ਦੇਵੀ ਕੇ ਭਇਓ ਸਲਭ ਦੀਪ ਅਨੁਹਾਰ ॥੩੩॥
77.t: sanamukh dhevee ke bhio salabh dheep anuhaar ||33||
77.e: Went before the goddess like the moth before the lamp.33.

77.g: ਸ੍ਵੈਯਾ ॥
77.t: savaiyaa ||
77.e: SWAYYA

77.g: ਬੀਰ ਬਲੀ ਸਿਰਦਾਰ ਦੈਈਤ ਸੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਕੈ ਮਿਯਾਨ ਤੇ ਖਗੁ ਨਿਕਾਰਿਓ ॥
77.t: beer balee siradhaar dhaieet su krodh kai miyaan te khag nikaario ||
77.e: That mighty chieftain of the demons took out his sword from the sheath in great ire.

77.g: ਏਕ ਦਇਓ ਤਨਿ ਚੰਡ ਪ੍ਰਚੰਡ ਕੈ ਦੂਸਰ ਕੇਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸਿਰ ਝਾਰਿਓ ॥
77.t: ek dhio tan cha(n)dd pracha(n)dd kai dhoosar kehar ke sir jhaario ||
77.e: He gave oneblow to Chandi and the second on the head of the lion.

77.g: ਚੰਡ ਸੰਭਾਰਿ ਤਬੈ ਬਲੁ ਧਾਰਿ ਲਇਓ ਗਹਿ ਨਾਰਿ ਧਰਾ ਪਰ ਮਾਰਿਓ ॥
77.t: cha(n)dd sa(n)bhaar tabai bal dhaar lio geh naar dharaa par maario ||
77.e: Chandi, protecting herself from all the blows, caught hold of the demon in her might arms and threw him on the ground

77.g: ਜਿਉ ਧੁਬੀਆ ਸਰਤਾ ਤਟਿ ਜਾਇ ਕੇ ਲੈ ਪਟ ਕੋ ਪਟ ਸਾਥ ਪਛਾਰਿਓ ॥੩੪॥
77.t: jiau dhubeeaa sarataa taT jai ke lai paT ko paT saath pachhaario ||34||
77.e: Just as the washerman beats the clothes in washing against a wooden plank on the bank of the stream.34.

77.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
77.t: dhoharaa ||
77.e: DOHRA

78.g: ਦੇਵੀ ਮਾਰਿਓ ਦੈਤ ਇਉ ਲਰਿਓ ਜੁ ਸਨਮੁਖ ਆਇ ॥
78.t: dhevee maario dhait iau lario ju sanamukh aai ||
78.e: In this way, the goddess killed the demon, who came and fought before her.

78.g: ਪੁਨਿ ਸਤ੍ਰਨਿ ਕੀ ਸੈਨ ਮੈ ਧਸੀ ਸੁ ਸੰਖ ਬਜਾਇ ॥੩੫॥
78.t: pun satran kee sain mai dhasee su sa(n)kh bajai ||35||
78.e: Then she penetrated into the army of the enemies by blowing her conch.35.

78.g: ਸ੍ਵੈਯਾ ॥
78.t: savaiyaa ||
78.e: SWAYYA

78.g: ਲੈ ਕਰਿ ਚੰਡਿ ਕੁਵੰਡ ਪ੍ਰਚੰਡ ਮਹਾ ਬਰਬੰਡ ਤਬੈ ਇਹ ਕੀਨੋ ॥
78.t: lai kar cha(n)dd kuva(n)dd pracha(n)dd mahaa baraba(n)dd tabai ieh keeno ||
78.e: The mighty Chandika, taking the bow in her hand, in great rage, did this

78.g: ਏਕ ਹੀ ਬਾਰ ਨਿਹਾਰਿ ਹਕਾਰਿ ਸੁਧਾਰਿ ਬਿਦਾਰ ਸਭੈ ਦਲ ਦੀਨੋ ॥
78.t: ek hee baar nihaar hakaar sudhaar bidhaar sabhai dhal dheeno ||
78.e: She scanned once all the army of the enemy and with terrible shout destroyed it.

78.g: ਦੈਤ ਘਨੇ ਰਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਹਨੇ ਲਖਿ ਸ੍ਰੋਨ ਸਨੇ ਕਵਿ ਇਉ ਮਨੁ ਚੀਨੋ ॥
78.t: dhait ghane ran maeh hane lakh sron sane kav iau man cheeno ||
78.e: Seeing a large number of chopped and bleeding demons, the poet feels in his mind

78.g: ਜਿਉ ਖਗਰਾਜ ਬਡੋ ਅਹਿਰਾਜ ਸਮਾਜ ਕੇ ਕਾਟਿ ਕਤਾ ਕਰਿ ਲੀਨੋ ॥੩੬॥
78.t: jiau khagaraaj baddo ahiraaj samaaj ke kaaT kataa kar leeno ||36||
78.e: That Garuda had chopped the snakes into bits and thrown them helter-skelter.36.

78.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
78.t: dhoharaa ||
78.e: DOHRA

78.g: ਦੇਵੀ ਮਾਰੇ ਦੈਤ ਬਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਬਲ ਨਿਬਲ ਸੇ ਕੀਨ ॥
78.t: dhevee maare dhait bahu prabal nibal se keen ||
78.e: The goddess killed many demons and made the strong ones weak.

78.g: ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਧਾਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਨ ਮੈ ਚਮੂੰ ਚਾਲ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨ ॥੩੭॥
78.t: sasatr dhaar kar karan mai chamoo(n) chaal kar dheen ||37||
78.e: Holding the weapons in her hand, she made the forces of the enemy run away.37.

78.g: ਭਜੀ ਚਮੂੰ ਮਹਖਾਸੁਰੀ ਤਕੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਨਿਜ ਈਸ ॥
78.t: bhajee chamoo(n) mahakhaasuree takee saran nij iees ||
78.e: The army of Mahishasura ran away and sought the shelter of its king.

78.g: ਧਾਇ ਜਾਇ ਤਿਨ ਇਉ ਕਹਿਓ ਹਨਿਓ ਪਦਮ ਭਟ ਬੀਸ ॥੩੮॥
78.t: dhai jai tin iau kahio hanio padham bhaT bees ||38||
78.e: It told him after running that twenty padam of the forces had been killd.38.

78.g: ਸੁਨਿ ਮਹਖਾਸੁਰ ਮੂੜ ਮਤਿ ਮਨ ਮੈ ਉਠਿਓ ਰਿਸਾਇ ॥
78.t: sun mahakhaasur mooR mat man mai uThio risai ||
78.e: Hearing this, the foolish Mahishasura was highly enraged.

78.g: ਆਗਿਆ ਦੀਨੀ ਸੈਨ ਕੋ ਘੇਰੋ ਦੇਵੀ ਜਾਇ ॥੩੯॥
78.t: aagiaa dheenee sain ko ghero dhevee jai ||39||
78.e: He ordered that the goddess be besiged.39.

78.g: ਸ੍ਵੈਯਾ ॥
78.t: savaiyaa ||
78.e: SWAYYA

78.g: ਬਾਤ ਸੁਨੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸਭ ਸੈਨਹਿ ਸੂਰ ਮਿਲੇ ਇਕੁ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਕਰਿਓ ਹੈ ॥
78.t: baat sunee prabh kee sabh saineh soor mile ik ma(n)tr kario hai ||
78.e: Listening to the words of their king, all the warriors together took this decision.

78.g: ਜਾਇ ਪਰੇ ਚਹੂੰ ਓਰ ਤੇ ਧਾਇ ਕੈ ਠਾਟ ਇਹੈ ਮਨ ਮਧਿ ਕਰਿਓ ਹੈ ॥
78.t: jai pare chahoo(n) or te dhai kai ThaaT ihai man madh kario hai ||
78.e: That with firm determination in the mind, the goddess be attacked from all the four directions.

78.g: ਮਾਰ ਹੀ ਮਾਰ ਪੁਕਾਰ ਪਰੇ ਅਸਿ ਲੈ ਕਰਿ ਮੈ ਦਲੁ ਇਉ ਬਿਹਰਿਓ ਹੈ ॥
78.t: maar hee maar pukaar pare as lai kar mai dhal iau bihario hai ||
78.e: With swords in their hands, and uttering loud shouts of “Kill, Kill”, the army of demons swarmed from all directions.

78.g: ਘੇਰਿ ਲਈ ਚਹੂੰ ਓਰ ਤੇ ਚੰਡਿ ਸੁ ਚੰਦ ਮਨੋ ਪਰਵੇਖ ਪਰਿਓ ਹੈ ॥੪੦॥
78.t: gher liee chahoo(n) or te cha(n)dd su cha(n)dh mano paravekh pario hai ||40||
78.e: They all besieged Chandi from all the four sides, like the moon encircled amongst clouds.40.

78.g: ਦੇਖਿ ਚਮੂੰ ਮਹਖਾਸੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਰਿ ਚੰਡ ਕੁਵੰਡ ਪ੍ਰਚੰਡ ਧਰਿਓ ਹੈ ॥
78.t: dhekh chamoo(n) mahakhaasur kee kar cha(n)dd kuva(n)dd pracha(n)dd dhario hai ||
78.e: Scanning the army of Mahishasura, Chandika caught hold of her fierce bow.

78.g: ਦਛਨ ਬਾਮ ਚਲਾਇ ਘਨੇ ਸਰ ਕੋਪ ਭਯਾਨਕ ਜੁਧੁ ਕਰਿਓ ਹੈ ॥
78.t: dhachhan baam chalai ghane sar kop bhayaanak judh kario hai ||
78.e: With anger, she waged the terrible war by showering the rain of her innumerable shafts.

78.g: ਭੰਜਨ ਭੇ ਅਰਿ ਕੇ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਛੁਟ ਸ੍ਰਉਨ ਸਮੂਹ ਧਰਾਨਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਹੈ ॥
78.t: bha(n)jan bhe ar ke tan te chhuT sraun samooh dharaan pario hai ||
78.e: By chopping the forces of the enemy, such a great quantity of blood fell on the ground.

78.g: ਆਠਵੋ ਸਿੰਧੁ ਪਚਾਯੋ ਹੁਤੋ ਮਨੋ ਯਾ ਰਨ ਮੈ ਬਿਧਿ ਨੇ ਉਗਰਿਓ ਹੈ ॥੪੧॥
78.t: aaThavo si(n)dh pachaayo huto mano yaa ran mai bidh ne ugario hai ||41||
78.e: As though the Lord-God hath created the eighth ocean alongwith already created seven oceans.41.

78.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
78.t: dhoharaa ||
78.e: DOHRA

79.g: ਕੋਪ ਭਈ ਅਰਿ ਦਲ ਬਿਖੈ ਚੰਡੀ ਚਕ੍ਰ ਸੰਭਾਰਿ ॥
79.t: kop bhiee ar dhal bikhai cha(n)ddee chakr sa(n)bhaar ||
79.e: Chandi in great anger, holding up her disc, within the enemy’s army

79.g: ਏਕ ਮਾਰਿ ਕੈ ਦ੍ਵੈ ਕੀਏ ਦ੍ਵੈ ਤੇ ਕੀਨੇ ਚਾਰ ॥੪੨॥
79.t: ek maar kai dhavai ke'ee dhavai te keene chaar ||42||
79.e: She cut off the warriors into halves and quarters.42.

79.g: ਸ੍ਵੈਯਾ ॥
79.t: savaiyaa ||
79.e: SWAYYA

79.g: ਇਹ ਭਾਤਿ ਕੋ ਜੁਧੁ ਕਰਿਓ ਸੁਨਿ ਕੈ ਕਵਲਾਸ ਮੈ ਧਿਆਨ ਛੁਟਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ॥
79.t: eeh bhaat ko judh kario sun kai kavalaas mai dhiaan chhuTio har kaa ||
79.e: Such a terrible war was waged that the profound contemplation of Shiva was infringed.

79.g: ਪੁਨਿ ਚੰਡ ਸੰਭਾਰ ਉਭਾਰ ਗਦਾ ਧੁਨਿ ਸੰਖ ਬਜਾਇ ਕਰਿਓ ਖਰਕਾ ॥
79.t: pun cha(n)dd sa(n)bhaar ubhaar gadhaa dhun sa(n)kh bajai kario kharakaa ||
79.e: Chandi then held up her mace and raised a violent sound by blowing her onch.

79.g: ਸਿਰ ਸਤ੍ਰਨਿ ਕੇ ਪਰ ਚਕ੍ਰ ਪਰਿਓ ਛੁਟਿ ਐਸੇ ਬਹਿਓ ਕਰਿ ਕੇ ਬਰ ਕਾ ॥
79.t: sir satran ke par chakr pario chhuT aaise bahio kar ke bar kaa ||
79.e: The disc fell on the heads of the enemies, that disc went in such a way with the might of her hand

79.g: ਜਨੁ ਖੇਲ ਕੋ ਸਰਤਾ ਤਟਿ ਜਾਇ ਚਲਾਵਤ ਹੈ ਛਿਛਲੀ ਲਰਕਾ ॥੪੩॥
79.t: jan khel ko sarataa taT jai chalaavat hai chhichhalee larakaa ||43||
79.e: That it seemed that the children were throwing the potsherd so as swim on the surface of the water.43.,

79.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
79.t: dhoharaa ||
79.e: DOHRA,

79.g: ਦੇਖ ਚਮੂੰ ਮਹਿਖਾਸੁਰੀ ਦੇਵੀ ਬਲਹਿ ਸੰਭਾਰਿ ॥
79.t: dhekh chamoo(n) mahikhaasuree dhevee baleh sa(n)bhaar ||
79.e: Scanning the forces of Mahishasura, the goddess pulling up her strength,

79.g: ਕਛੁ ਸਿੰਘਹਿ ਕਛੁ ਚਕ੍ਰ ਸੋ ਡਾਰੇ ਸਭੈ ਸੰਘਾਰਿ ॥੪੪॥
79.t: kachh si(n)gheh kachh chakr so ddaare sabhai sa(n)ghaar ||44||
79.e: She destroyed all, killing some thorough her lion and some with her disc.44.,

79.g: ਇਕ ਭਾਜੈ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਪੈ ਗਏ ਕਹਿਓ ਹਤੀ ਸਭ ਸੈਨ ॥
79.t: eik bhaajai nirap pai ge kahio hatee sabh sain ||
79.e: One of the demons ran to the king and told him about the destruction of all the army.,

79.g: ਇਉ ਸੁਨਿ ਕੈ ਕੋਪਿਓ ਅਸੁਰ ਚੜਿ ਆਇਓ ਰਨ ਐਨ ॥੪੫॥
79.t: eiau sun kai kopio asur chaR aaio ran aain ||45||
79.e: Hearing this, Mahishasura become furious and marched towards the battlefield. 45.,

79.g: ਸ੍ਵੈਯਾ ॥
79.t: savaiyaa ||
79.e: SWAYYA,

79.g: ਜੂਝ ਪਰੀ ਸਭ ਸੈਨ ਲਖੀ ਜਬ ਤੌ ਮਹਖਾਸੁਰ ਖਗ ਸੰਭਾਰਿਓ ॥
79.t: joojh paree sabh sain lakhee jab tau mahakhaasur khag sa(n)bhaario ||
79.e: Knowing about the destruction of all his forces in the war, Mahishasura held up his sword.,

79.g: ਚੰਡਿ ਪ੍ਰਚੰਡ ਕੇ ਸਾਮੁਹਿ ਜਾਇ ਭਇਆਨਕ ਭਾਲਕ ਜਿਉ ਭਭਕਾਰਿਓ ॥
79.t: cha(n)dd pracha(n)dd ke saamuh jai bhiaanak bhaalak jiau bhabhakaario ||
79.e: And going before the fierce Chandi, he began to roar like dreadful bear.,

79.g: ਮੁਗਦਰੁ ਲੈ ਅਪਨੇ ਕਰਿ ਚੰਡਿ ਸੁ ਕੈ ਬਰਿ ਤਾ ਤਨ ਊਪਰਿ ਡਾਰਿਓ ॥
79.t: mugadhar lai apane kar cha(n)dd su kai bar taa tan uoopar ddaario ||
79.e: Taking his heavy mace in his hand, he threw it on body of the goddess like an arrow.,

79.g: ਜਿਉ ਹਨੂਮਾਨ ਉਖਾਰਿ ਪਹਾਰ ਕੋ ਰਾਵਨ ਕੇ ਉਰ ਭੀਤਰ ਮਾਰਿਓ ॥੪੬॥
79.t: jiau hanoomaan ukhaar pahaar ko raavan ke ur bheetar maario ||46||
79.e: It seemed that Hanuman carrying a hillock, threw it on the chest of Ravvana.46.,

79.g: ਫੇਰ ਸਰਾਸਨ ਕੋ ਗਹਿ ਕੈ ਕਰਿ ਬੀਰ ਹਨੇ ਤਿਨ ਪਾਨਿ ਨ ਮੰਗੇ ॥
79.t: fer saraasan ko geh kai kar beer hane tin paan na ma(n)ge ||
79.e: Then he held up bows and arrows in his hand , killed the warriors, who could not ask for water before dying.,

79.g: ਘਾਇਲ ਘੂਮ ਪਰੇ ਰਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਕਰਾਹਤ ਹੈ ਗਿਰ ਸੇ ਗਜ ਲੰਗੇ ॥
79.t: ghail ghoom pare ran maeh karaahat hai gir se gaj la(n)ge ||
79.e: The wounded warriors were moving in the field like lame elephants.,

79.g: ਸੂਰਨ ਕੇ ਤਨ ਕਉਚਨ ਸਾਥਿ ਪਰੇ ਧਰਿ ਭਾਉ ਉਠੇ ਤਹ ਚੰਗੇ ॥
79.t: sooran ke tan kauchan saath pare dhar bhaau uThe teh cha(n)ge ||
79.e: The bodies of the warriors were moving their armours were lying fried up on the ground.,

79.g: ਜਾਨੋ ਦਵਾ ਬਨ ਮਾਝ ਲਗੇ ਤਹ ਕੀਟਨ ਭਛ ਕੌ ਦਉਰੇ ਭੁਜੰਗੇ ॥੪੭॥
79.t: jaano dhavaa ban maajh lage teh keeTan bhachh kau dhaure bhuja(n)ge ||47||
79.e: As if the forest is on fire and the snakes are running to reed themselves on the fast moving worms.47.,

79.g: ਕੋਪ ਭਰੀ ਰਨਿ ਚੰਡਿ ਪ੍ਰਚੰਡ ਸੁ ਪ੍ਰੇਰ ਕੇ ਸਿੰਘ ਧਸੀ ਰਨ ਮੈ ॥
79.t: kop bharee ran cha(n)dd pracha(n)dd su prer ke si(n)gh dhasee ran mai ||
79.e: Chandi in great ire penetrated into the war-arena with her lion.,

79.g: ਕਰਵਾਰ ਲੈ ਲਾਲ ਕੀਏ ਅਰਿ ਖੇਤਿ ਲਗੀ ਬੜਵਾਨਲ ਜਿਉ ਬਨ ਮੈ ॥
79.t: karavaar lai laal ke'ee ar khet lagee baRavaanal jiau ban mai ||
79.e: Holding her sword in her hand, she dyed the battlefield in red as if the forest is on fire.,

79.g: ਤਬ ਘੇਰਿ ਲਈ ਚਹੂੰ ਓਰ ਤੇ ਦੈਤਨ ਇਉ ਉਪਮਾ ਉਪਜੀ ਮਨ ਮੈ ॥
79.t: tab gher liee chahoo(n) or te dhaitan iau upamaa upajee man mai ||
79.e: When the demons besieged the goddess from all the four sides, the poet felt like this in his mind,

80.g: ਮਨੁ ਤੇ ਤਨੁ ਤੇਜੁ ਚਲਿਓ ਜਗ ਮਾਤ ਕੋ ਦਾਮਨਿ ਜਾਨ ਚਲੇ ਘਨ ਮੈ ॥੪੮॥
80.t: man te tan tej chalio jag maat ko dhaaman jaan chale ghan mai ||48||
80.e: That the body of the mother of the world moved swifter than her mind, she appeared as lightning moving in the clouds.48.,

80.g: ਫੂਟ ਗਈ ਧੁਜਨੀ ਸਗਰੀ ਅਸਿ ਚੰਡ ਪ੍ਰਚੰਡ ਜਬੈ ਕਰਿ ਲੀਨੋ ॥
80.t: fooT giee dhujanee sagaree as cha(n)dd pracha(n)dd jabai kar leeno ||
80.e: When the goddess held her sword in her hand, all the army of the demons cracked.,

80.g: ਦੈਤ ਮਰੈ ਨਹਿ ਬੇਖ ਕਰੈ ਬਹੁਤਉ ਬਰਬੰਡ ਮਹਾਬਲ ਕੀਨੋ ॥
80.t: dhait marai neh bekh karai bahutau baraba(n)dd mahaabal keeno ||
80.e: The demons were also very powerful, they did not die and instead were fighting in transformed forms.,

80.g: ਚਕ੍ਰ ਚਲਾਇ ਦਇਓ ਕਰਿ ਤੇ ਸਿਰ ਸਤ੍ਰ ਕੋ ਮਾਰ ਜੁਦਾ ਕਰ ਦੀਨੋ ॥
80.t: chakr chalai dhio kar te sir satr ko maar judhaa kar dheeno ||
80.e: Chandi segregated the heads of the enemies by throwing her disc with her hands.,

80.g: ਸ੍ਰਉਨਤ ਧਾਰ ਚਲੀ ਨਭ ਕੋ ਜਨੁ ਸੂਰ ਕੋ ਰਾਮ ਜਲਾਜਲ ਦੀਨੋ ॥੪੯॥
80.t: sraunat dhaar chalee nabh ko jan soor ko raam jalaajal dheeno ||49||
80.e: Consequently the current of bloods flowed as if Rama was offering water to the sun.49.,

80.g: ਸਬ ਸੂਰ ਸੰਘਾਰ ਦਏ ਤਿਹ ਖੇਤਿ ਮਹਾ ਬਰਬੰਡ ਪਰਾਕ੍ਰਮ ਕੈ ॥
80.t: sab soor sa(n)ghaar dhe teh khet mahaa baraba(n)dd paraakram kai ||
80.e: When that mighty goddess killed all the chivalrous demons with her power,

80.g: ਤਹ ਸ੍ਰਉਨਤ ਸਿੰਧੁ ਭਇਓ ਧਰਨੀ ਪਰਿ ਪੁੰਜ ਗਿਰੇ ਅਸਿ ਕੈ ਧਮ ਕੈ ॥
80.t: teh sraunat si(n)dh bhio dharanee par pu(n)j gire as kai dham kai ||
80.e: Then so much mass of blood fell on the earth that it became a sea of blood.,

80.g: ਜਗ ਮਾਤ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪ ਹਨੇ ਸੁਰ ਤਾਪ ਸੁ ਦਾਨਵ ਸੈਨ ਗਈ ਜਮ ਕੈ ॥
80.t: jag maat prataap hane sur taap su dhaanav sain giee jam kai ||
80.e: The mother of the world, with her power, removed the suffering of gods and the demons went to the abode of Yama.,

80.g: ਬਹੁਰੋ ਅਰਿ ਸਿੰਧੁਰ ਕੇ ਦਲ ਪੈਠ ਕੈ ਦਾਮਿਨਿ ਜਿਉ ਦੁਰਗਾ ਦਮਕੈ ॥੫੦॥
80.t: bahuro ar si(n)dhur ke dhal paiTh kai dhaamin jiau dhuragaa dhamakai ||50||
80.e: Then the goddess Durga glistened like lightning amongst the army of elephants.50.,

80.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
80.t: dhoharaa ||
80.e: DOHRA,

80.g: ਜਬ ਮਹਖਾਸੁਰ ਮਾਰਿਓ ਸਬ ਦੈਤਨ ਕੋ ਰਾਜ ॥
80.t: jab mahakhaasur maario sab dhaitan ko raaj ||
80.e: When Mahishasura, the king of all deemons, was killed,

80.g: ਤਬ ਕਾਇਰ ਭਾਜੇ ਸਬੈ ਛਾਡਿਓ ਸਕਲ ਸਮਾਜ ॥੫੧॥
80.t: tab kair bhaaje sabai chhaaddio sakal samaaj ||51||
80.e: Then all the cawards ran away leaving behind all paraphernalia.51.,

80.g: ਕਬਿਤੁ ॥
80.t: kabit ||
80.e: KABIT,

80.g: ਮਹਾਬੀਰ ਕਹਰੀ ਦੁਪਹਰੀ ਕੋ ਭਾਨੁ ਮਾਨੋ ਦੇਵਨ ਕੇ ਕਾਜ ਦੇਵੀ ਡਾਰਿਓ ਦੈਤ ਮਾਰਿ ਕੈ ॥
80.t: mahaabeer kaharee dhupaharee ko bhaan maano dhevan ke kaaj dhevee ddaario dhait maar kai ||
80.e: Supremely heroic goddess, with the magnificence of the sun at noon, killed the demon-king for the well-being of gods.,

80.g: ਅਉਰ ਦਲੁ ਭਾਜਿਓ ਜੈਸੇ ਪਉਨ ਹੂੰ ਤੇ ਭਾਜੇ ਮੇਘ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਦੀਨੋ ਰਾਜ ਬਲੁ ਆਪਨੋ ਸੋ ਧਾਰਿ ਕੈ ॥
80.t: aaur dhal bhaajio jaise paun hoo(n) te bhaaje megh i(n)dhr dheeno raaj bal aapano so dhaar kai ||
80.e: The remaining demon-army ran helter-skelter in such a way, as the cloud speed away before the wind, the goddess with her prowess bestowed the kingdom on Indra.,

80.g: ਦੇਸ ਦੇਸ ਕੇ ਨਰੇਸ ਡਾਰੈ ਹੈ ਸੁਰੇਸ ਪਾਇ ਕੀਨੋ ਅਭਖੇਕ ਸੁਰ ਮੰਡਲ ਬਿਚਾਰਿ ਕੈ ॥
80.t: dhes dhes ke nares ddaarai hai sures pai keeno abhakhek sur ma(n)ddal bichaar kai ||
80.e: She caused sovereigns of many countries to bow in obeisance to Indra and his coronation ceremony was thoughtfully performed by the assembly of gods.,

80.g: ਈਹਾ ਭਈ ਗੁਪਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿ ਜਾਇ ਤਹਾ ਭਈ ਜਹਾ ਬੈਠੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿਅੰਬਰਿ ਕੋ ਡਾਰਿ ਕੈ ॥੫੨॥
80.t: e'eehaa bhiee gupat pragaT jai tahaa bhiee jahaa baiThe har haria(n)bar ko ddaar kai ||52||
80.e: In this way, the goddess disappeared from here and manifested herself there, where the god Shiva was seated on the lion-skin.52.,

80.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਮਾਰਕੰਡੇ ਪੁਰਾਨੇ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਚੰਡੀ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਉਕਤਿ ਬਿਲਾਸ ਮਹਖਾਸੁਰ ਬਧਹਿ ਨਾਮ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਧਿਆਇ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ਸਤੁ ਸੁਭਮ ਸਤੁ ॥੨॥
80.t: eit sree maaraka(n)dde puraane sree cha(n)ddee charitr ukat bilaas mahakhaasur badheh naam dhuteeaa dhiaai samaapatam sat subham sat ||2||
80.e: End of the Second Chapter entitled ‘The Killing of Mahishasura’ as recorded in CHANDI CHARTRA UKATI BILAS of Markandeya Purana. 2.,

80.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
80.t: dhoharaa ||
80.e: DOHRA,

80.g: ਲੋਪ ਚੰਡਕਾ ਹੋਇ ਗਈ ਸੁਰਪਤਿ ਕੌ ਦੇ ਰਾਜ ॥
80.t: lop cha(n)ddakaa hoi giee surapat kau dhe raaj ||
80.e: In this way Chandika disappeared after bestowing the kingship on Indra.,

80.g: ਦਾਨਵ ਮਾਰਿ ਅਭੇਖ ਕਰਿ ਕੀਨੇ ਸੰਤਨ ਕਾਜ ॥੫੩॥
80.t: dhaanav maar abhekh kar keene sa(n)tan kaaj ||53||
80.e: She killed the demons and destroyed them for the well-being of the saints.53.,

80.g: ਸ੍ਵੈਯਾ ॥
80.t: savaiyaa ||
80.e: SWAYYA,

80.g: ਯਾ ਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਮਹਾ ਮੁਨ ਦੇਵਨ ਕੇ ਤਪ ਮੈ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
80.t: yaa te prasa(n)n bhe hai mahaa mun dhevan ke tap mai sukh paavai ||
80.e: The great sages became pleased and received comfort in meditating on the gods.,

80.g: ਜਗ੍ਯ ਕਰੈ ਇਕ ਬੇਦ ਰਰੈ ਭਵ ਤਾਪ ਹਰੈ ਮਿਲਿ ਧਿਆਨਹਿ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
80.t: jagay karai ik bedh rarai bhav taap harai mil dhiaaneh laavai ||
80.e: The sacrifices are being performed, the Vedas are being recited and for the removal of suffering, contemplation is being done together.,

80.g: ਝਾਲਰ ਤਾਲ ਮ੍ਰਿਦੰਗ ਉਪੰਗ ਰਬਾਬ ਲੀਏ ਸੁਰ ਸਾਜ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥
80.t: jhaalar taal miradha(n)g upa(n)g rabaab le'ee sur saaj milaavai ||
80.e: The tunes of various musical instruments like cymbals big and small, trumpet, kettledrum and Rabab are being made harmonies.,

80.g: ਕਿੰਨਰ ਗੰਧ੍ਰਬ ਗਾਨ ਕਰੈ ਗਨਿ ਜਛ ਅਪਛਰ ਨਿਰਤ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ॥੫੪॥
80.t: ki(n)nar ga(n)dhrab gaan karai gan jachh apachhar nirat dhikhaavai ||54||
80.e: Somewhere the Kinnars and Gandharvas are singing and somewhere the Ganas, Yakshas and Apsaras are dancing.54.,

80.g: ਸੰਖਨ ਕੀ ਧੁਨ ਘੰਟਨਿ ਕੀ ਕਰਿ ਫੂਲਨ ਕੀ ਬਰਖਾ ਬਰਖਾਵੈ ॥
80.t: sa(n)khan kee dhun gha(n)Tan kee kar foolan kee barakhaa barakhaavai ||
80.e: With the sound of conches and gongs, they are causing the rain of flowers.,

80.g: ਆਰਤੀ ਕੋਟਿ ਕਰੈ ਸੁਰ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਪੇਖ ਪੁਰੰਦਰ ਕੇ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
80.t: aaratee koT karai sur su(n)dhar pekh pura(n)dhar ke bal jaavai ||
80.e: Millions of gods fully decorated, are performing aarti (circumambulation) and seeing Indra, they show intense devotion.,

80.g: ਦਾਨਤ ਦਛਨ ਦੈ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰਦਛਨ ਭਾਲ ਮੈ ਕੁੰਕਮ ਅਛਤ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
80.t: dhaanat dhachhan dhai kai pradhachhan bhaal mai ku(n)kam achhat laavai ||
80.e: Giving gifts and performing circumambulation around Indra, they are applying the frontal –mark of saffron and rice on their foreheads.,

80.g: ਹੋਤ ਕੁਲਾਹਲ ਦੇਵਪੁਰੀ ਮਿਲ ਦੇਵਨ ਕੇ ਕੁਲਿ ਮੰਗਲ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੫੫॥
80.t: hot kulaahal dhevapuree mil dhevan ke kul ma(n)gal gaavai ||55||
80.e: In all the city of gods, there is much excitement and the families of gods are singing songs of feliciations.55.,

80.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
80.t: dhoharaa ||
80.e: DOHRA,

80.g: ਐਸੇ ਚੰਡ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪ ਤੇ ਦੇਵਨ ਬਢਿਓ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪ ॥
80.t: aaise cha(n)dd prataap te dhevan baddio prataap ||
80.e: In this way, through the Glory of Chandi, the splendour of gods increased.,

80.g: ਤੀਨ ਲੋਕ ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਰੈ ਰਰੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਤਿ ਜਾਪ ॥੫੬॥
80.t: teen lok jai jai karai rarai naam sat jaap ||56||
80.e: All the there worlds are rejoicing and the sound of the recitation of True Name is being heard.56.,

80.g: ਇਸੀ ਭਾਤਿ ਸੋ ਦੇਵਤਨ ਰਾਜ ਕੀਯੋ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਨਿ ॥
80.t: eisee bhaat so dhevatan raaj keeyo sukh maan ||
80.e: The gods ruled comfortably like this.,

80.g: ਬਹੁਰ ਸੁੰਭ ਨੈਸੁੰਭ ਦੁਇ ਦੈਤ ਬਡੇ ਬਲਿਵਾਨ ॥੫੭॥
80.t: bahur su(n)bh naisu(n)bh dhui dhait badde balivaan ||57||
80.e: But after some time, two mighty demons named Sumbh and Nisumbh appeared.57.,

80.g: ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਲੋਕ ਕੇ ਰਾਜ ਹਿਤ ਚੜਿ ਧਾਏ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਸੁੰਭ ॥
80.t: ei(n)dhr lok ke raaj hit chaR dhaae nirap su(n)bh ||
80.e: For conquering the kingdom of Indra, the king Sumbh came forward,

80.g: ਸੈਨਾ ਚਤੁਰੰਗਨਿ ਰਚੀ ਪਾਇਕ ਰਥ ਹੈ ਕੁੰਭ ॥੫੮॥
80.t: sainaa chatura(n)gan rachee paik rath hai ku(n)bh ||58||
80.e: With his four types of army containing soldiers on foot, in chariots and on elephants.58.,

80.g: ਸ੍ਵੈਯਾ ॥
80.t: savaiyaa ||
80.e: SWAYYA,

80.g: ਬਾਜਤ ਡੰਕ ਪੁਰੀ ਧੁਨ ਕਾਨਿ ਸੁ ਸੰਕਿ ਪੁਰੰਦਰ ਮੂੰਦਤ ਪਉਰੈ ॥
80.t: baajat dda(n)k puree dhun kaan su sa(n)k pura(n)dhar moo(n)dhat paurai ||
80.e: Hearing the sound of the war-trumpets and getting dubious in mind, Indra the portals of his citadel.,

80.g: ਸੂਰ ਮੈ ਨਾਹਿ ਰਹੀ ਦੁਤਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਕੇ ਜੁਧ ਕੋ ਦੈਤ ਭਏ ਇਕ ਠਉਰੈ ॥
80.t: soor mai naeh rahee dhut dhekh ke judh ko dhait bhe ik Thaurai ||
80.e: Considering the hesitation of the warriors to come forward for fight, all the demos gathered together at one place.,

80.g: ਕਾਪ ਸਮੁੰਦ੍ਰ ਉਠੇ ਸਿਗਰੇ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਰ ਭਈ ਧਰਨੀ ਗਤਿ ਅਉਰੈ ॥
80.t: kaap samu(n)dhr uThe sigare bahu bhaar bhiee dharanee gat aaurai ||
80.e: Seeing their gathering, the oceans trembled and the movement of the earth changed with heavy burden.,

80.g: ਮੇਰੁ ਹਲਿਓ ਦਹਲਿਓ ਸੁਰ ਲੋਕ ਜਬੈ ਦਲ ਸੁੰਭ ਨਿਸੁੰਭ ਕੇ ਦਉਰੈ ॥੫੯॥
80.t: mer halio dhahalio sur lok jabai dhal su(n)bh nisu(n)bh ke dhaurai ||59||
80.e: Seeing the forces of Sumbh and Nisumbh running. Sumeru mountain moved and the world of gods became agitated.59.,

80.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
80.t: dhoharaa ||
80.e: DOHRA,

80.g: ਦੇਵ ਸਭੈ ਮਿਲਿ ਕੇ ਤਬੈ ਗਏ ਸਕ੍ਰ ਪਹਿ ਧਾਇ ॥
80.t: dhev sabhai mil ke tabai ge sakr peh dhai ||
80.e: All the gods then went running to Indra.,

80.g: ਕਹਿਓ ਦੈਤ ਆਏ ਪ੍ਰਬਲ ਕੀਜੈ ਕਹਾ ਉਪਾਇ ॥੬੦॥
80.t: kahio dhait aae prabal keejai kahaa upai ||60||
80.e: They asked him to take some steps because of the conquest of powerful demos.60.,

80.g: ਸੁਨਿ ਕੋਪਿਓ ਸੁਰਪਾਲ ਤਬ ਕੀਨੋ ਜੁਧ ਉਪਾਇ ॥
80.t: sun kopio surapaal tab keeno judh upai ||
80.e: Hearing this, the king of gods got furious and began to take steps for waging war.,

80.g: ਸੇਖ ਦੇਵ ਗਨ ਜੇ ਹੁਤੇ ਤੇ ਸਭ ਲੀਏ ਬੁਲਾਇ ॥੬੧॥
80.t: sekh dhev gan je hute te sabh le'ee bulai ||61||
80.e: He called also all the remaining gods.61.,

80.g: ਸ੍ਵੈਯਾ ॥
80.t: savaiyaa ||
80.e: SWAYYA,
